It’s a pull for photographers, swimmers and thrill-seekers. The best way to explore it — and the surrounding gems — is by boat. This guide includes where to rent boats near Bonsai Rock, the best restaurants you can boat up to, where to see and be seen, things to do, and opportunities to snap the best photos around Lake Tahoe. Sand Harbor Rentals (2m north) • Enjoy warm summer days with boat rentals on glassy waters. Excellent launch spot for short cruises south to Bonsai Rock. Incline Village / Ski Beach Marina and beach (10 minutes by boat) Pontoons, speedboats, and luxury cruisers. It is the center of Bonsai Rock and Crystal Bay. Zephyr Cove Marina (further south) Full service marina and larger boat rentals if you would like to explore the entire east and south shore as well as Bonsai Rock. Why by boat: Parking lot gets full early; you’re assured parking by arriving by boat. Tucked away on the serene north shore of Lake Tahoe, Crystal Bay with its Speedboat Beach, is the perfect home base for a daylong boat excursion. But with convenient access to hidden coves, historic sites and waterfront dining, it’s a great place to rent a boat for the day and play without the crowds or havoc of neighboring towns. Crystal Bay Boat Rentals & Charters Tahoe Bliss Boat Charters offers captained boat rentals of all sizes, including wake‑surf boats, powerboats, and pontoons — ideal for families, thrill fishermen, or sunset seekers. Choose from optional add‑ons including wake surfing, tubing, waterskiing, fireworks watching, full‑moon or star gazing voyages, and flexible sunset cruises. Best Day‑Trip Routes from Crystal Bay Crystal Bay & Speedboat Beach offer some of the most stunning views in all of Lake Tahoe. Below are some of our favorite places to check out when you are out enjoying you Lake Tahoe boat rental: Cruise Along North Shore Speedboat Beach cove: Anchor here to swim, paddleboard, and sunbathe Secluded coves & boulder strewn beaches: Hideaway vistas for photos and tranquility Sightseeing & History Cal-Neva Lodge & Casino: See the iconic lakefront resort (Frank Sinatra’s summer go-to) from the water Tahoe Biltmore site: Grab a peek at the former casino site at the water’s edge Withers Log House & Cal-Vada Lodge: Historic log architecture in Crystal Bay Sunsets, Moonlight & Fireworks Cruises Sure‑to‑wow sunset charters from 7–9pm Moonlit stargazing excursions, with a brilliant Milky Way above Tahoe’s dark-sky vantage point Enjoy the 4th of July or Labor Day straight from your boat - fireworks in your front yard! What to Do After Boating in Crystal Bay with Tahoe Bliss Boat Charters On‑Shore Stops & Dining Although boats can be moored anywhere, here are a few of the destination shore-side spots to add to your boating itinerary: Cal-Neva Resort: Tie up or drop anchor just off shore and make a short lakeside visit inside the historic lodge and casino. Crystal Bay Club: Lake view, lakeside dining, and setting right on the water. Cal-Neva Lodge: Classic cabin charm just out the door on the water. Activities Beyond Boating in Crystal Bay Enjoy some more water-filled fun throughout the day: Kayaking / SUP tours: Launch from Speedboat Beach, walk to the beach front shop with easy rentals, and return tothe beach for calm water shoreline paddles Fishing charters: Top-rated guides such as Sierra Fin Addicts and Lake Tahoe Luxury Boat Rentals are based in these parts What to Bring & Know Before You Come Must Haves: Sunscreen, towels, suits, warm clothes, water & snacks, waterproof phone case Book early: Summer weekends fill up quickly—get your boat charter locked in early Captain included: All rentals come with USCG‑certified captains for your safety and convenience Crystal Bay Fun Facts & Local History Withers Log House (1931)and Cal-Vada Lodge (1935) are both listed on the National Register of Historic Places, reminders of Crystal Bay's early period of rustic resorts. The new lodge, the Cal-Neva Lodge, had been built just 30 days after fire turned an older hostelry of the same name to ashes, and it became well known in the 1960s when it was owned by Frank Sinatra. But it was also where John F. Kennedy and Marilyn Monroe spent time together when he wasn’t following the mule deer through the high, cool, and — until a final season of scandal and shame — discreet turf of the Crittenden Lodge, in the Washoe Valley near Tahoe. (“Old mule deer,” Monroe cooed.) Tahoe Biltmore, which first opened in 1948, is now closed, at least for the time being, but will be reincarnated as a luxury Waldorf Astoria with access to the lake. A bona fide North Shore jewel, Hidden Beach provides the clear blue waters, sun-warmed granite boulders and low-key, mellow vibe that makes it seem miles away from the crowded public hoopla of many beach outings. Whether you're seeking a romantic getaway, family fun, or a serene day of beachside relaxation, there is nothing like experiencing the beauty of this secluded shoreline with a Hidden Beach boat rental from Tahoe Bliss Boat Charters. Why Hidden Beach for Lake Tahoe Boating? Hidden Beach certainly earns its name. You can reach this crescent cove by water or a short walk along the East Shore Trail, and it slides away in the distance past smooth granite boulders, turquoise-blue shallows and pine-fringed cliffs. It's one of the few “locals only”-style spots, quiet, scenic, and often less crowded than some of Tahoe’s bigger beaches. At Tahoe Bliss, we like to take our guests to Hidden Beach because it’s so pretty and it’s well off the beaten path, with great swimming and snorkeling, and with a relaxed energy that's perfect for anchoring, sun bathing, or having a picnic on board. Our Hidden Beach boat rentals provide fully private, captained outings that empower you to experience Lake Tahoe the way you want to. We cruise from the pickup location of your choice (may possibly include Incline Village or Sand Harbor) directly to Hidden Beach in style. What to Expect: Cushionsuits and lots of shade Bluetooth speaker systems for all your favorite tunes Paddleboards, floats and Snorkeling gear provided Your own local, Coast Guard licensed captain at the helm to guide and tailor your day You’ll drop anchor just off shore, enjoy unimpeded views of the passing granite shoreline, float in the warmth of the sun and swim in some of the clearest water Tahoe has to offer. Things to Do at Hidden Beach Less developed than the expansive public beaches on the lake, Hidden Beach is why people love Tahoe. The following are some of our favorite things to do when visiting by boat: Swimming & Snorkeling The peaceful, pristine waters around Hidden Beach are perfect for swimming and snorkeling. You will frequently see trout and bass weaving between boulders, and there’s great underwater visibility in calm conditions. Sunbathing on the Boulders Sun-warmed granite boulders that rim the beach provide natural lounge chairs with sunset views. Reel in your float or climb out onto a rock and soak in the serenity. Picnic On Board Our boat rentals come with a cooler and a lot of room for snacks and drinks. Pack your own favorite local nibbles or let us arrange for you to coordinate with gourmet delis in the area for a more upscale lakeside picnic. Paddleboarding Because of the generally tranquil water, Hidden Beach is a paddleboarder’s dream. Whistle around the cove or explore little nooks and crannies of shoreline, or just float about and relax. Where to Eat Nearby Although there are no food vendors on Hidden Beach itself (that’s part of the charm!), there are more than a few wonderful options just a short drive or boat ride away: Lone Eagle Grille (Incline Village) Fine dining overlooking the lake, featuring seafood and upscale mountain fare. Tunnel Creek Café Perfect post-beach fare of fresh coffee, sandwiches and smoothies right at the trailhead of the East Shore Trail. T’s Mesquite Rotisserie Home of the massive burritos and tacos, this locals’ spot in Incline Village is great for takeout before or after boating. Alibi Ale Works (Incline Public House) Craft beer and high-end bar food to relax at after your boat day. How to Access Hidden Beach Access to Hidden Beach is two-fold. By Boat (Highly Recommended) The best way to visit Hidden Beach is catching it by water. With a Hidden Beach boat tour, no parking frustration, no crowds, and VIP treatment for this idyllic beach! By Foot For those on land, Hidden Beach is a short walk or bike off the East Shore Trail, a two-way paved path that connects Incline Village to Sand Harbor. Parking is minimal off Highway 28, and there’s a short walk to reach them. Insider Advice on Visiting Hidden Beach Stake out the best anchoring spots in advance, arriving early by boat, particularly on weekends. Bring what you need — there are no restrooms or services at the beach. Take water shoes if you want to wade in by the rocks. Mind the silence — Hidden Beach is a tranquil zone, not a party cove. As a family-owned and operated resort, we welcome you to our home. Donner Ski Ranch is one of the few remaining independent ski areas, so you'll never feel like just another number here. We love this place and want you to feel that way too. Welcome to the family. Incredible Value Fun for All We believe skiing and snowboarding should be fun and accessible to everyone, not just the rich and famous. For almost 90 years, we have offered one of the most affordable snow experiences around. Whether you're a first-timer or a seasoned local, you can enjoy an incredible day on the slopes without breaking the bank. 88 Years of Awesome! For nearly nine decades, Donner Ski Ranch has welcomed families to our slopes. Since we first opened in 1937, we've provided an accessible and affordable experience for everyone who loves the snow. We're proud to be one of California's oldest and most beloved ski resorts, offering generations of families a place to learn, play, and make lasting memories. If you have a lesson and are thinking about renting equipment with us, we recommend you arrive at least one hour before the lesson. During holidays or weekends, we strongly encourage you to arrive at least 2 hours before the lesson, so you have enough time to find a parking spot and wait in lines if there are any; the earlier the better. We DO NOT rent only skis or only ski boots. If you are renting ski equipment with us, you’ll have to rent the whole package and use our boots with our skis. As the only inland marina on the lake, we are your premiere choice for protection from wind and wave action. Our 250 slips rent on a daily, weekly, monthly, or seasonal basis. We also have a full service launching & landing department equipped with a travel lift, fork lift, and launch ramp for your convenience. NOTE: All vessels being launched must be inspected prior to launching. Visit tahoeboatinspections.com for more information. SLIP INQUIRY FORM Wet Slips Under Redevelopment Tahoe Keys Marina stands as the premier maritime hub and the largest marina on Lake Tahoe, uniquely positioned as the lake’s only inland marina. This sheltered, inland configuration provides a fully protected harbor for your vessel, offering a calm and secure environment that is shielded from the wind and heavy chop of the open water. Our expansive 22-acre facility in South Lake Tahoe is engineered for comprehensive vessel care, featuring a full-service boat launch, a high-capacity Travel Lift, and a specialized Jib crane for sailboat stepping and service. As a complete destination for both boaters and mountain enthusiasts, our property offers high-speed diesel and regular fuel, a curated selection of local charter vendors, a professional on-site water ski school, and premier waterfront dining. Beyond the docks, the experience continues with scenic trails leading to secluded wildlife viewing areas and “secret” beaches on the pristine shores of Lake Tahoe—providing the ultimate vantage point to soak in breathtaking 360° sunsets over the Sierra Nevada mountains. DRY STORAGE Tahoe Keys Marina also provides dry storage solutions, offering secure trailer storage for vessels up to 60’ in length. Located in South Lake Tahoe, our dedicated storage lot is the ideal off-season or year-round home for larger boats and trailers, providing easy access to the water while ensuring your investment is kept safe in a professional marina environment. Whether you need a spot for a performance boat or a large cruiser, our Tahoe Keys dry storage facility offers the space and security required for the premier Lake Tahoe boating lifestyle. Tahoe Paradise Park News Click For Agenda & Board Packet Tahoe Paradise Recreation and Park District On the banks of the Upper Truckee River is one of Tahoe's little-known gems. Away from the crowds and traffic, Tahoe Paradise Park offers many outdoor activities and events. Lake Baron, the heart of the upper park area, provides great fishing spots and calm water for paddle boarding or kayaking and hosts lakefront weddings by the infamous 1000 year old Juniper Tree. Find your game at the Tennis courts or enjoy live music and events held at the Clubhouse with beach access. The lower park area, along the banks of the Upper Truckee River, holds the playground, disc golf course, and a large picnic area. Find numerous hiking and mountain biking trails throughout the park. Any of the upper or lower areas can be reserved for your wedding or event! The park is administered by the Tahoe Paradise Recreation & Park District. ChIJcaR1JCqMmYARM3vcgiLxcpM.google_text: Tahoe Paradise Park Lakeshore recreation area for swimming, fishing & BBQs, plus farmers' markets & hiking trails. Park on the Upper Truckee River offering paddle-boating and kayaking on Lake Baron, plus picnic facilities. Visitors say this park offers a beautiful and peaceful natural setting with a clean lake, perfect for various outdoor activities like walking, fishing, and paddleboarding. They also highlight the availability of pickleball courts, a frisbee golf course, and a popular farmers market. Guests mention the convenient $5 parking fee and that dogs are allowed on leash. park picnic_ground fishing_pond athletic_field wedding_venue event_venue sports_club sports_activity_location association_or_organization point_of_interest service establishment

Electra Just Dreaming Bayliner Explore San Francisco New! ← " My partner and I really enjoyed this breathtaking experience of staying on a boat, it is in a beautiful location, near the city center of Key West. We were able to go on a charter and enjoy the beauty of the sea in the Keys, as well as snorkeling in reefs and fishing. I really recommend this boat! Clair · July 2024 We had the best time at Larry & Allie's cabin and felt right at home! We also went out on their chartered boat for the afternoon and it was the highlight of our trip! Definitely check out their company The Water Traveler! So fun! Sarah · July 2024 Captain ALi and her team were absolutely amazing to work with during our wedding weekend. They were the only vendor we could find that was willing and excited to help us put on a hybrid boat and beach event on the Lake. They went out of their way to make the event fun and personalized, from the activities available to the food and drinks to the decor, and to say they exceeded our expectations would be an understatement. They were by far the easiest and most fun vendor we worked with throughout our wedding weekend and the day-of execution was flawless. We could not be more thankful to Captain ALi and her entire team for going out of their way to make it so special for us. THANK YOU! Sudhish · 2022 Hugely fun day with the family on Lake Tahoe with every kind of water toy imaginable. Captain Ali and her crew made it all a blast and even got us beginners wake surfing. A huge bonus was not having to prepare for this at all. They gathered the toys, food, alcohol, towels, everything. We just showed up and had fun. Dee · 2022 I went out to Lake Tahoe for my bachelor party and we chartered two boats with Ali and her team. 18 of us, so we were a handful. They were unbelievable and amazing! Unforgettable experience. It was so much more than I could have hoped for. They not only took care of us as advertised but went way above and beyond. Captain Ali and her team were amazing and people would be crazy to not book with them. Seriously an amazing experience and I would recommend Tahoe Lake Love to everyone I know and everyone I don't. That's how awesome they are! Brent · 2023 Taking a private charter with Captain Ali was one of the best days we've ever had and 100% was money well spent. Captain Ali was amazing and fun and went above and beyond to make our experience a great one. We got to sight-see, play with all the fun water toys, and lounge by the beach, all without having to think about food or drinks or towels or sunscreen. Ali thought of everything! We will definitely do this again. Unforgettable! Lisa · 2023 Ali and her team helped create an amazing family trip to Lake Tahoe this summer. I have stayed at many properties with great hosts, but Ali and her team stand above the rest. Great and fast communication, stocked, clean, and amazing property, captained boat charter with all the amenities, beautiful location. My family gives Ali, boat charter crew, and Tahoe Lake Love our fullest recommendation! Brett · 2022 An absolute blast! We booked the boat charter with Captain Ali and Captain Larry for a bachelorette bash. They were so kind and communicative from beginning to end! We happened to be in Tahoe when it was an unseasonably cold weekend, but they did everything they could to ensure we had the best day weather wise and moved our charter to the middle of the day so we could all be warm. They also completely outdid themselves with hosting, great food, great drinks, and even party favors! I can't recommend this charter enough. Bring your friends and get ready for the best time you can have on Lake Tahoe. Ali and Larry are the bee's knees. I would 100% book again! Kandi · 2022 Ali, her property, and boat charter absolutely made my husband's 50th birthday an incredible experience. Hands down the best vacation rental property and boat charter one stop shop! Every detail was thought of, considered, and implemented to perfection. 100% will make this experience a yearly event! Julia · 2022 We stayed at a property and booked a lake charter with them last year and it was hands down the most memorable part of our entire summer break! The home was super comfortable, clean, and in an amazing location. It was an easy walk to the dock where Captain Ali picked us up. She thinks of literally EVERYTHING to make the day as fun and easy as possible! She stocked the boat with drinks, water, delicious food, sunscreen, and several water toys to keep everyone entertained. She took us to some gorgeous local spots for swimming, and patiently blew up and deflated the raft a million times for my little one. While the day couldn't have been more perfect, I can say without a doubt that Captain Ali is the magic that makes it work. We've booked again for this summer and none of us can wait to get back out on the lake. I wouldn't even consider booking a charter with anyone else, Captain Ali and Tahoe Lake Love is where it's at! Lisa · 2022 → Why The Water Traveler Everything included , nothing left to chance The Water Traveler is a VIP-style, all-inclusive vacation brand featuring captained boat charters and private events. pages.text: Float Reno - All Inclusive River Tubing on the Truckee top of page Experience Choose Your Float Details River Reels Blog FAQ Post Pride Float and Detox Day About Book Now ↦ Welcome to Float Reno Reno's Premier Truckee River Float Experience Your Perfect River Day, Handled Book Your Float Adventure See you in Summer 2027! Bigger Adventures Coming! Float Reno is taking a pause for the 2026 season as we are developing an exciting new experience and future improvements for Reno's river adventure community. Thank you for the incredible support we look forward to welcoming you back in Summer 2027. Check out the latest float conditions ↦ The Float Reno Experience ↤ Enjoy a self-guided river adventure through the heart of Reno Float through downtown Reno with sunshine overhead, skyline views around you, and plenty of Insta-worthy moments. Right now, the Truckee River is running with faster flows and lively currents, making this a more adventurous experience compared to a typical lazy float. We've got the rest covered: the tubes, transport, and everything in between. Your float is self-guided, and river conditions can vary, so be prepared for changing currents and an active day on the water. No timetables. No car juggling. Just show up ready for an unforgettable river adventure with your crew. What's Your Float Style? Two options designed around you: ALL Inclusive We provide all the gear, shuttle transportation, and personalized support on the water. All you need to do is show up. Bring Your Own Tube We'll provide the shuttle, inflation station, and support at launch. We can rent any additional float gear you may need. Pick the experience that fits your vibe. ALL Inclusive Package $70 $55 Youth (8 to 14) General (14+) Book Now ✅ Premium River Tube ✅ Life Jacket, Helmet, River paddle, Phone Dry Bag ✅ Shuttle to River Drop-In point ✅ Float Concierge for safety briefing ✅ Private launch point access with concierge assistance ✅ Secure onsite storage for your belongings ✅ Float Reno Navigation App ✅ Exclusive Perks at Local Bars & Restaurants Add-on Essentials (available at check-in) Forgot something? We've got you covered. Pick up cold drinks, sunscreen, water shoes, hats, dry bags, and other last-minute river gear right at our Welcome Center before getting on the shuttle. Bring Your Own Tube Package $35 (Adults and Children 8+) Book Now ✅ Bring Your Own Tube - any style welcome (must deflate for shuttle) ✅ Life Jacket - included for your safety ✅ Shuttle to River Drop-In point ✅ Inflation station access (all tube types) ✅ Pre-float safety briefing ✅ Public Launch Point Access ✅ Float Reno Navigation App ✅ Exclusive Perks at Local Bars & Restaurants ✅ Optional rentals: Premium tubes, Life jackets, Helmets, Paddles, Onsite storage Add-on Essentials (available at check-in) Forgot something? We've got you covered. Pick up cold drinks, sunscreen, water shoes, hats, dry bags, and other last-minute river gear right at our Welcome Center before getting on the shuttle. ↦ Book Now ↤ The Details Start your adventure at our Welcome Center at Idlewild Park, where you'll check in and hop on our complimentary shuttle. We'll take you upriver to the Launch Center at the Tom Cooke Trailhead, where you'll grab your gear, review river tips, and get float ready. Then it's go time: ease into the Truckee for a self-guided float lasting about 2 2.5 hours through cottonwood groves, scenic bends, and downtown skyline views. Please note: river conditions can vary and may include faster flows, small waves, and stronger currents, especially in early summer. Be ready for a more active, adventurous float. Reconnect with friends as you cruise all the way back to Idlewild Park, where you'll return your gear. After your float, enjoy a picnic in the park or check out one of our partner spots for great food and drinks! Arrival and Shuttle Pickup Information: Meet at the Welcome Center at Idlewild Park at least 30 minutes before your reservation time in order to check-in and catch the shuttle. The shuttle will leave promptly at your reservation time. ​ If you miss the shuttle at our Welcome Center, you will need to transport yourself directly to the Launch Center (15 minute drive). ​​​ ↦ The Scenic Truckee River Float River Route Launch from Tom Cooke Trailhead and float 2 2.5 hours to Idlewild Park, a short walk from Reno's Riverwalk District. ➤ Welcome Center by the river at Idlewild Park ➤ Complimentary shuttle to the river drop-in location ➤ GPS guidance and points of interest in the Float Reno app ➤ End back at the Welcome Center and grab any items you left with us ➤ After your float, enjoy nearby food and drink options at the Riverwalk View Today's Truckee River Float Conditions. Please note that trips may be delayed or canceled due to weather or higher river flows. River conditions can change, and currents may be faster and more active than expected. All participants must be 8 years or older and strong swimmers, as this is a self-guided river experience. ↦ Float Reno App Your River Guide, Right in Your Pocket" RiverNav GPS Navigate the river with ease FloatCam Group Camera Capture and share moments TubeTalk Messaging Communicate with your group Partner Discounts Access exclusive deals ↦ Testimonials ↤ What Floaters Say I got to try Float Reno on a trial run and it was such a fun, adventurous experience. The whole setup felt thoughtful and professional. Reno's river scene is about to get a major upgrade. Shay M This is the kind of experience Reno has been missing! From start to finish, everything was seriously fun. Float Reno provided me with everything I needed for this adventure! Kat O I floated with a few friends as part of an early test run, and we couldn't stop talking about how cool the concept is. It's the perfect mix of adventure and chill can't wait for the official launch! Camper Shells - Custom Truck Accessories Skip to content Reno: (775) 329-5111 Carson City: (775) 885-8111 Mon–Fri 8AM–6PM | Sat 9AM–3PM Home Accessories RVs & Campers About Us Contact Home / Products / Camper Shells Camper Shells Camper Shells CTA has been Northern Nevada's top camper shell dealer since 1983. We stock the largest selection in the region. Whether you need a work cap, recreational shell, or commercial solution — we carry the best brands and install them right. Brands We Carry LEER · Snug Top · RSI SmartCap Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 What We Offer Camper Shells Options Leer Shell 100XL - Fiberglass Full-height fiberglass shells with windows, locks, and interior lighting. RSI Modular Breakout Lightweight, durable aluminum shells for work and recreation. Leer Commercial Shell - DDC Heavy-duty shells for fleet and commercial applications. Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 SnugTop SnugTop has been manufacturing truck caps in California since 1959 and they remain one of the most recognized names in the western market. Their Sport and Rebel models are among the most popular shells we sell — clean lines, solid construction, and a finish quality that holds up to Northern Nevada sun and temperature swings. SnugTop's one-piece fiberglass construction is notably stiff, which keeps the shell from flexing and creaking over time. Available in a wide range of colors with factory-match paint options. The SnugTop Super Sport is a popular step up from the standard Sport — slightly taller interior height and a more aggressive profile. Good option for truck owners who occasionally sleep in the shell or need the extra height for gear organization. RSI SmartCap RSI SmartCap is the premium option in our shell lineup and it's built for a completely different use case than a standard fiberglass cap. SmartCap's aluminum construction makes it exceptionally strong — it's designed to carry rooftop tents, solar panels, and full overland loads on the roof. The integrated side panel system uses a T-slot track that runs the full length of the interior, allowing direct attachment of DECKED drawers, lighting, shelving, and custom rigging without drilling. For serious overlanding builds, the SmartCap is in a different category from traditional fiberglass shells. RSI builds SmartCap in South Africa where the product was originally developed for the global 4x4 market, and the quality reflects that pedigree. If you're building a truck that will go to remote areas and needs to work hard, SmartCap is worth the investment. What We Carry Leer Camper Shells Leer is our flagship line and the shell we sell most. We're one of the exclusive Leer dealers in Northern Nevada, so we know the product cold and can custom-order any model in your truck's factory color. If you want a clean, well-built fiberglass cap that fits like it came from the factory, Leer is where the conversation usually starts. SnugTop Camper Shells SnugTop has been building fiberglass shells since 1960 and the craftsmanship shows. Their lineup covers everything from sleek recreational caps to purpose-built commercial options. Like Leer, we can custom order any model and handle the full installation in-house. RSI SmartCap The SmartCap is a stainless steel modular cap that's become popular with overlanders and work truck operators. Its biggest practical advantage for our customers is turnaround time: we stock units and typically have them assembled and ready to install within a day or two. If your timeline is tight or you want a cap that's ready to carry a rooftop tent right out of the gate, it's worth a close look. Go Fast Campers We're one of GFC's authorized dealer-installers in the region. Go Fast Campers makes the Platform Camper and Platform Topper, two of the most talked-about products in the overlanding world right now. If you're building a truck you want to actually live out of on the road, come in and we'll walk you through the lineup. Same-Day Installation Every shell we sell, we install. All shell installs are same-day. Come in, we'll get it on your truck before you leave. How Custom Orders Work Most fiberglass shells are custom ordered to your truck's specific bed size, cab configuration, and paint code. Lead times vary by brand and model, but we'll give you a real timeline when you come in. We also carry select shells in stock at both locations, so if you need to move quickly, call ahead and we'll let you know what's on the floor. Come In and Talk to Us Picking a shell is one of those decisions where a 20-minute conversation saves a lot of second-guessing. The differences between models, the tradeoffs between materials, what makes sense for your specific truck and how you use it: that's what we do every day. Walk-ins are welcome at both locations. Frequently Asked Questions What's the difference between a camper shell and a truck topper? Same product, different names. Camper shell, truck topper, truck cap, bed cap: all the same thing. The terminology varies by region. Can I get a shell color-matched to my truck? Yes. Leer and SnugTop both offer factory color-match. Give us your paint code and we'll order it to match. How long does installation take? All shell installs are same-day. We'll let you know a more specific timeframe when you schedule. Do you install on all makes and models? Ford, Toyota, Chevy, GMC, Ram, Nissan, and more. If there's a shell built for it, we can get it and install it. Can I add a roof rack to my shell? Yes. We work with Thule and Yakima rack systems and can spec the right setup with you when you come in. Get Started Interested in Camper Shells? Suspension Lifts - Custom Truck Accessories Skip to content Reno: (775) 329-5111 Carson City: (775) 885-8111 Mon–Fri 8AM–6PM | Sat 9AM–3PM Home Accessories RVs & Campers About Us Contact Home / Products / Suspension Lifts Suspension Lifts Suspension Lifts Get the clearance and stance you want with professionally installed suspension lifts. CTA has state-of-the-art alignment and installation equipment at both Reno and Carson City. Whether you need a leveling kit to eliminate factory rake or a full suspension system to conquer the trails, our factory-trained technicians will get the job done safely and correctly. Every lift includes a post-install alignment. Brands We Carry Rough Country · BDS · Fox · Bilstein · Old Man Emu · Icon Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 What We Offer Suspension Lifts Options Leveling Kit Eliminate factory rake and level your truck for a clean, aggressive look. Quick install with no loss of ride quality. Suspension Kits Full 2"–6" lift kits with upgraded shocks, springs, and control arms for maximum clearance and off-road performance. Get a Quote Call Reno: (775) 329-5111 Call Carson City: (775) 885-8111 Built for Northern Nevada A suspension setup that works well on a manicured trail in Southern California isn't necessarily the right choice for how Northern Nevada trucks actually get used. The terrain here ranges from high-speed desert flats east of Reno to rocky Sierra Nevada approaches to washboard forest service roads in the Pine Nut and Virginia Ranges. The speed and surface variety matters — a setup dialed for slow technical crawling will feel harsh and nervous at desert speeds, and vice versa. Most of our customers need a suspension that handles confidently at highway speed, absorbs the sustained chatter of maintained dirt roads, and still has enough articulation for the occasional technical section. That points toward quality coilovers with appropriate valving over budget monotube shocks — which is why we emphasize brands like ICON, Fox, and Bilstein over cheaper alternatives that look similar on spec sheets but behave very differently on Nevada roads. If you're building a truck specifically for desert racing or off-road performance, we build those too — but the conversation is different. Come in and tell us what you're doing with the truck. Leveling Kits A leveling kit corrects the factory rake most trucks come with from the manufacturer — the front sitting slightly lower than the rear to account for payload. If you're not carrying heavy loads regularly, that rake works against the truck's appearance and can limit the tire size you can run up front. A leveling kit typically lifts the front 1.5 to 3 inches to bring it even with the rear. It's a cleaner stance, it opens up your wheel and tire options, and on most trucks it's a relatively straightforward install. For a lot of daily drivers, a leveling kit with a good set of wheels and tires is the right answer and nothing more is needed. We do spacer-style leveling kits for customers where it makes sense, and strut-based kits where the truck and use case call for something more capable. We'll tell you the difference and what's right for your situation. Lift Kits Lift kits start where leveling kits leave off. Most of what we install falls in the 2 to 6 inch range, with the sweet spot for most customers around 3 to 4 inches — enough to run 33s or 35s comfortably, improve approach and departure angles meaningfully, and still keep the truck drivable every day without excessive wear or handling compromise. Beyond 6 inches, the build gets more involved. Larger lifts often require additional components: control arms, extended brake lines, adjustments to the front differential, and more careful attention to geometry. We do those builds too, and we'll walk you through what's actually required versus what's optional at each level. Body Lifts Body lifts raise the body of the truck off the frame using spacers, without changing the suspension geometry. They're a lower-cost way to clear larger tires without altering how the truck drives. Not right for every application, but a legitimate option in the right context. Suspension Lifts A full suspension lift modifies the truck's actual suspension components to increase ride height. Done properly it improves ground clearance, approach and departure angles, and off-road capability while maintaining or improving on-road ride quality. The quality of the components you choose matters a lot here, which is why we take brand and application seriously. Brands We Work With ICON Vehicle Dynamics ICON is our go-to for Toyota Tacoma builds and a strong choice across other platforms as well. Their coilovers and control arm kits are engineered for real-world performance, not just lift height, and they hold up well over time. Carli Suspension Carli is what we reach for on Ram builds. Their systems are specifically engineered around the Ram's front suspension geometry and designed for customers who want a truck that rides well on the highway, handles a load, and can go off-road without compromise. Rough Country Rough Country is our most commonly installed kit across a wide range of trucks and customers. It covers most popular platforms, the pricing is accessible, and for customers who want a solid lift without getting into premium pricing territory, the quality is there. ReadyLIFT ReadyLIFT makes some of the cleanest bolt-on leveling and lift kits available and is a go-to for Ram builds where a customer wants a quality result at a fair price. BDS Suspension BDS is a strong choice for Ram and full-size truck customers who want lift with more off-road intent. Their kits are designed with geometry and durability in mind. King Shocks King is the shock absorber of choice for serious off-road builds. When a customer wants the best performing suspension they can put on their truck, King shocks are usually in that conversation. Westcott Designs Westcott makes purpose-built lift and suspension kits for Toyota platforms — Tacoma, Tundra, and 4Runner specifically. A good fit for Toyota owners who want a system engineered specifically for their platform. Teraflex and Falcon Shocks Teraflex and their Falcon Shocks line are strong options for Jeep and truck builds where you want quality geometry correction alongside well-tuned damping. Hunter Alignment Rack Every suspension install we do gets a proper alignment. We run a Hunter alignment rack, which is the most precise and widely trusted alignment system in the industry. Most shops in the area are running older equipment — Hunter's current systems use imaging technology to take more measurement points faster and more accurately than traditional alignment equipment. The practical difference for you: the alignment is tighter, the printout is clear and readable so you can see exactly where your truck landed before and after, and you're not relying on equipment that was accurate when it was new. Suspension work without a proper alignment after is an unfinished job. We don't do it that way. Free Re-Torque Service After a suspension install, components settle as they go through their first heat cycles and miles. It's normal, and it's why we offer a free re-torque at around 500 miles after your install. You bring the truck back in, we check all the torque specs and make sure everything is still exactly where it should be. Most shops don't offer this. We do because it's the right way to finish the job. When you leave after a re-torque, you know the suspension is set correctly for the long term. Which Lift Is Right for Your Truck? That depends on more variables than most people expect when they first start looking. Tire size goals, daily driving versus trail use, towing or payload requirements, budget, and the specific platform all factor in. Where Life Intersects Work & Play About Soaring Ranch in Truckee / Tahoe ​ CONVENIENTLY located in one of Truckee's most vibrant and recreation-rich areas, Soaring Ranch is reimagining the best of Truckee in a neighborhood fully blended with housing, recreation, and commerce. ​ With bike path connections from the community to Martis Valley, Lake Tahoe, and the Truckee River Soaring Ranch visitors and future residents can take the bike path and pedestrian connections to access the area and beyond. ​ Enjoy vibrant shopping and dining services including Raley's grocery market, Mountain Hardware's second location, RE/MAX Gold, DLUX Window Coverings, Martis Valley Massage and more businesses at Soaring Ranch a hub of local living where everything is footsteps or pedal strokes away. Features Future Commercial & Residential Opportunities Soaring Ranch was founded on the belief that convenience and sustainability should go hand-in-hand. Having established a premier retail destination at the gateway to the Sierra in Phase 1, plans are in place for Phases 2 and 3: a multi-year expansion that integrates diverse workforce housing options with new restaurants and office spaces, all connected by the region's most accessible bike and pedestrian paths. ​ By integrating local living with recreation-rich design, Soaring Ranch is building a future where you can live, work, and play. Learn more about commercial opportunities and future workforce housing . Projects Contact 20-Minute Neighborhood Following the innovative planning principles of a 20-Minute Neighborhood where work, life and play all come together, Soaring Ranch is an answer to Truckee's housing, community character, sustainability and local business needs. Soaring Ranch opens up the endless possibilities that exist when housing is integrated with daily life the chance meetings of neighbors in the aisles of the market, on the bike path, or on the way to and from work. Or the ability to leave the car behind for days on end and still explore all that Truckee and North Tahoe have to offer. LOCATION Soaring Ranch is Located in Truckee, CA on the corner of Highway 267 & Soaring Way. ​ JOIN THE MAILING LIST Stores & Restaurants ​ News ​ Housing ​ ​ Contact ​ Terms & Conditions ​ Accessibility ​ Privacy Policy bottom of page

COMMERCIAL LEASING Phase 2: Expanding the Vision Building on the proven success of Phase 1, which is now 100% stabilized with long-term leases, Phase 2 offers a premier opportunity to join a thriving, established business community. ​ While Phase 1 set the standard for commercial viability on-site, Phase 2 expands this vision by introducing two new buildings featuring a strategic, horizontally mixed-use design. By positioning prime commercial spaces directly on Soaring Way and tucking residential units behind, the project maximizes visibility for tenants while protecting the privacy of the residential areas. ​ ​ CONTACT US Phase 2 Commercial Space Phase Two will include 22,000 square feet of premier, all-ground-floor commercial space, strategically designed for maximum visibility and ease of access. This expansive footprint will house new restaurants and retail businesses such as a pet store, pharmacy, and coffee shop curated to enhance residents' quality of life. Positioned as a distinct destination separate from the residential units, this project aims to fulfill a significantly underserved demand for high-traffic retail, office, F&B, and residential space on the east side of Truckee. Phase 2 Workforce Housing: Supporting Commercial Businesses The integration of Phase 2 and Phase 3 workforce housing at Soaring Ranch creates a captive and consistent market for our commercial partners. By adding over 200 residential units to the site, we are establishing a built-in neighborhood of high-frequency consumers who value the convenience of shopping and dining just steps from their front door. The housing units also helps stabilize the local labor market, making it easier for businesses to recruit and retain staff who live within the community. Learn more about Soaring Ranch's local housing here. ​ ​ About A Diverse Population Base Avg. Income: $180,000+ Avg. Home Price: $1,000,000+ ​ Truckee's area population has more than quintupled over the course of 25 years. About Truckee Approximately 4,000 professionals commute daily to Truckee year round. Seasonal jobs account for an additional 2,000 daily. ​ Truckee's base population is approximately 38,000 and it swells to over 80,000 during the peak summer and winter seasons. Location Soaring Ranch is the 1st shopping center built in over 25 years in Truckee and is the only shopping center located east of Downtown Truckee. ​ Over 1,000 hotel rooms are within a 10 minute drive. ​ Lake Tahoe enjoys over 24 million guest visits per year. We’re on a mission to cultivate a love of ice sports here in the high desert and ensure they are accessible to all. Meet Our Team A Community Ice Arena As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, we exist to serve the people of the greater Reno area and provide a space for everyone to share the ice. Whether you’re a hockey player, figure skater, spectator, or trying ice skating for the first time, there’s a place for you in our growing community! About Us Ice Activities For Everyone Reno Ice is committed to helping every person participate in ice recreation, including kids, older folks, and people with disabilities. We proudly offer Learn to Skate for all ages, adaptive sled hockey, a financial aid program for young skaters, and more! Scholarships A Place to Learn & Grow More than just an ice rink, Reno Ice is a vibrant community hub where skaters of all backgrounds develop their skills and find encouragement from our team and expert coaches. Click below to find a session and discover your potential on the ice! Find an Event We’d love to host your next group event! Rent the Ice Community Reviews “Great facility and wonderful staff! The coaches are super supportive and always have a great plan set up for each session for the different age groups. I could not be happier with the culture of this establishment and would highly recommend taking your children here or coming yourself.” - Ryan A. “Amazing facility. Clean, organized, great staff and coaches and they have the best hockey program and skating for all ages.” - Shannon L. “Best sports community in Reno. My daughter said she wanted to do hockey 5 years ago and since then the community at Reno Ice has wrapped their arms around her and taken her in. Reno Ice has been a blessing for my daughter.” - Mica R. “I'm such a fan of Reno Ice. They have truly brought this community together. They have something for everyone in the family, even if you just want to sit and watch. It's great knowing that all of my friends with kids, have kids enrolled in either Hockey, figure skating, skating clinics, handicapped skating. This place has it all. The staff are all amazing. HUGE FAN!” - - Michelle H. Looking for information/tickets for the Reno Ice Raiders or Nevada Hockey? Reno Ice is the proud home rink of both the Reno Ice Raiders and Nevada Men’s Ice Hockey (the UNR club team.) Reno Ice is the perfect place to host birthdays, school outings, corporate gatherings, and private parties. Our team will help you create a memorable experience that’s easy to plan and exciting for everyone in your group! 🥳 Plan Your Gathering at Reno Ice Let’s get your special event on the calendar! From ice time to tables for refreshments, we’ll work with you on a package that’s right for your group. Reno Ice is a great venue for Birthday parties Company events Community groups Camps Clinics and more! Email Mallory at mallory@renoice.com to discuss availability and rates, or use the form below to get started with your booking. Rental Packages Locker Room Rental - $125 With this package, you’ll have access to a private locker room 30 minutes before and after any scheduled Public Skate (which can range from one hour to two hours). This room rate does not include standard admission for Public Skates ($12 per person, $6 for children under 4), rental skates ($5 per pair), and skate aids ($5 each with a maximum of 20). Tables and chairs are provided in the locker room. This is an excellent choice for smaller parties that do not need to rent out the whole ice. Ice Rentals - $435/hour Reserve the entire ice for your party! This all-inclusive rate covers your admission, all skate rentals, and skate aids if you need them (with a maximum of 20). You can choose the music, and we’ll put on special lighting or disco effects if you so choose. Tables and chairs will also be provided to you to hold snacks, gifts, etc. If you have a large party and/or want to have the ice to yourselves, you’ll want to reserve an entire ice rental. Please see below for our private rental booking policy. Private Event Booking Policy Private rentals booked more than a month in advance require a deposit of 25% of the total booking fee. We will not place your event on our schedule until the deposit has been paid. The rental fee must be paid in full one month prior to your event. For last-minute bookings/events arranged less than a month in advance, the full rental fee must be paid in full when booking . Failure to pay the full amount may result in losing your timeslot. Questions? Email mallory@renoice.com. Reno Ice, The Jennifer M. Skate Sharpening and Repairs at Reno Ice Sharpening - $12 We offer skate sharpening on our Blackstone machine. Our experienced sharpeners will get your skates to the exact edge you need to perform at your best. Please note: We charge $15 for a rush order (skates needed the next day that are dropped off after 5pm.) Rockering - $40 Also called “profiling” or “contouring,” rockering is the process of creating a custom curvature on your blade, and can help with maneuverability or performance. Please come by the front desk to chat with us about getting your skates rockered! Repairs - Custom Need a repair on your figure or hockey skate? We may be able to help. Contact mallory@renoice.com to inquire. If we are not able to repair your skate, we may be able to provide a recommendation for where to access the right service. To get skates sharpened or rockered, please drop them off at the front desk. A staff member will take your name, contact information, preferred edge (see below), and the date you need them by. You can pay when you drop them off or at the time of pick up. Note: We ask that you take your skate guards/soakers off prior to leaving your skates. If you have questions about our sharpening, repair, or rockering services, please send an email to mallory@renoice.com. Thank you! Reno Ice, The Jennifer M. Choosing how to explore Lake Tahoe often comes down to one big question: Should you rent a boat or book a captained boat charter ? While both options get you out on the water, the experience can be completely different—especially on a lake known for sudden winds, strict boating rules, and some of the most unique navigation challenges in the country. This guide breaks down the real differences between boat rentals and charters , including safety, cost, alcohol rules, and overall enjoyment, so you can choose the option that gives you the best possible day on Lake Tahoe. Spoiler: for most visitors, a captained charter delivers a far more relaxing, safer, and more memorable experience. Boat Rental vs. Boat Charter: Quick Comparison Feature Boat Rental Captained Charter Captain Included ❌ No ✅ Yes (USCG licensed) Safety + Local Knowledge Dependent on renter Always included Fuel Costs Often extra Usually included Liability Higher (you drive) Minimal (captain responsible) Experience Split between driving and relaxing 100% relaxing and sightseeing Navigation Must handle docking, weather, and local rules Captain handles everything Alcohol Policy ❌ Operator cannot drink ✅ Passengers may drink with a captain Ideal For Experienced boaters Families, friends, groups, stress-free adventures When a Boat Rental Makes Sense A rental might be the right fit if you check most of these boxes: You have strong boating experience and enjoy driving You’re familiar with Lake Tahoe’s rules, winds, and navigation You want full control of the boat and itinerary You only need the boat for a short outing You’re comfortable handling docking, anchoring, and safety You don’t mind fuel charges, deposits, or added responsibilities When a Boat Charter Is the Better Choice A quick checklist to know if a captained charter is the better fit: You want a stress-free, fully guided experience You prefer to relax, take photos, and enjoy the scenery You want to drink alcohol without worrying about operating a boat You’re visiting Lake Tahoe for the first time You want to explore Emerald Bay and other top landmarks safely You have kids, a large group, or a special celebration You want a smoother ride with expert navigation in changing weather You want the best chance at an unforgettable, worry-free day on the lake Frequently Asked Questions About Boat Rentals vs. Charters in Lake Tahoe 1. What’s the main difference between a boat rental and a captained boat charter? A rental means you drive the boat yourself, while a captained charter includes a licensed captain who handles all navigation, safety, and lake knowledge so you can fully relax. 2. Are captained charters safer than renting a boat? Yes. Charters are operated by USCG-licensed captains who understand Tahoe’s winds, hazards, and boating rules—significantly reducing risk for passengers. 3. Which option offers a better overall experience? Most visitors prefer charters because everyone gets to relax, take photos, enjoy the scenery, and skip the stress of driving, docking, and monitoring lake conditions. 4. Is it cheaper to rent a boat than book a charter? Sometimes upfront—but rentals often add fuel charges, deposits, damage fees, and lost time learning the lake. Charters are typically the better value when considering the full experience. 5. Can I drink alcohol on a boat rental or charter? You cannot drink if you are operating a rental boat. Passengers can drink on a captained charter since the captain is the designated operator. 6. Can both rentals and charters go to Emerald Bay? Technically yes; however, charters are better equipped to navigate the channel, other boats, and no-wake areas—and they can share the history and stories that make Emerald Bay special. 7. Do I need boating experience to rent a boat on Lake Tahoe? Yes—renters are responsible for navigating strict no-wake zones, buoys, wind shifts, and docking. First-time or inexperienced boaters often struggle. 8. Which option saves more time on the water? Charters. You step onboard and go, while rentals require paperwork, instructions, fuel stops, and time learning the lake. 9. Which is better for families or larger groups? Charters are ideal—parents can relax, kids stay safer, and a captain ensures smooth conditions, easier routes, and local guidance. 10. Why are charters recommended for visitors new to Lake Tahoe? Tahoe’s deep water, sudden winds, and complex rules make self-driving challenging. Charters provide local expertise and a far more enjoyable, stress-free day. Lake Tahoe Boat Tour Questions and Answers 1. How many people can ride on a power boat or pontoon tour? Our tours accommodate groups up to 13 people (depending on boat), making them ideal for families, friends, and small group outings. 2. Do I need a boating license to ride on your charter? No. All tours are fully captained by a licensed professional who handles navigation, safety, and boat operation. 3. What tour durations do you offer? We offer day trips ranging from 2 to 6 hours, along with a 2-hour sunset tour. Custom durations may be available depending on the schedule. 4. What should I bring (or not bring) on the boat? We recommend swimsuits, towels, sunscreen, water, hats, sunglasses, and weather-appropriate layers. You’re welcome to bring drinks and snacks, but please avoid glass containers for safety and to protect the lake. 5. Are tours flexible? Can we change the route or stops? Yes. While we provide popular recommended stops like Emerald Bay, Vikingsholm, Rubicon Bay, and hidden coves, your captain can adjust the itinerary based on your preferences, available time, and weather conditions. 6. Is alcohol allowed onboard? Yes, alcohol is allowed. We simply ask that you avoid glass containers and skip red wine, since it can stain if spilled. 7. Can we swim or stop for water activities during the tour? Yes, we can stop for swimming or relaxing in calm, protected areas when weather conditions and time allow. 8. What happens if weather or wind makes boating unsafe? Safety comes first. If lake conditions become unsafe, your captain may adjust the route or reschedule your tour. When possible, alternate times or refunds will be offered if a trip must be canceled. Have additional questions? Check out our FAQ for even more info. Enjoy The Best Lake Tahoe Jet Ski Experience Crystal clear waters, sandy beaches, iconic granite boulders, towering pine trees and snow capped mountains. Welcome to Lake Tahoe, the most stunning alpine lake in the United States all year round. Many people know Lake Tahoe due to its amazing world famous ski resorts and snow quality during the winter season, however, summers in Lake Tahoe are even better! The basin offers a wide range of outdoor activities to enjoy during the summer months. Hike to one of the many peaks to have views that will take your break away, bike along the Truckee river and enjoy the views or the local fauna, rent a boat, take a mountain bike trail or enjoy the day off-roading in the Rubicon, camp in one of the many astonishing campsites all along the lake shore There are many things to do in the lake but nothing is more fun to do than exploring on a jet ski Lake Tahoe . There are many other jet ski, boat and kayak rentals all over the lake that sure are fun and a great time to enjoy with friends and family but... WITH OUR JET SKI RENTALS LAKE TAHOE WE STRIVE TO PROVIDE YOU WITH A UNIQUE AND DIFFERENT RENTAL EXPERIENCE TO MAKE THE MOST OUT OF THE LAKE AND YOUR VACATION. We are locals that have been enjoying the lake for all our lives and we've been putting this together for many many years. We are not going to try to take you on a slow and boring private guided tour, instead, we know your guys like to go fast, listen to good music and not be controlled by a guide. That's why we have carefully put together a list of the most iconic spots to see, drive around and overall have the best possible experience without missing anything and all at your own pace!! KEEP TAHOE BLUE CALL US NOW TO BOOK YOUR UNIQUE JET SKI EXPERIENCE !! Button Button Button Button Tahoe Jet Ski Rentals Frequently Asked Questions Can I bring my phone with me? All Jet Skis have a waterproof compartment where you can store your valuables. Also, we provide a waterproof bag with a cord so you can take pictures safely. However we are not responsible for any personal item lost in the lake or anything water damaged. What is the temperature of Lake Tahoe? Temperature changes depending on what area of the lake you are, however, from mid June to the end of August, you can expect temperatures ranging from 62 to 70 degrees. What is our cancellation policy? We require 72 hours before the date your reservation is scheduled for a cancellation with a full refund. When is your peak season? The busiest season is from mid-June to mid-September. We are usually a little less busy through May and early June, and again, late September and October. However, if online says we are fully booked, give us a call and let us know what dates are you looking for and we might be able to make it work for you! What if it's bad weather on the date of our reservation? If we are unable to operate due to weather conditions, you will not be obligated to your reservation and you can either have it rescheduled for a different date or get a full refund. We will work with you to get the best solution possible ALWAYS. How early should I show up for my reservation? We recommend you to show at least 30-45 minutes before your reservation. Can I rent a Jet Ski without previous experience? Our jet ski rentals lake tahoe can be operated without any previous experience. All we ask from you is to take these activities with the same respect as when you drive your car. Our jet skis can go really fast and it can be dangerous to you or other people in the lake if operated carelessly. How old do you have to be to operate a jet ski? You have to be at least 16 with a valid driver's license to operate a Jet Ski with Jet Ski Rentals Lake Tahoe. Any operator under the age of 18 can only have a rider who is over the age of 18. A minor can not be responsible for another minor. Can you deliver the jet skis to our vacation rental? If you have a dock in your rental property and you rent for at least 1 day, our Luxury Jet Ski rental service offers delivery and also a full set up of anything you need to have the best experience. FEEL TAHOE Is It Safe To Take A Swim In Lake Tahoe? Swimming in the pristine turquoise waters of Lake Tahoe is totally safe - with one big caveat (and no buddy, we don't mean Tahoe Tessie ): The water in Tahoe is cold, particularly the further you get from shore where the water is deep. Remember all the snow-capped mountains and all the things we talked about the world famous ski resorts ? Well, Tahoe is a high elevation alpine lake and snowmelt is the main source of water of our beloved lake. That said, during the summer months, the weather is nice and warm so a dip in the lake is always refreshing. Close to shore, where the water is more shallow and the sun is able to warm the water, you can swim comfortably. Is not the Mediterranean sea but definitely even those with fear of cold waters could enjoy a good relaxing swim If you are taking the jet ski Lake Tahoe out, one person always has to be in the jet ski. We understand that sometimes doing hard turns and playing around you can fall from the watercraft, make sure you always keep your life vest on and swim back to the jet ski right away. On waters as cold as the deep lake areas if you stay in for long periods of time swimming can be difficult due to cramping and it can get dangerous so, be safe, enjoy your swims but don't ever abandon your watercraft and let it get away from you " My husband and I rented one of the luxury jet skis for a week. They delivered the jet ski to our house and dock it in our private doc, provided us with all we needed and kept in touch throughout the week to be sure we didn't have any issues. Mike and Lucas were awesome, we definitely will be renting from them again every time we go back up there." Andrea McKeown New York "Probably the coolest jet skis we've ever rented. Mike took his time to show us where the best spots to go see and were and their vibe is incredible. They let us do our thing and when we came back they give us a fresh green coconut!! They are pretty busy so make sure you book ahead of time and if there is no availability, give them a call, they make it work for us even though our very short notice so good luck!!" Ashley Williams Houston "The Jet Skis come with a GoPro hood in the from and a speaker holder!!! We got the coolest videos ever... renting a Jet ski in Lake Tahoe was probably the funniest thing ever and Lucas definitely helped to make this a memorable experience. On our next year family trip we will be calling you guys 100%" Madelaine Roche Paris We are one big family.... pages.text: Reno Tennis Center: Courts & Facilities - Tennis Nation Skip to primary navigation Skip to main content Skip to footer Tennis Nation Be Relentless Pickleball Pickleball Lessons in Reno Pickleball Classes & Clinics in Reno Pickleball Leagues in Reno Pickleball Open Play Junior Pickleball Adult Pickleball Pathway Pickleball Camps Indoor Pickleball in Reno (Guide) Tennis Tennis Lessons in Reno Tennis Classes & Clinics Tennis Leagues & Teams Junior Tennis Pathway Adult Tennis Programs Tennis Camps Play & Compete Ladders & Match Play in Reno Tournaments & Events Reno Tennis Center Pickleball Courts in Reno Tennis Courts in Reno Memberships & Benefits CourtReserve Booking Help Private & Group Rentals Sponsorships Resources Free Lessons WhatsApp Communities (Tennis & Pickleball) Shop Tennis Racquets Pickleball Paddles Demo Program Racquet Stringing Contact & FAQs Reno Tennis Center — Reno’s Public Racquet Sports Facility The Reno Tennis Center is the heart of racquet sports in Reno, Nevada — a community-focused, city-accessible facility where players of all ages and abilities come together to play, learn, compete, and connect through tennis and pickleball. Operated by Tennis Nation Racquet Sports in partnership with the City of Reno, this is a true civic facility built for everyday players, families, newcomers, and lifelong athletes. Facility Overview Located at 2601 Plumas Street beside the Washoe County Golf Course, the Reno Tennis Center offers year-round outdoor play across one of Northern Nevada’s largest racquet sports footprints. This is not a private club—it’s a public, welcoming destination designed for access, consistency, and community. 10 Tennis Courts (6 lighted for evening play) 24 Pickleball Courts (12 lighted for night sessions) Large Hitting Wall for solo practice and warm-ups 3 Playmate Tennis Ball Machines (free for members) 2 Lobster Pickleball Machines (free for members) On-court player seating and spectator seating throughout the facility Front desk services for check-in, reservations, and information Online booking and scheduling through CourtReserve Full-Service Onsite Pro Shop with racquet sports essentials The Reno Tennis Center is designed to remove friction from play. Players can arrive without gear and still be fully equipped. The onsite pro shop offers racquets, paddles, balls, shoes, apparel, grips, drinks, snacks, and professional stringing services—so everything you need is in one place. New players are also welcome to try the sport before investing in equipment. The Reno Tennis Center offers loaner and demo tennis racquets and pickleball paddles, so you can step on court even if you don’t yet own gear. It’s one more way the facility keeps racquet sports accessible, welcoming, and easy to begin. The layout is intentionally open and social. You’ll see beginners learning the game, competitive players drilling, families sharing courts, and friends meeting for casual play—all in the same space. Explore: Tennis Courts at Reno Tennis Center Tennis Court Availability & Booking Tennis Programs & Instruction Whether you’re returning to the sport or stepping on court for the first time, this is Reno’s home base for tennis. Pickleball Pickleball is thriving in Reno, and the Reno Tennis Center is its primary public hub. With 24 dedicated courts and daily activity from morning through evening, players can find open play, social sessions, and structured opportunities in one place. Explore: Pickleball Courts at Reno Tennis Center Open Play Pickleball Options Pickleball Programs & Pathways The scale of the facility allows beginners, social players, and competitive athletes to coexist without friction—each group has space to play the way they want. pages.text: Tahoe Fly Fishing - Home 0 Skip to Content Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Lake Tahoe’s Fly Shop & Guide Service Book a Guide Welcome to Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters! Located on the south shore of Lake Tahoe offering the most complete fly fishing outfitter and shop for all things fly fishing in the Sierra. Private Water: Guided Fly Fishing Adventures to East Peak Lake Stay close to Stateline and get all the adventure! An epic trip for families and small groups on East Peak Lake at Heavenly Mountain Resort. Take the Scenic Gondola and an off-road trail ride in a UTV with your group up to private East Peak Lake . This 3-hour excursion includes an introduction to casting and guided fly fishing, the gondola ride, and an off-road trail ride. Learn More Off-Road Adventure Guided Fly Fishing Packages Jump in one of our 4-Seater UTV Off-Road side-by-sides and buckle up for a fly fishing experience like no other. We’ll take you to remote sections of water with fewer footprints and fish that don’t get to see a lot of flies. Our remote locations offer unparalleled beauty with outstanding fishing. Learn More Private Water: Fly Fishing Adventures on Sawmill Lake! Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters offers exclusive access to the picturesque Sawmill Lake located in North Lake Tahoe on the Northstar Resort. The 10-acre lake offers anglers of all abilities the shot at trophy rainbow or brown trout on the fly. Sight cast dry flies at cruising fish or strip streamers deep and enjoy the view! Learn More Guided Fly Fishing The Tahoe area offers an abundance of opportunity to chase trout and other species on the fly. Book your fly fishing adventure today! Rivers: Truckee River, Little Truckee, East Carson, West Carson, East Walker, West Walker, and more. Lakes: Sawmill Lake, Caples Lake, Red Lake, Blue Lakes, Silver Lake, Boca Reservoir, Stampede, and more. Learn More Fly shop with all the gear Whether you’re just getting started or building your arsenal, our fly shop has everything needed to get you on the water and keep you there. Premium products from Simms Fishing, Howler Brothers, Scott Fly Rods, Ross, Galvan, Fishpond, and more. Just getting started, or building an arsenal, our staff is here to help. We also offer a full complement of fly tying materials to customize your ‘secret weapon’ and add your own style to your bugs. Check out our online store for TFFO swag and gear! Shop Gear Classes and Clinics We offer courses for all anglers at every skill level designed to be engaging and make you a better angler. Group clinics bring people together around the love of fly fishing. TFFO creates a social atmosphere by partnering with local vendors and accommodations to deliver a fun and educational experience in small group settings. Upcoming Clinics A better fly fishing adventure with Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters Book a Trip Lake Tahoe’s #1 Guide Outfitter. Learn from the best. Guided Trips and Services Tahoe Fly Fishing 0 Skip to Content Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Open Menu Close Menu Home Services Classes Travel Shop Report Book a Guide Guided Fly Fishing Adventures The pro staff at Tahoe Fly Fishing Outfitters has the experience and knowledge to put you on fish and help you grow your knowledge and skill set. We specialize in ‘catch & release’ fly fishing for both walk & wade and lake fishing. Strip streamers to large aggressive trout, nymph to holding fish, or target them with a well placed dry fly. Our guides will make sure to provide lasting memories, big smiles and the shot at a fish of a lifetime. 1/2 - Day Trip $450 ½ Day trips are 4 hours of on the water time. This does not include drive time to and from the river. A half day trip usually runs 6 hours of total time. Book a Trip 3/4 - Day Trip $550 ¾ Day trips are 6 hours of on the water time. This does not included drive time to and from the river. A ¾ day trip usually runs 8 hours total time. Boook a Trip Full - Day Trip $650 Full day trips are 8 hours of on the water time. This does not include drive time to and from the river. A full day trip usually runs 10 hours of total time. Book a Trip Off-Road Guided Fishing for 2: $1100 6 Hours of on water walk & wade guided fly fishing. This does not include drive time to and from the river. Complete trip time can range from 8 - 10 hours. Book a Trip Off-Road Guided Fishing for 3: $1300 6 Hours of on water walk & wade guided fly fishing. This does not include drive time to and from the river. Complete trip time can range from 8 - 10 hours. Book a Trip Off-Road Guided Fishing up to 9 anglers We offer an off-road trips for up to 9 anglers. No experience needed and an exciting private trip for your group with all the gear included. Book a Trip PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake - Rod Fees Half and Full Day rod fees will give up to 4 anglers access to the private 10-acre Lake located on the Northstar Resort. Loaded with Rainbows and some big browns, this is an awesome private experience. Contact Us PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake - Guided Trips Get out on Sawmill Lake with a guide and learn the skills to chase big and fight big lake rainbows and brown trout. This is a great opportunity to take in the beauty of the Sierra on your own private lake. Contact Us PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake Float Tube Trip for 2 It’s more than just a guided trip on a private lake. This 2 Angler guided trip uses comfy float tubes for a leisurely kick around the lake. Fishing from a tube gives you a better shot at big rainbows lurking in the deep. Contact Us Spring Shad Float Trip Super fun float on the American River to chase sea run shad with a fly rod. This is a good one if you want shots at aggressive, hard-pulling fish. Learn More PRIVATE WATER: Sawmill Lake A private 10-acre lake on the Northstar Resort property holding trophy rainbow trout. Walk the banks for cruising fish or cast from float tubes in this incredible setting. Learn More Nor Cal Advanced Angler's Fish Camp: May 28 - 31, 2026 A private fish camp minutes from the McCloud River featuring outfitter tent accommodations set amongst the Aspens, Cedars, and Pines of Squaw Valley in McCloud, CA. Learn More PRIVATE WATER: Heavenly Mountain Resort Join us on a private lake in South Lake Tahoe on the Heavenly Mountain Resort. Take the scenic gondola up the mountain to our private East Peak Lake. Learn More Stillwater Ice Out Clinic Spring brings warmer temps and melting ice. The fish are hungry and ready to bulk back up. Limited spots available for the first shots at big lake fish. Learn More Clinics & Classes Casting Clinic, Fly Tying, Entomology, Advanced Techniques, and more. We have classes for all skill levels. Check out our courses and elevate your skills! View Courses Truckee/Carson River Float A drift on an Eastern Sierra River is an angler’s treat and affords different opportunities on the river. Contact us to learn about our float trips. Learn More Large Group/Team Building We can host large group fly fishing adventures. Looking for a private setting, or wanting to get your group out on the river? Let us create a trip for you. Contact Us Guide Pro Staff Jarrod Beer, GUIDE Jarrod has fished the Sierras his entire life and 20 years of guiding has given him incomparable tools for sharing knowledge and his passion for fly fishing. Alyssa Evart, GUIDE No river too far and with a quiver of tricks she has made a name for herself with a fly rod. Whether chasing backcountry goldens or Steelhead on the coast she is happy in the water. Taylor Norton, GUIDE Taylor grew up fishing Long Island Sound, He moved west and honed his skills on western trout running pack trips in the Rockies. His passion for teaching makes for a a memorable trip for his clients. Jason Shaw, GUIDE A true outdoorsman who spends a lot of time on the water and sure to create a memorable day for his guests on his home waters Chad Fuller, GUIDE Chad has carried a fly rod all over the western seaboard from baja to Alaska and hunts the flats for saltwater big game every chance he gets. Guests are sure to enjoy the knowledge and good times that come with a day on the water. Drew Johnston, GUIDE & GEAR GURU “Yo!” Drew is a good time on the water with strong knowledge of Tahoe’s surrounding steams and stillwaters. For float tube and walk & wade trips Drew has the map and ties the bugs to find big fish. Jasper Donley, GUIDE A 4-Season mountain native with great knowledge of stillwater and rivers around the Sierra. You’ll find him on the water or on the slopes 8 days a week. Drew Litzinger, GUIDE “Litz” has the fishing bug like few other when it comes to Sierra trout. He’s comfortable in a float tube in the high alpine, in a drift boat, or walking a river. A great teacher for all and feel safe with his fire fighting, EMT background. John Brassfield, OWNER & GUIDE DIRECTOR John has spent the last 15 years hunting for fabled fish. The big fish of the McCloud are where this passion started. Now more than ever he finds his heart’s desires on the flats chasing permit. Jacob Smith, GUIDE & SHOP TEAM Jacob might love trout fishing more than any of us. His pursuit and passion is on full display whether around the counter at the shop or riverside with his clients. Mike Patten, BASS GUIDE Our dedicated bass guide who knows the ins and outs of float and fly, striper fishing, and conventional bass fishing. He even comes with a boat! Bob Caron, GUIDE Bobby has a good time on the water and has a great way of becoming fast friends with whoever he fishes with. Whether on an off-road trip, hosted travel or around camp, Bob has you entertained. Cancellation Policy for all guided and unguided services. Cancellations made 7 days or more in advance of scheduled trip will receive a 100% refund. Cancellations made within 7-3 days prior to your scheduled trip will be charged 50% of guide rates or services. Cancellations made within 72 hours of the scheduled trip will not receive a refund or transfer and will be charged full guides rates. pages.text: Tahoe Swell Seekers | Enjoy Lake Tahoe Water Sports Today 0 Skip to Content About Gallery Contact FAQ Book now Open Menu Close Menu About Gallery Contact FAQ Book now Open Menu Close Menu About Gallery Contact FAQ Book now LAKE TAHOE watersports charters wakesurfing &wakeboarding lessons captain included Premium wake boat rentals BOOK NOW Tahoe Swell Seekers is a luxury boat charter company operating in lake tahoe THAT PROVIDES epic daYS OUT ON THE LAKE FOR YOU AND YOUR GROUP DOESN’T MATTER IF ITS YOUR FIRST RIDE OR YOUR BEST RIDE, we’re ALL ABOUT GREAT WAVES, GREAT VIBES, AND AN UNFORGETTABLE TIME ON THE WATER All the Watersports Wakesurfing Looking to surf on one of the best boat waves in the industry? Our MB B52 has a fully adjustable wave that caters to all skill levels. Whether you’re looking to get up on the board for the first time, surf without the rope, or looking to learn spins and tricks, we’ve got you covered. Wakeboarding Although not as popular as wakesurfing these days, we LOVE getting people strapped into some bindings and getting out behind the boat! Never done it before? No problem! Wakeboarding is a great transition from snowboarding and surfing so you can still work on those skills all summer long. Foiling Have you mastered wakesurfing and are ready to take it to the next level? We offer wake foiling for those who are very experienced with wakesurfing or who already have experience with the foil. Our foil sessions will include all the tips and techniques to get you proficient and flying effortlessly through the water. This is the closest feeling to riding powder on a board! Grab your spot the boat 23’ MB Sports B52 Alpha 4800 pounds of ballast Fully Adjustable waves 400 horsepower engine Tower board racks Bimini shade cover Exile audio surround sound 15 inch subwoofer Switch on the fly surf tabs Spacious interior Built in cooler How many people can you accomodate? We allow up to 10 guests per booking! If you have more than 10 people in your group then we can arrange to get 2 or more boats booked for your group for the day. What do we need to bring? We always recommend bringing your own towels, snacks, swimwear, and beverages. We will provide coolers, wakeboards, surfboards, tubes, wetsuits and life vests. We can also provide ice for the coolers for an additional charge. Do you allow pets? Unfortunately your furry friends paws can damage the upholstery in the boat and pet hair is always a massive pain to get out of the boat. Please leave your pets at home! Do we have to get in the water? When you book with us, we will tailor the day however you like! Watersport activities are always optional.We offer sightseeing cruises, scenic tours, and can take you wherever you want to go. What is your cancellation policy? We allow cancellation for a full refund up to 7 days before your booking. If you want to cancel within 7 days of your booking, we will refund you with a credit for the full amount you paid for a future booking with us. There will be no refunds for cancellations made within 24 hours. Frequently Asked Questions ‍ ‍ @ tahoeswellseekers LAKE TAHOE TAHOESWELLSEEKERS@GMAIL.COM (707) 294- 8757 (707) 320-8923
