pages.text: Lake Tahoe Fishing Charters | Best in Tahoe 2024 & 2025 Skip to main content Skip to footer Charters Morning Charter Afternoon Charter Full Day Charter Family Charter Rates FAQs Fishing Gallery About Blog Contact Book Book Now Contact Us Home Fishing Trips Charter Rates Fishing Tahoe FAQ Gallery About Blog Lake Tahoe's Best Fishing Charter Voted Best of Tahoe 2025 & 2024 —Mile High Fishing Charters delivers top-rated Lake Tahoe fishing trips for Mackinaw, Rainbow, and Kokanee Salmon year-round. Looking for the best sportfishing trips in Lake Tahoe? At Mile High Fishing Charters, we run both public and private fishing trips on Lake Tahoe. Our Kingfisher boats are fully outfitted with top-tier gear, and every trip is guided by locals who fish this lake year-round. Whether it’s a private charter or a shared trip, we focus on comfort, quality, and giving you a trip worth remembering. Year-Round Fishing for All Ages We fish Lake Tahoe year-round for Mackinaw (Lake Trout), Rainbow Trout, Brown Trout, and Kokanee Salmon. These trips are well-suited for families, beginners, and experienced anglers alike. All ages are welcome. We run small-group charters by default—nothing oversized or impersonal. You’ll fish with guides who know the lake and care about doing it right. Good gear, solid boats, and local knowledge. What Our Guests Say Real reviews from real anglers—straight from Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor, and social media. See why so many guests recommend us. “I had an incredible time on the lake with my boys thanks to Mile High. Our guide, Justin, was laid-back, knowledgeable, and had us catching fish almost immediately. Fishing with a 7-year-old isn’t always easy, but Justin was patient, friendly, and made the experience enjoyable for all of us. No reason to book with anyone else.” Clark Good - Google Reviewer “My dad and son went out with Captain Justin this weekend and had a great time. He was friendly, easy to talk to, and clearly knew his stuff. They hit their limit, and Justin cleaned the fish and even gave solid cooking tips. We had an amazing dinner that night thanks to him. Great service, great attitude—highly recommend fishing with these guys.” Sean F - Yelp Reviewer “We went out Sunday morning with Captain Justin and had a blast. My 5-year-old caught a fish within 10 minutes, and everyone in our group landed at least one. Even my mom—who doesn’t fish—had fun and caught two. No experience needed. Justin suggested we take our catch to Macduff’s for lunch, which was perfect. We’ll definitely book with Mile High again.” Megan H - TripAdvisor Reviewer Fishing Trips We Offer We run morning, afternoon, and full-day fishing trips from Tahoe Keys Marina, targeting Mackinaw, Rainbows, Browns, and Kokanee. Public and private charters available year-round for all ages. Booking Policy – Mile High Fishing Charters Skip to main content Skip to footer Charters Morning Charter Afternoon Charter Full Day Charter Family Charter Rates FAQs Fishing Gallery About Blog Contact Book Book Now Contact Us Home Fishing Trips Charter Rates Fishing Tahoe FAQ Gallery About Booking & Cancellation Policy Everything you need to know before confirming your trip. Booking Terms Minimum Group Size All charters require a 4-person minimum to operate. Your trip is not confirmed until this minimum is met or you’ve booked it as a private charter. Booking Under 4 People If you book for fewer than 4 on a public trip, we’ll try to match you with another group. If not possible, we’ll help refer you to a partner company. Private Charters Private trips are confirmed instantly, regardless of group size. Confirmation Required Please call us 1–2 days before your trip to verify that the trip is confirmed: (530) 541-5312 Payment Information Our site may contain links to third-party websites. These are provided for convenience only. We are not responsible for the content or practices of any external sites. Balance due is listed with your reservation Cash is preferred to avoid card processing fees 3% fee applies to credit/debit card payments Cancellation Policy Cancel 14+ days before trip → No charge Cancel within 14 days → 50% charge Cancel within 48 hours → 100% charge No-call, no-show → Charged 100% (no exceptions) Weather Cancellations The captain may cancel or reschedule based on weather or lake conditions. In this case, you’ll be offered a full refund or option to reschedule. Case-by-Case Flexibility We understand that life happens. For those craving a taste of the wild, our walk-and-wade trips immerse you in the heart of the Truckee's rugged beauty, where each step brings you closer to that elusive trophy fish. Or take your angling experience to the next level with our float trips aboard our drift boat, where you'll navigate otherwise unaccessible sections of the Truckee River. So pack your camera, practice your grin, and join us for a journey you'll never forget, where every cast holds the promise of landing the fish of a lifetime. Half day trips are 4 hours, and full day trips are 6 continuous hours. View full details Notoriously difficult, but We make it easy. The Truckee River is famous for it's giant fish, and insanely challenging and technical fishing. We consistently put clients on the fish of their lifetime, and pass other anglers breaking their rods in frustration. Save your rods, and book a trip. Book Now See if you can hit the The Truckee Slam Gilligan is famous for putting clients on behemoth brown trout, but it's not uncommon to hit the Truckee Slam: Brown, Rainbow, Cutthroat and Whitefish. All of which can easily top 20" and send you into your backing faster than the most brazen bonefish. 35 Years of Truckee Mastery Your Guide Matt "Gilligan" Koles is the living legend of the Truckee, a master guide with over 3 decades of Truckee expertise under his belt. Gilligan is not just a guide; he's a nationally recognized fly tier, and a pioneer of tight-line nymphing, reshaping the very landscape of fly fishing on these storied waters. As the most sought-after guide in the area, Gill's passion for the river is matched only by his unwavering dedication to ensuring every angler who wades alongside him or steps aboard his boat leaves with memories that will last a lifetime. Rest assured, with Gill at the helm, your fishing dreams are not just within reach -- they're practically guaranteed. Fish with Gill Experience the Majesty Big river, bigger fish Flowing 106 miles from Lake Tahoe to Pyramid Lake, the Truckee is truly the playground of giants. It's meandering path flows through the rugged beauty of the Sierra's, the casino chaos of downtown Reno, and the sage-filled high desert on it's way to Pyramid Lake. There's a lot of river to cover, and it's not easy to know where to go. We'll shorten your learning curve, and make sure you end your trip with great memories, and a notebook of wisdom. Flies are provided on all guide trips, as well as additional gear if required (waders, boots, etc.) at no cost. Waters are provided, but guests should bring any snacks and lunches. We fish aggressively and continuously, and don't stop for long lunches, which is why the full day options are around 6 hrs. Believe me, you'll be exhausted from roping fish at the end of the day! What's the Cancellation Policy Deposits for canceled guide trips will be refunded in full with a 30 day or more notice. Cancellations within 30 days will forfeit all deposit monies. If we are able to re-book the guide, we will refund the deposit or apply it to a trip at a later date. If a trip is cancelled with less than 72 hours notice, the full price of the guide trip will be charged. Our guide trips go out in all safe weather and water conditions, therefore inclement weather, water levels or undesirable fishing conditions are NOT acceptable reasons to cancel or receive a refund. Trips cancelled by the guide or mutual guide/client decision due to unsafe weather or water conditions, state or federal closures, or other uncontrollable circumstances will have the entire deposit refunded. Where will we fish? Depending on whether you book a walk&wade or a float (drift boat) trip, we will seek out whatever stretch of river that is fishing well. We are on the river almost daily, so we're intimately attuned to the conditions, flows, and hatches and will put you in the best possible position. We will communicate with guests at least 24 hours before a trip on where we will meet to maximize our success. What skill level do I need? While we specialize in putting experienced clients onto trophy fish, we do also love teaching aspiring anglers. If you are booking a walk & wade trip however, it is important that you are sure on your feet and can maneuver through the rocky and unstable terrain, and have confidence wading in moderately fast-moving water. If you are unsure of your ability to walk & wade, consider booking a float (drift boat) trip, but that will involve some whitewater/ rapids, and you may have to help portage the boat. Please don't hesitate to drop us a line. What type of fishing will we do? It will depend on what the fish are biting! In the fall and spring we tend to have more success throwing streamers, and in the warmer summer months we focus on tight-line (euro) nymphing. Gilligan was one of the first to employ tight-line techniques in the West, and is largely attributed to it's now common use on the Truckee and beyond. If you're interested in learning this radically efficient technique, he'd be happy to teach you! These Clinics will focus exclusively on European Tight Line Nymphing; also commonly referred to Czech Nymphing, Euro Nymphing, or High Sticking. The main differentiator between this nymphing style and more conventional tactics is the use of a fluorocarbon line and "sighter" instead of a traditional fly line and "bobber/indicator". Instead of being constrained by the speed of a bobber on the surface, tight line rigs dredge nymphs through targeted depths of water columns and travel exactly at the speed of the water at those depths, presenting a much more accurate meal for picky trout. Anglers have been fly fishing since the 2nd Century AD, The "Treatyse of Fysshiynge with an Angle" came out in 1496, and Walton's "Compleat Angler" was published in 1653. Welcome to this amazing new rental opportunity, we are excited to share it with you! Hoop Northern Nevada is a premier arcade basketball trailer that brings the fun right to your doorstep. We show up, open the doors, and let anyone and everyone play arcade basketball for free, for as long as you want. Simple, fun, competitive and very addicting. We envisioned a new venture in the event rental space focused on children's entertainment. Surprisingly, there was a gap—no mobile arcade trailers centered around basketball. Drawing on our entrepreneurial spirit and experience, we found the Hoop Trailer business! We knew this was something that had to be a reality in the Northern Nevada Location. Thus, Hoop Northern Nevada was born—a mobile arcade trailer designed to bring the thrill of basketball right to your doorstep. The Booking Process 1. Fill out the form First we need some info from you about your party. Dates, times, location, add-ons, etc. We’ll get in touch to verify we are available. 2. Accept the Invoice Once we verify your info we’ll send you over an official estimate for your event. This is where you can see a breakdown of the price. 3. Pay the deposit When everything is approved and looks good, we’ll ask for a 50% deposit to lock in your event on our calendar. 4. Enjoy and Play Day of the event, we’ll show up early to ensure everything is set up. A quick demo and you are ready to play the entire time. What is this Hoop Trailer? Hoop Trailer is a mobile arcade trailer that brings the excitement of arcade basketball games directly to your event location. It's perfect for birthday parties, corporate events, school functions, and more. How does This work? We deliver our custom-built mobile arcade trailer to your desired location. The trailer features four basketball games that guests can enjoy, providing a fun and interactive experience. What events can I book? You can book a Hoop Trailer for a wide range of events, including birthday parties, community gatherings, corporate events, school carnivals, and any occasion where you want to add a unique entertainment element. Do you offer licensing opportunities? Yes, we do! If you're interested in bringing a Hoop Trailer to your city, visit our licensing website to learn more about opportunities and how to get started. Do you have insurance? YES, we do! We have a $1,000,000 policy and we can also add your event/venue to our 'additionally insured' section of our policy if necessary. Ready to Bring the Fun to Your Event? Our mission at Hoop Northern Nevada is to bring smiles and laughter to every event we attend. Whether it's a birthday party, community gathering, fundraising or school event, we strive to create unforgettable moments through our custom-built mobile arcade trailers. Frequently Asked Questions about the Mobile Basketball Trailer Rental Business Hoop Northern Nevada 0 Skip to Content Pricing About Gallery FAQs Blog Licensing Book Now Open Menu Close Menu Pricing About Gallery FAQs Blog Licensing Book Now Open Menu Close Menu Pricing About Gallery FAQs Blog Licensing Book Now FAQs or Frequently Asked Questions We understand that planning an event involves a lot of details and questions. Our Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) section is designed to provide you with clear, concise answers to common queries about our services. What is the rental rate? The rental rate is $400 for 4 hours. Each additional hour is $100. Do you deliver the mobile arcade to any location? Yes, we deliver the trailer anywhere you'd like. For locations beyond a 20-mile radius, we charge $2 per mile. What is included in the basic rental package? The basic rental package includes our custom-built mobile arcade featuring four basketball games. How do I book this Hoop Trailer for my event? You can book us by visiting our website and clicking the "Book Now" button or contacting us directly via phone or email. Is there a deposit required to reserve a date? Yes, we require a 50% deposit to secure your booking. The other 50% is due within 7 days of your event. What is your cancellation policy? Our cancellation policy will be detailed in your booking confirmation. Generally, cancellations made within a certain period prior to the event may incur a surrender of your deposit. Can the mobile arcade be set up indoors? Yes, our mobile arcade can be set up both indoors and outdoors, provided there is enough space and access for the trailer. How much space is needed for the mobile arcade? The space required will depend on the venue layout. We recommend an area that can comfortably accommodate the trailer and allow for safe gameplay. The trailer is 10’ tall, 8.5’ wide and 18’ long. Do you provide staff to manage the arcade during the event? We typically arrive to your event 15 minutes early to get set up. Our staff will go over the games and the trailer with you and answer any questions you may have. Then we leave the event and come back at the end of your party. The games and trailer don’t require any supervision so we are confident everything will be just fine. What if I need additional hours beyond the initial booking? 4 hours is our minimum. Additional hours can be added for $100 per hour. It's best to arrange this in advance, but we may be able to accommodate last-minute extensions depending on availability. What forms of payment do you accept? We accept major credit cards, debit cards, and online payment methods. We will also accept cash or a check. Specific details will be provided during the booking process. Is there an age limit for playing the arcade games? Our arcade games are suitable for all ages, but we recommend adult supervision for younger children to ensure safety. We found 6 years and up is the sweet spot. What happens in case of bad weather? Hoop will be there rain or shine! If it does rain, the big doors where your guests play are shielded from getting wet! If you would like to reschedule though we can look at our calendar and work with you to find a date that works. Can I book Hoop Trailer for corporate events? Absolutely! Hoop Trailer is perfect for corporate events, team-building activities, company picnics, and more. How far in advance should I book my event? We recommend booking as early as possible to secure your preferred date and time, especially during peak seasons. Do you offer discounts for multiple bookings or referrals? We occasionally offer discounts for multiple bookings or referrals. Please contact us for current promotions and special offers. How can I contact Hoop if I have more questions? You can reach us via our website's contact form, email, or by phone. Go to our contact page to get started! Tell me more about the licensing opportunities? Hoop Trailer is excited to offer licensing opportunities in other cities! If you're interested in bringing a Hoop Trailer to your area, visit our Hoop Trailer website to learn more about how you can join the fun and start your own mobile arcade business. This is such a cool idea, do you have a patent? We do! We are officially “Patent Pending” and have filed with the USPTO agency. Our design patent keeps our idea safe from others encroaching and stealing it but also allows us to operate safely in this space. Experience the Ultimate Mobile Arcade. The Only Custom Basketball Arcade Don’t wait to experience the thrill of Hoop Northern Nevada’s mobile arcade at your next event! Whether it’s a birthday party, corporate gathering, or special celebration, we bring the excitement and competition directly to you. With our unique setup featuring four custom-built basketball games, we guarantee non-stop fun and unforgettable memories. Book Pricing info@hoopnorthernnevada.com 775.369.4667 © 2025. Book Now Welcome to Birkholm’s Water Sports—Lake Tahoe’s premier destination for water skiing, wakeboarding, wakesurfing, tubing, and scenic boat tours. Since 2003, our expert team has been sharing the thrill and beauty of Lake Tahoe’s crystal-clear waters with families, adventure seekers, and first-timers alike. Whether you’re looking to learn a new skill or simply enjoy a day on the water, we’re here to make every moment unforgettable. Wakesurfing If you like surfing in the ocean then you will love surfing behind the boat on Lake Tahoe. Come try inland surfing on our endless waves, or until the fuel runs out. Wakesurfing is a great alternative to wakeboarding or waterskiing. Wakesurfing More Info Wakeboarding Wakeboarding, a favorite Lake Tahoe Water Sport. Birkholm’s wakeboarding lessons and/or tows for all ages and ability levels. Come out and see how easy it can be with professional coaching at Birkholm’s Water Ski School. Wakeboarding More Info Water Skiing Birkholm’s Water Ski School offers water ski lessons for double skiing and slalom skiing. We can teach you using in the water instruction or from the boat depending on your age and confidence. Water skiing is truly an activity where the entire family can participate, in the beauty of Lake Tahoe. Water Skiing More Info Boat Tours Birkholm’s Water Ski School also offers boat rides and tours of Lake Tahoe. Take a tour of Emerald Bay, or spend the day cruising the East or West Shores of Lake Tahoe. There are lots of spots to stop for swimming plus several lakeside restaurants if you want to make a pit stop. Boat Tours More Info Tubing Tubing is an activity the entire family can participate in without instruction or lessons. Tube rides are the same price, and wet suits are included if desired. Fuel is also included. Tubing More Info Boat Rental Looking for the best Tahoe boat rental experience? Birkholm’s Water Sports offers private, premium boat rentals on Lake Tahoe—perfect for families, couples, and groups looking to explore the lake in comfort and style. With over 20 years of local experience, our team provides safe, scenic, and stress-free boating adventures you’ll never forget. Boat Rental More Info We provide everything you will need for your wakesurfing, water skiing or wakeboarding experience on beautiful Lake Tahoe Water Skiing Lessons : Enjoy personalized coaching in double or slalom water skiing. Our professional coaches ensure safety, quick progress, and endless fun for both beginners and seasoned skiers. Wakeboarding & Wakesurfing : Ride the perfect wave behind our state-of-the-art boats. Our professional instructors tailor lessons to your ability, making it easy to master wakeboarding tricks or transition smoothly to wakesurfing on Lake Tahoe’s pristine waters. Tubing Adventures : Ideal for the whole family, our tubing sessions require no previous experience. Just suit up, hop on the tube, and enjoy a thrilling ride as you glide across the lake. Scenic Boat Tours : Experience Lake Tahoe’s breathtaking shoreline on one of our private boat tours. Cruise through Emerald Bay, explore hidden coves, and take in panoramic views of the Sierra Nevada mountains—all while enjoying a leisurely ride with your loved ones. Hours of Operation At Birkholm’s Water Ski, Wakeboard, and Wakesurf School on Lake Tahoe, we are more than just a school – we’re a general boat charter service for your endless water sports adventures. Open every day from 7am to 7pm (Sunset Charters available) including weekends, we ensure you have ample time to enjoy the thrill of wake surfing, waterskiing, wakeboarding, and tubing whenever it suits you. Dive in and make the most of every moment on the water with us! We Operate out of the Tahoe Keys Marina You can find us at: 2435 Venice Drive South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150 Lakefront Pickups Available All Around the Lake Lakefront pickups are available with a minimum booking plus travel fees depending on desired pick up location. We can come to your residence or accommodations Only Your Group on Each Boat at a Time If your group is large we can take trips in and out dropping off and picking up participants or use multiple boats to accommodate your entire group at once. Feel free to call us to make special arrangements All Lessons and Charters are Private to Your Family or Group Rates are by the Hour, Not by the Person Reservations are Required We book up quickly! Schedule your reservation early to guarantee your trip. Find out about Suspension Service Service FAQs How expensive is it to check a bike? Good news, bike checks are free! We'll take a look and let you know what's going on, no charge. How much do bicycle mechanics charge per hour? We don't do hourly rates. We keep it simple with fixed-price service packages, and they're usually a better deal! How much do bike shops charge to fix a puncture? Most of the time it's about $15 if you just do it by itself. If you bundle it into a service package, labor is 60% off. How much does it cost to replace bike parts? It depends on the part. It could be $6, or it could be $150. If you go with one of our service packages, a lot of those parts are included -- like a full drivetrain swap is included in our Level 2! How much does it usually cost to repair a bike? Most service packages start around $90 and go up depending on what your bike needs. How much is an average bike repair? A solid once-a-year tune-up usually lands around $150. How much is it to patch a bike tire? We don't patch tubes How long should it take to service a bicycle? Quick stuff can be done in about an hour. Bigger jobs usually take a couple days depending on the queue. If it's going to take longer, we've got loaner bikes to keep you rolling. Are bikes high maintenance? Some are, yeah. The more high-tech the bike, the more upkeep it needs. Especially with internal cables or electronic parts. Those need a little extra love. Is it cheaper to buy a new bike or fix an old one? Rule of thumb: if repairs are more than half the value of the bike, it's usually time to start thinking about something new. Is it worth it to repair a bike? If the fix is going to cost more than half the bike's value, it might not make sense. But it depends on how much you ride and what the bike means to you. Is repairing a bike hard? Some stuff is easy. Some stuff... not so much. Things like brakes, electronics, and compatibility can get tricky fast. That's where we come in! Is it worth rebuilding an old bike? Sometimes, yeah. But if you're spending more than half the bike's value, it's usually better to look at a new one. What is bike repair called? If we're keeping your bike running smooth, that's service or maintenance! If something's broken and needs fixing, that's repair! What is the average lifespan of a bike? Frames can last a really long time---sometimes a lifetime. Most parts wear out in a couple years depending on how much you ride. What is the most common bike repair? Definitely flat tires. It happens to everyone. Do you tip bicycle repair? Nope, no need. How much should I pay for a good bike? Rough starting points: - Regular bikes: around $600 - E-bikes: around $1,200 (And yes, we usually have some solid deals below that too.) Can you repair a bike yourself? You can definitely try, but some stuff needs special bike tools and know-how. If it gets complicated, we've got your back! Can I service my bike myself? For sure. Basic stuff starts at home. We even do clinics to show you how. Can a carbon frame be repaired? It can be, but it's tricky. It voids the warranty and can change how the bike rides. We don't do those repairs, but there are companies that specialize in it if you want to go that route. How do I fix a flat tire on a bike? Best way to learn? Come to one of our free flat repair clinics! We'll happily walk you through it. Safe Buying Guide for Trek & Bontrager Products Skip to content {{ $t('header.link.login') }} United States / English {{ $t('header.link.account') }} {{ $t('login.register') }} Safe Buying Guide for Trek & Bontrager Products Safe Buying Guide for Trek & Bontrager Products A quick guide to making sure you're really buying a Trek With the rise of e-commerce, there has also been a rise in fake websites that advertise products that you are interested in at very low prices. These websites exist only to deceive people and take their money. We care deeply about the security of our customers as well as the integrity of our products and brand. Trek and Bontrager products are exclusively sold by Trek and its authorized retailers. What to look for: The deal is too good to be true If an advertisement is telling you that the bike you want is now 70%-90% off, they are lying to you. Do not click on the ad. Do not give them your money or any personal information. The contact information is suspicious Trek and our retailers hold ourselves to a very high standard of customer service. If you cannot reach the person you are buying from, do not buy from them. The site is relatively new You can check to see how long a website has existed by entering it into archive.org. If the site is brand new and offering steep discounts, do not purchase anything from them. The site does not ask you to pick a preferred retailer All current model Trek bikes ordered online must be shipped to an authorized Trek retailer for assembly. If you are not asked to select a retailer to ship a bike to, do not buy from the site. Prior model year Trek bikes can be shipped directly to consumers, but only through an authorized retailer’s website or BikeExchange.com . Ways to check: Check the reliability of the site online Use an online tool such as ScamDoc to check the reliability score of a potential website. Call or email your local Trek retailer Contact your local store prior to purchasing online to verify the website. Find a retailer . Contact Trek customer service Visit our contact us page for information on getting in touch with us directly. If you feel you have been a victim of a fake website If you feel as though you may have given your personal information to a fraudulent website, call your bank or credit card company. Unfortunately, there is little Trek can do if you have given money or information to a fake website. Trek and its retailers do not match prices found on fake websites. We began running trips in 1993 on the Bio Bio River and named our adventure travel company out of respect for this iconic river and the indigenous people living on its banks. Unfortunately, the Bio Bio River was eventually dammed, so we ventured further south to the Futaleufu River in Chilean Patagonia and chose a most stunning and serene location as the setting for one of the preeminent riverside basecamps on the planet! Your hosts Lorenzo and Terry of Bio Bio Patagonia will make you feel like family the moment you arrive. The Futaleufu River basecamp continually sets the standard for multi-sport adventure, cuisine, guides and staff, in addition to being a sanctuary to recharge and revitalize yourself. Our goal is to provide all skiers, beginners and experts alike, with the best fitting, best performing and most comfortable ski boot they’ve ever worn. Surefoot Orthotics are the first step in creating a proper fit inside your ski boots. We have over 100 models to choose from and carry all the major ski boot brands such as Lange, Nordica, Tecnica, Atomic, and Salomon. While many seek advantages in advanced frames or drag-reducing material, riders frequently overlook personal care in favor of gear upgrades. Surefoot Custom Bike Orthotics prioritize the rider, aligning the foot and ankle’s strongest bones to optimize power and stability. Run From training for marathons or leisurely neighborhood jogs, every step sends an impact through your feet. It’s crucial to have proper support and cushion to reduce fatigue and prevent injuries. Combine proper running technique, carefully selected running shoes, and Surefoot Custom Run Orthotics to enhance your runs. Golf Surefoot Custom Golf Orthotics stack and align the bones of the foot in their strongest position, sub talar neutral. This neutral position is the starting place for providing proper alignment and support for your entire body. Our Process Custom Orthotic Fabrication We begin by scanning your feet with our proprietary pressure-sensitive scanner which measures your foot in 538 precise locations, crafting a detailed, three-dimensional topographical representation of the bottom of your foot. The digital blueprint of your foot is then sent to an advanced orthotic fabrication machine. Solid pieces of raw ethyl vinyl acetate (EVA) are then milled to your exact digitally rendered measurements using an advanced three-axis CAD/CAM milling machine. The final step is a meticulous, hand-guided trimming by our skilled experts, fine-tuning the orthotic to align flawlessly with your footwear shape. Such knowledgeable staff. My partner got custom made orthotics for his ski boots and we were both really impressed with the entire process. They have up to date precise technology and orthotics are made within 30 mins! He needed an adjustment a few days later and they happily accommodated. He has already noticed significantly less pain in his feet while skiing. Would highly recommend. Maddi, Whistler FAQs Can I use my ski orthotics in my running shoes? No. We advise against using your ski orthotics in running shoes due to the differing densities of the EVA material. High-impact sports like running need orthotics with softer materials for cushioning and injury prevention. In contrast, low-impact sports like skiing and biking benefit from denser orthotics for better support and control. Using the correct orthotic for each activity ensures maximum comfort and performance. Do I have to visit a store to have a pair of custom orthotics made? Yes, an initial in-store visit is essential for us to capture your foot's unique data with our specialized scanning technology. Unfortunately, there's no alternative to this process. But once we have your scan, you can order additional pairs anytime. If visiting a store isn't possible, consider our over-the-counter Conforma Insoles, available here . How long can I expect my orthotics to last? The lifespan of custom orthotics can vary based on factors like usage frequency, individual size, and activity intensity. For instance, orthotics tend to last longer for those with high arch, rigid feet compared to those with low arch, hyper-mobile feet. Shop Truckee River Flies Fly Fishing The Truckee River The Truckee River, often called the “Toughy” or the “Tricky” is a true year-round fishery, with each season bringing its own set of challenges and opportunities. Success here comes down to preparation: heavy flies, enough split shot to get down in the zone, and a rod and line setup capable of turning over those rigs. On this river, getting your flies where the fish are is everything. A Euro nymph rod is a longer, lighter fly rod designed for tight-line nymphing. It helps you maintain direct contact with your flies, improve drift control, and detect subtle strikes—especially in fast, technical water like the Truckee. Without it, line can slip between the spool and frame, leading to frustrating tangles and lost efficiency. A full cage keeps everything contained and running smoothly, so you can stay focused on maintaining tight contact and fishing your drift effectively. Beachfront locations with Lake Tahoe as a backdrop are perfect for capturing beautiful wedding photos. The Recreation Complex offers a variety of rooms and outdoor amenities to host family gatherings or celebrations for private events. Lakeview Commons at El Dorado Beach is popular for public special events and fundraisers of all types. Additional park amenities with covered gazebos, BBQ, and playgrounds are available to make your next special event a memorable one. What is a Private Event? "Private Events" are defined as events that are open only to your guests such as a wedding, family gathering, or private celebration. If you are interested in booking your private event at City Recreation and Aquatics Center, please check out our facility rental calendars to see availability at our various event venues. What is a Public Event? "Public Events" are defined as events that are open to the public with or without an entrance fee, may have vendors and/or serve food, and are publicly advertised. All public events held within city limits or on city property are subject to completing the City Special Event Application . Commercial Use of Parks A Commercial Use of Parks Permit (CUPP) is required for any individual or business conducting fee-based or revenue-generating activities in City of South Lake Tahoe parks. This includes fitness classes, camps, and other organized programs. To learn more about requirements and fees, please visit our Commercial Use of Parks Permit page. (opens in new window) Marine Specialties Service Department Marine Specialties Boat Service & Repair – Northern Nevada’s Trusted Marine Experts Welcome to the Marine Specialties Service Department, where keeping your boat in peak condition is our top priority. We know that owning a boat is all about fun on the water, but it also comes with the responsibility of regular maintenance. That’s why we proudly offer expert boat repairs and service for Nautique, Sanger, Barletta Pontoons, and many other boat brands up to 20 years old. Expert Boat Maintenance & Repairs Our factory-trained technicians specialize in preventative maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs, helping you avoid costly breakdowns and unexpected downtime. Whether you need a 25-hour service, annual service, impeller replacement, full engine diagnostics, or even a new engine installation, we complete repairs efficiently and effectively so you can spend less time in the shop and more time on the water. As an authorized dealer for Nautique, Sanger, and Barletta, we perform warranty repairs on the boats we sell. If you purchased a Nautique, Sanger, or Barletta from us and need warranty service, we will handle the repair process for you. We Service a Wide Range of Marine Engines & Boat Brands We proudly service inboard and sterndrive boats within the last 20 model years, including those powered by: ✔ PCM Marine Engines ✔ Indmar Marine Engines ✔ Volvo Penta Marine Engines ✔ MerCruiser Engines If you’re unsure whether we service your boat, please have your boat’s make, model, and engine information ready when you call or text us, and we’ll be happy to assist you! Preventative Maintenance – Protect Your Investment Preventative maintenance is the key to avoiding costly repairs, maximizing your boat’s performance, and extending its lifespan. Our service team focuses on routine inspections, fluid changes, and system checks to catch potential issues before they turn into major problems. ✔ Oil & Filter Changes – Extend engine life & improve efficiency ✔ Annual Service – Includes engine oil & filter change, fuel filter replacement (if equipped), multi-point inspection, and trailer service ✔ Impeller & Cooling System Checks – Prevent overheating and engine damage ✔ Battery & Electrical System Testing – Avoid unexpected power failures ✔ Fuel System Maintenance – Ensure peak engine performance ✔ Trailer Inspections & Service – Keep your boat trailer safe & road-ready ✔ Maintenance Inspection – Performed on all Summer Preps to check critical systems and catch problems before you’re on the water By staying on top of these essential maintenance steps, you can ensure smooth operation, improved fuel efficiency, and fewer unexpected breakdowns. Seasonal Services – Summer Prep & Winterization ✔ Summer Prep & Maintenance Inspections – Ensure your boat is ready for the season with a full system check and tune-up. ✔ Winterization Services – Properly protect your engine and systems during the off-season to prevent costly freeze damage. Check out the sections below for Preventative Maintenance Estimates, our Maintenance Inspection Sheet, and why Winterization is a must for boaters in Northern Nevada & California. NOTICE FOR OUTBOARD ENGINE CUSTOMERS At this time, Marine Specialties does not provide service or repairs for outboard engines (with the exception of Yamaha outboards on Barletta Pontoons purchased from Marine Specialties). However, we’re happy to assist you in finding a qualified outboard service provider in your area. If you’re performing your own outboard repairs, our Parts Department may have what you need. We stock select older outboard engine parts, and if we don’t have it in stock, we can help you locate the right parts for your specific model. Submit a request through our Parts Request Page, and we’ll do our best to assist you. MEET THE CREW Three Stunning Lakes Nestled in these stunning mountains, we have many pristine lakes, each with its own character. We are proud to offer charters on three of them. BOCA RESERVOIR Boca Reservoir, located in Truckee, California, sits on the Little Truckee River within the Tahoe National Forest. This man-made lake rests at an elevation of about 5,500ft and offers beautiful mountain views. STAMPEDE RESERVOIR Just past Boca, sits Stampede Reservoir, at 5,900ft. Tucked further into the forest, it offers a peaceful, scenic setting and is great for sight seeing. It feeds water into Boca Reservoir throughout the year. LAKE TAHOE Lake Tahoe is a natural lake that straddles the California Nevada border, and is famous for its crystal clear, deep, blue waters. Beyond its scenic beauty, Tahoe offers a variety of waterfront dining and bars. SERVICES Gallery "Cole and Brian were hands down the best instructors I have ever had with this sport. Truckee + North Lake Tahoe's First Mobile Axe Throwing Experience About Alpenthrow Thanks for checking out Alpenthrow! North Lake Tahoe's first mobile axe throwing trailer. Whether you're a pro-beard, flannel wearing axe-throwing professional or a first timer, our goal is the same for you and your crew to have an unforgettable time. ​ Whether you're celebrating a special event or just want to have some fun, we'll make any event a fun and unique experience. ​ If you've never thrown before, our coaches will walk you through the how-to's on throwing an axe safely, and in a matter of minutes you will experience the primal thrill of hitting the target. We start with a safety tutorial, followed by throwing with our coaching staff providing detailed instruction to each member of the group. All groups are different, but the learning process generally takes between 10-15 minutes depending on the size of the group. We can provide your group with different games to get competitive with one other. How it Works When you are ready to book, please contact us. Here is what we are going to want to know about your event: ​ ● Date, time, and full address of your event, we request 7-days advance notice to your event. ​ ● Distances of further than 20 miles from Truckee will require additional mileage charges. ​ ● We require a 25ft long x 10ft wide x 12ft. tall space on level ground where we can park our trailer that is easily accessible from the road. ​ ● Our package minimum is 2 hours but can customize pricing specific to your event needs. ​ ● 50% deposit required at time of booking; payment is non-refundable. Book us for your next event. Boat Storage Lake Tahoe - Sierra Boat Company Skip to content Call Us: (530) 546-2551 Facebook Instagram Facebook Instagram My account Cart Checkout 0 Items Boat Services Boat Storage Brokerage Mechanical Restoration Wood Boat Restoration Boats For Sale Featured Fiberglass Launches New Wooden Boats Riva Runabouts 19′ and Under 20′ and Over Utility 19′ and Under 20′ and Over Sold Boats Rates Store About Resources Contact Us Select Page BOAT STORAGE LAKE TAHOE Indoor Boat Storage Facility Sierra Boat has indoor boat storage facilities for over 450 boats. We have ample space for boats up to 22’ and limited space for larger boats. We always give priority storage to wooden boat owners. Before boats are put in to winter storage, they are fully prepared for layup. We usually start with an oil change followed by the addition of fuel stabilizer and the fogging of the engine. Fogging or pickling, puts a coating of oil over all of the combustion components which includes cylinders and valves. This ensures that during long term storage, surface rust does not erode engine components. The engine is then drained of all cooling water and is fully inventoried for contents stored in the boat. Once racked, the boat is then double checked to make sure it was properly drained. Finally we cover the boats and map their location. When the boat comes out of storage, we activate the engine and go through a check list to make sure critical components are functional such as bilge pumps and lights. We then give the boat a water test to make sure it is performing properly before we release it to the customer. If any problems are encountered, the customer is notified so repairs can be made. This process ensures that our clients receive a trouble free boat upon pickup. We have the largest inventory of wooden runabouts on the West Coast. Because of our 50+ years of experience with wooden boat restoration and repair, we understand the idiosyncrasies of representing and selling Antique and Classic Boats. We are also licensed with the California Department of Boating and Waterways for yacht brokerage and sales and are members of the California Yacht Brokers Association. This assures that be you a buyer or a seller, you will be treated in a professional and ethical manner. Many of the boats we sell have been with Sierra Boat for a long time and we have comprehensive knowledge of the boats as well as a history of past work performed on them. This gives us the ability to represent the boats accurately. Our boats have for the most part been professionally maintained and restored and we seek out listings for boats that have had only professional work done on them. Once a customer has focused on a particular boat to buy, a deposit is taken and we arrange for a sea trial. This is a very important part of how we do business because ultimately, the boat must perform to the buyer’s expectations. It also is an opportunity for us to sort out any problems with the boat. If desired, we can also arrange for a survey of the boat by an accredited marine surveyor. As a full service marina and boatyard, we have always had qualified staff to take care of the oldest engines to the newest. Our experience with engines runs from Liberty V-12s, Hall Scott, Packard, Sterling, Scripps and Kermath. Of course we also work on all of the Chris Craft engines including the A-120 V8 as well as Chrysler, Grey Marine and Interceptor. Have a modern engine? We do those too. We have factory trained mechanics for Mercruiser, Volvo and Bombardier products. We can re-power your wooden boat in a way that still looks stock from the outside including a single exhaust and correct instruments. We do this in a way that does not alter the boat and allows for the re-installation of the original engine if desired for show purposes. Step Up. Push Further. Set The Pace. Every bow Mathews has ever made was built for one reason: To give you an edge when nothing else does. Out there, the rules belong to mother nature. She’s fast. She’s ruthless. She’s been winning since the beginning. That’s why Mathews has spent decades chasing every ounce of personal performance, every advantage, every breakthrough. The 2026 ARC is the sharpest edge yet – your chance to step into her world and stack the odds in your favor. Arc Overview: Engineered for speed and refined for archers who demand more, the 2026 ARC combines enhanced stability, efficiency, and versatility in a lightweight, high-powered platform. Built on their most advanced riser design to date, a second generation SWX cam with Perimeter weight technology, and a redesigned limb cup and limb geometry, every system within the ARC platform has been scrutinized to retain velocity across hunting setups where other platforms lose ground. The ARC isn’t just fast on paper – it’s fast where it matters most. Featuring the new Bridge-Lock 7° Angled Stabilizers, a new Bridge-Lock mounting port for quick integration of the new Integrated V-bar, and an all-new integrated Silent Connect anchor, the ARC refines every component in Mathews most optimized system to date. Features: Redesigned SWX-2 Cam: The second generation SWX Cam with Perimeter Weight Technology works alongside the rest of this powerful system to both reduce felt recoil and retain speed where others lose ground. In side-by-side comparisons, hunting setups that typically cost past models significant speed, keep their edge with the ARC—giving hunters faster arrows, flatter trajectories, and more forgiveness in the field. New 2026 SWX-Z Mods: This new mod option offers a more generous curve to produce an ultra-smooth draw with a modest tradeoff in peak speed ratings. How to Read Water Conditions to Improve Your Catch Rate - Fishingintahoe Skip to content info@fishingintahoe.com 530-318-1981 REVIEWS BLOGS CONTACT US HOME About Us Charters Our Guides Our Fleet Book Online Menu HOME About Us Charters Our Guides Our Fleet Book Online BOOK ONLINE How to Read Water Conditions to Improve Your Catch Rate By samsearchberg / September 13, 2024 Understanding water conditions is crucial for enhancing your fishing success. Whether you’re heading out for fishing in Lake Tahoe or any other location, reading water conditions accurately can significantly impact your catch rate. Here’s how to interpret these conditions to make the most of your fishing trips. Observe Water Clarity Water clarity is one of the most important factors in charter fishing . Clearwater generally means fish are warier and may be harder to catch. On the other hand, murky water can make fish less cautious, but it also requires different techniques. In Lake Tahoe, where water clarity can exceed 70 feet, you may need to use more subtle baits and lures. Check water clarity regularly and adjust your fishing methods accordingly. Monitor Water Temperature Fish are highly sensitive to water temperature, and it affects their feeding behavior. For a successful fishing charter, always check the water temperature before you begin. In Lake Tahoe, the water temperature can vary greatly depending on depth and season. Generally, fish are more active in cooler water and might prefer deeper areas during warmer months. Using a temperature gauge can help you find the ideal fishing spots based on current conditions. Watch for Surface Activity Surface activity is a good indicator of fish behavior . Look for signs such as fish jumping, birds diving, or ripples caused by feeding fish. These indicators can help you locate where the fish are active and improve your chances of a successful catch. During your fishing boat trips, use these observations to adjust your location and bait. Paying attention to surface activity can guide you to the most productive fishing areas. Pay Attention to Weather Patterns Weather conditions play a significant role in fishing success. Changes in weather can affect fish behavior and water conditions. For example, overcast skies often lead to more active feeding, while bright sunny days might make fish more elusive. Wind can also influence where fish are located, as it can push baitfish and create feeding opportunities. Before heading out, review the weather forecast and plan your fishing trips around expected conditions. Understand Current and Tide Effects For those engaging in fishing tours in areas with significant currents or tides, understanding their effects is crucial. Tides can influence fish movement, and strong currents can impact where fish are located. In Lake Tahoe, while tides are less of a concern, water flow and current patterns still affect fish behavior. Use this knowledge to choose the best times and locations for fishing boat trips, and consider adjusting your techniques based on current conditions. Ready to Improve Your Catch Rate? We offer expertly guided fishing trips and private fishing charters that will put you in the prime spots for a successful fishing charter. Our experienced fishing guides know how to read water conditions and will ensure that your fishing tours are both enjoyable and productive. Contact us today to book your next adventure and maximize your catch rate! More NcStar Optics & Accessory Performance Gear CCW CCW News Contact Us Firearms News NSSF Celebrates 20th Anniversary of the Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act WASHINGTON, D.C. — NSSF® – The Firearm Industry Trade Association – celebrates the 20-year anniversary of the enactment of the Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act (PLCAA). The PLCAA is the bipartisan law passed by Congress and signed into law on October 26, 2005, by former President George W. Bush that protects the firearm industry from frivolous lawsuits attempting to hold highly-regulated and lawful firearm businesses liable for the criminal misuse of lawfully sold firearms by remote third parties. The PLCAA, at its core, ensures that the Second Amendment right to keep and bear arms can be exercised by law-abiding Americans. “Americans cannot exercise their God-given right to purchase, possess and use firearms without a strong and present industry that provides the means to acquire those firearms. The firearm industry is comprised of more than 400,000 hardworking men and women who take immense pride in providing safe and reliable products for Americans to purchase if and when they choose to do so,” said Lawrence G. Keane, NSSF Senior Vice President and General Counsel. “The Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act has ensured that this Constitutional right has not been bankrupted out of existence by gun control activists and those bent on eliminating the right of law-abiding Americans to keep and bear arms.” The PLCAA codifies traditional American jurisprudence and common-sense principles to prevent baseless litigation from bankrupting an entire industry critical to the safety and security of our nation. The PLCAA codified a bedrock legal principle: that firearm industry manufacturers and retailers are not responsible for the subsequent criminal misuse or illegal possession of their lawfully sold, non-defective products by remote third parties – criminals – over whom they have no control. Firearm industry members are no more legally responsible for illegal shootings than a cookware manufacturer is responsible if a criminal misuses a sharp kitchen knife to stab someone, or than Ford is for a fatal crash caused by a drunk driver operating a Ford vehicle. Congress recognized the threat these frivolous lawsuits represented and passed the bipartisan PLCAA in 2005, explaining it was because antigun politicians were using the courts to “attempt to circumvent the Legislative branch of government” and “expand civil liability in a manner never contemplated by the framers of the Constitution.” The PLCAA is still proving necessary, as the industry is still being targeted by gun control groups and politicians, including those who continue to falsely claim the firearm industry is “the only industry immune from liability.” While the PLCAA has been incredibly successful in protecting the firearm industry from frivolous lawsuits, the PLCAA is constantly under attack. In recent years, several states have attempted to defy the will of Congress by codifying the same strained tort theories in statutes providing that industry members are subjected to ill-defined “reasonable controls” standards for public nuisance. For example, displeased with Congress’ judgment, New York passed a law in 2021 to, in then-Governor Andrew Cuomo’s own words, “reinstate the public nuisance liability for gun manufacturers” that states tried to impose two decades ago, in an avowed effort to “right the wrong done 16 years [earlier]” when Congress enacted the PLCAA. While we celebrate the anniversary of this landmark legislation, we remain vigilant in defending the PLCAA from ongoing threats. -30- About NSSF NSSF is the trade association for the firearm industry. Its mission is to promote, protect and preserve hunting and the shooting sports. Formed in 1961, NSSF has a membership of thousands of manufacturers, distributors, firearms retailers, shooting ranges, sportsmen’s organizations and publishers nationwide. For more information, visit nssf.org. ________________________ Media contact: Mark Oliva 202-220-1340 Big Banks are Blinking on Discrimination Against the Firearms Industry By Larry Keane Big banks are blinking in the stare down over discrimination against the firearm industry. So much so, that even The Wall Street Journal is taking notice. The issue of financial discrimination has been a top priority for NSSF in what can only be described as a David versus Goliath battle of wills. The firearm industry is a $93 billion-a-year industry that faced off against the combined economic strength of the banking industry, which tops $23.6 trillion in assets and a net income of $260 billion in FY 2022. That’s like slinging a pebble against a giant. But persistence pays off and now the giant is thinking the fight isn’t worth the cost. The Wall Street Journal reported, “Big banks are trying to get out of the crosshairs of Republican states that are cracking down on companies for ‘woke’ policies that conservative policymakers say are illegal and discriminatory.” Those meetings were between JP Morgan Chase, Citigroup and Wells Fargo, as well as other big bank representatives, and officials in Texas and Oklahoma. Interestingly, those are the same banking institutions that had, and some continue to have, policies to refuse banking services to firearm-related businesses. Citigroup recently recanted its antigun positions and publicly stated it would conduct business based on financial risk, instead of the ill-defined “reputational risk” that banks used to justify freezing out gun and ammunition businesses. NSSF is cautiously optimistic that Citigroup’s reversal is genuine, but we’re watching and waiting for evidence that firearm businesses are again banking with the corporate financial provider. “Trust but verify,” as President Ronald Reagan used to say. in the sun Explore Northern Nevada's Most Complete Boat Dealership New Boats Explore Pre-Owned Explore Services Explore Shop by Type Water Sport Boats Fishing Boats Pontoons Lakes Inventory Current Promotions Welcome To Custom Boat & Marine Custom Boat & Marine is a local family-owned marine dealership serving Northern Nevada and Lake Tahoe since 1977. We have worked hard over the years helping families like yours to have as much "Fun in the Sun" as possible. In the boating world, we believe families that play together stay together. For the past 48 years, boating has been our passion, along with excellent customer service. With our experience as a high-altitude boat dealer and the longevity of our employees in both sales and service, we can guarantee you a great boating experience. Custom Boat & Marine offers a great selection of new and pre-owned boats, and we take pride in the brands we represent, including Bayliner, Hewes Craft, Sea Ray, Godfrey Pontoons, Heyday Wakeboats, and Mercury outboards. Bayliner is the number one selling boat in the world. Bayliner has accomplished this in a variety of ways, from innovative manufacturing, worldwide buying power, providing the first lifetime hull warranty, to being the best value in the market. Mercury and MerCruiser are the most recognizable names in marine power, with more dealers and factory-trained technicians worldwide than any other brand. Custom Boat & Marine has Northern Nevada's largest and most complete on-site service department. We can and will service all makes and models with our factory-trained technicians, regardless of how old your boat may be. In addition, Custom Boat & Marine offers fiberglass repair and custom rigging from wakeboard towers to fishing equipment and electronics. At Custom Boat & Marine, we do a lot more than just sell boats. Our knowledgeable staff is available to help you find the latest and greatest in boating accessories or that hard-to-find part. No matter what your boating needs are, Custom Boat & Marine would like to invite you, your family, and friends down to experience why we have earned the prestigious President's Award for being one of the top 5 Bayliner dealers in the country. Buoys The Marina’s boat valet service is available during business hours to guests who have boats stored on buoys. Owners are responsible for the connection from the boat to the buoy and the Marina has mooring lines in stock and available for purchase on site. Book Now About Current Fly Fishing A Safe, Fun, and Educational Experience on the Water We offer catch-and-release guided fly fishing trips in Reno, Nevada and Truckee, California. Taking anglers of all ability levels — from first-time fly fishers to experienced anglers looking to improve their skills. Being licensed to guide in both California and Nevada allows us access to some of the best rivers in the Eastern Sierra. If you're looking for a quality fly fishing guide service that offers top-notch instruction for all skill levels, Current Fly Fishing is ready to make your next adventure a great one. Guide Trips & Rates Lessons Fly Fishing Locations Truckee River | East Walker River California & Nevada With Reno, Nevada as our home base, we are able to access many great fly fishing locations within an hour drive, along with other productive waters throughout the Eastern Sierra. The Truckee River is our home water, and we also guide trips on the East Walker River. These are two of the Eastern Sierra’s best rivers for large, hard-fighting brown and rainbow trout. Float trips on the Truckee River offer a completely different perspective on this beautiful fishery and allow access to water that is difficult to reach on foot. Fishing Locations Guided Fly Fishing Trips Truckee River Guided Fly Fishing Trips From half-day guide trips to full-day float trips, Current Fly Fishing offers guided fly fishing trips for anglers of all experience levels in Reno, Nevada and Truckee, California. From $425 Half-Day Guide Trip A great option for anglers looking for focused instruction, an immersive experience and a shorter day on the Truckee River. (Unless a guide is specifically requested, trips maybe assigned to any of our professional guide staff) Seasons & Conditions on the Truckee The Truckee River fishes year-round with changing techniques through the seasons. We choose our fly fishing locations based on flows, clarity, and hatches. Spring: As the snow melt run off subsides and temps warm up we see the most diversity in our insect hatches; BWOs, March Browns,PMDs, Yellow Sally Stoneflys and Caddis. There is a fair chance to see a few fish rising too. A great time of year to Float, higher water levels allow float access to many sections. Summer: As temps rise and water levels begin to lower we see Caddis, Mayfly, Golden Stoneflys and Midge hatches. Floating remains an option in certain areas however, depending on flows we may be limited.Many areas open up for Walk and Wade Fishing. Fall: Consistent flows and cooler weather; Mayfly/Baetis and October Caddis. Once temps drop we start floating east of Reno. This section of river can offer opportunities for dry fly fishing and stunning desert views. Winter: Fish move into slower pools and begin to feed during the warmest parts of the day. Midges and BWOs are the main hatch. Surprisingly, this is the most productive time of year for dry fly fishing. Floating east of Reno is a great option as well as Walk and Wade. Carnegie SVRA Known for its challenging hill climbs and single track trails, the SVRA offers a variety of recreation opportunities for OHV enthusiasts. Clay Pit SVRA Located two miles west of Oroville, this 220-acre SVRA provides recreation opportunities for motorcycle, ATV and 4x4 recreationists. Heber Dunes SVRA The sand dunes and dense groves of tamarisk trees that prevail throughout the SVRA offer a unique desert recreation experience. Hollister Hills SVRA Divided into two unique recreation areas-the Upper Ranch and the Lower Ranch-the park provides a wide-variety of OHV recreation opportunities for all skill levels Hungry Valley SVRA OHV recreation opportunities include open areas, identified trails, tracks, play areas, special use areas, and a 4x4 obstacle course. Oceano Dunes SVRA The SVRA provides a unique opportunity for visitors to participate in OHV recreation on several miles of beach and coastal sand dunes. Ocotillo Wells SVRA More than 85,000 acres of Southern California desert provide a wide variety of opportunities for OHV recreation and exploration. Prairie City SVRA This urban OHV Park provides recreational opportunities for motorcycles, ATVs, 4x4s, ROVs, Karts, and Quarter Midgets. Our Mission The Mission of the Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation (OHMVR) Division is to provide leadership statewide in the area of off-highway vehicle (OHV) recreation; to acquire, develop, and operate state-owned vehicular recreation areas; and to otherwise provide for a statewide system of managed OHV recreational opportunities through funding to other public agencies. The OHMVR Division works to ensure quality recreational opportunities remain available for future generations by providing for education, conservation, and enforcement efforts that balance OHV recreation impacts with programs that conserve and protect cultural and natural resources. State Parks Commissions Historic Preservation Boating & Waterways Visit one of our SVRAs Ride your dirt bike, ATV, side-by-side (ROV/UTV), 4x4, or dune buggy on a wide variety of designated terrain and trails available at nine state vehicular recreation areas (SVRAs). Some SVRAs feature camping, interpretive programs, and other recreational opportunities. Learn about our Grants Program Our OHMVR Division's Grants and Cooperative Agreements Program in an annual program providing financial assistance to eligible applicants for well-managed off-highway vehicle recreation. OHMVR Commission The Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation Commission meets quarterly to review plans for new and expanded recreation areas and welcomes public comment on the OHMVR Division's program s . OHV Safety Week Join the OHMVR Division and its partners for this year's OHV Safety Week, held from November 15th to 23th, 2025. OHMVR Division encourages everyone to prioritize OHV safety and respect for one another. Off-Highway Vehicle Access Project The Off-Highway Vehicle (OHV) Access Project is a state initiative lead by the California Department of Parks and Recreation (State Parks) Strategic Planning and Recreation Services Division, Off-Highway Motor Vehicle Recreation (OHMVR) Division, and OHMVR Commission to identify new opportunities for additional OHV facilities in California as mandated by Senate Bill 155 (SB 155). Click here to learn about the division’s numerous resource management projects. Know before you go Prior to leaving for your outdoor destination, learn how to recreate safely and responsibly. Read up on the rules of the riding, take a training course and find out about the proper equipment. Many of the facilities/venues listed here are available for group rentals. View more information on the Rental Facilities page . Ridgeline Park Ball Fields 939 Southwood Blvd., Incline Village, NV 89451 Ridgeline Park consists of three well-maintained softball/baseball fields, located right below the Incline Skate Park on Southwood, next to the middle school. Ball Field #3 underwent extensive renovations in 2021, made possible through a public-private partnership with Ridgeline Apps , the Incline-Tahoe Foundation , and the Incline Village General Improvement District. Read more about the renovation on the Ridgeline Park & Ball Field page . Ridgeline Park Ball Fields are available for group rentals for Incline Village and Crystal Bay residents and the general public. Preston Field & Playground 700 Tahoe Blvd., Incline Village, NV 89451 This field is located right along Hwy 28 by the Hwy 431 turnoff and it’s easily spotted by its radiant green grass and perfectly groomed field. Preston Field is perfect for playing softball and baseball. Preston Field is available for group rentals for Incline Village and Crystal Bay residents and the general public. Adjacent to the field is a playground with two play structures and a swing set surrounded by a grassy area and picnic tables. Picnic areas are available for group rentals for birthday parties, small outdoor gatherings, etc. Village Green 960 Lakeshore Blvd., Incline Village, NV 89451 Village Green is a wide open space next to the Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe. There is a multi-use field for playing soccer, Frisbee, or a friendly game of football. A trail and a creek run around the edges of it and it’s nestled among the Aspen trees. Park at the Aspen Grove parking lot. Village Green is available for group rentals for Incline Village and Crystal Bay residents and the general public. The schedule for Village Green is posted here during the spring, summer, and fall months as the fields are occasionally rented for sports leagues and special events. Recreation Center, Beach Picnic Areas, Parks and Fields The Recreation Center offers year-round facilities for birthday parties, group fitness room, indoor gymnasium, and indoor pool. Adjacent to the Recreation Center, the new Bocce Park is a great outdoor space that is available for parties and rentals. On the west end of town, Preston Park is another great location for a family gathering, work outing or your child’s birthday party. In addition, Village Green, Preston Field and Ridgeline Park offer wide open spaces for activities and have multi-use fields for your softball and baseball needs for tournaments, family reunions, or corporate events. For IVGID Picture Pass Holders (with beach access), Incline and Burnt Cedar beaches have picnic areas to reserve for your spring or summer event. No longer do you need to arrive hours before your event to secure a spot for your group. The designated beach sites include picnic tables offering you and your friends an area to picnic or grill and enjoy the beach. The volleyball courts and bocce area is also now available for group rentals. Each guest is still responsible for beach access fees. Reservations at all sites are taken on a first-come, first-served basis at the Parks & Recreation Counter. Please call (775) 832-1310 or stop by and see us for rates or more information. Payment is required with your application. Rent individual courts or rent the entire Pickleball Center (15 upper courts). The newly renovated deck can also be rented for events. Tennis & Pickleball Center Facility Rental Application (tennis courts, pickleball courts, and Tennis & Pickleball Center deck) Incline Village Golf Courses, Tournaments & Groups ​The Incline Village Golf Courses offers special rates for groups of 16 or more. The unique Robert Trent Jones, Jr. designed Mountain Course and the renowned Robert Trent Jones, Sr. designed Championship Course provide fun and challenging options for all levels of golfers. Fill out the Tournament Inquiry form and our staff with contact you with options. The Chateau at Incline Village® Radiating with Tahoe charm, The Chateau at Incline Village® is located at the Championship Golf Course at 955 Fairway Blvd. Vaulted ceilings, stacked rock fireplaces, and expansive decks all enhance the beauty of the natural surroundings. Passes Golf Events & Programs Local Clubs Transfer of Service In order to transfer service to a new owner we will need to receive notification at least two business days prior to close of escrow. Water and sewer services are not interrupted upon change of ownership. Service is not transferred until a Grant Deed has been received from the title company. The details below also provide other helpful information to ensure accuracy upon close of escrow. Buyers can contact our office to provide their contact information, but water and sewer utilities follow the property. Once we receive a copy of the Grant Deed after close of escrow we can transfer service. Processing change of ownership upon sale For single, multi-family and commercial properties (excluding HOA accounts or vacant land) For all changes of ownership due to sale we will require a minimum of 2 working days notice, prior to the close of escrow, to schedule a final read on the water meter. Please call our office to notify us of the estimated close of escrow date and a request for final meter read. By the morning of the close of escrow date we will provide you with the current balance on the account and the consumption charges due from the final meter read. IVGID does not prorate balances on accounts so the final read breakdown will include the base rate charges for the account (which are billed in advance). If a final meter read is not requested the new owner will be liable for the past consumption charges on the account. Other helpful information to ensure accuracy upon close of escrow If the leak notification is set at the time of collecting a final meter read IVGID will advise escrow so all parties can be informed. This is a courtesy notification and IVGID will not require a leak be fixed. When a demand is submitted for completion, we will complete the information requested or indicate if the property is located within an HOA which pays the water/sewer charges or is vacant land. We will also send the demand to the IVGID Recreation department for them to indicate if there are passes which need to be returned upon sale. Our billing cycle is the 19th to the 18th of each month. Our base rates are billed on the 19th of the month in advance for this time period. Consumption charges are billed in arrears based on water and sewer use at the property. IVGID does not prorate charges and water and sewer services and charges are continuous through change of ownership. If the customer has Auto Payment set for their account, we will cancel auto payment once a final read is completed. If duplicate payment is made after the close of escrow date, we will deposit the title company check and issue a refund check to the seller. Upon close of escrow we need to receive a copy of the Deed (excluding properties in an HOA), even if there is not a check being submitted, as well as a contact phone number(s) for the customer. A separate demand for refuse charges must be sent to Waste Management by email: dpayoffs@wm.com. Refuse rates are billed quarterly in advance on October 1, January 1, April 1, and July 1. Guiding Tahoe Since 1999. +1 (530) 583-4857 Captain Chris is a friendly, knowledgeable North Lake Tahoe fishing guide who loves to catch fish All charters are private all of the time—up to 5 people. You & your group will be the only ones on board. Come fish on my boat, a 25-foot Skip jack, with a comfortable cabin and restroom. Captain Chris does it all, from taking your call to filleting your fish. Mackinaw trout are the primary target in Lake Tahoe; however, from July through September, I also fish for rainbow trout after catching Mackinaw first. April through September, trips depart early morning. Winter trips are wind and weather permitting. Charter length is approximately 4 hours. Call for start times. pages.text: ODM Defense Home Calendar Holsters Instructors Services Deposits Contact Media Home Calendar Holsters Instructors Services Deposits Contact Media Guns - gear - custom holsters - training ODM DEFENSE Providing Safe and Practical Personal Defense Training, Firearms, and Gear for Northern Nevada & Surrounding Areas Founded in Minden, NV with the core value of providing safe, practical, professional, and relaxing firearms training to individuals and groups, ODM Defense is a positive training environment to improve and perfect you knowledge and skills as a responsible gun owner. ODM Defense uses practical methods during our training evolutions to make the student really think about and analyze what it is they are doing, why they are doing it, and what the intended outcome is. Whether it is a CCW class, a first-time shooters class, Hunters Ed, or advanced pistol, the staff at ODM Defense place a heavy emphasis on the “why”. Why do we do things a certain way, why we approach certain methods a certain way… Its the why that helps the student recognize, acknowledge, and accept the information being presented. Get in touch with us to reserve a class seat, or use the contact form at the bottom of this page to enquire whether our services are right for you. Learn More Contact ➤ LOCATION 2559 Precision Dr, Ste 1 Minden, NV 89423 ☎ CONTACT info@odmdefense.com (775) 468-6874 Some of What We Offer Concealed Carry Learn the ins and outs of carrying a concealed firearm. Safety, Mindset, Nomenclature, Local, State, and Federal Laws, Basic Fundamentals & Shooting Skills, Marksmanship, Written Exam & Range Qualification. This class covers the state minimum requirement & much, MUCH more. Ladies Only Orientation We pride ourselves on providing a safe, comfortable, and relaxing training environment where new shooters can feel free to ask whatever questions come to mind, and get hands-on training on all levels of firearm handling and safe use. This is a 2 part class, consisting of classroom and live-fire range time. ODM takes care of all the heavy lifting! FACTORY-CERTIFIED CERAKOTE SERVICES We have a Cerakote factory-certified cerakote applicator on the team to handle all of your custom coating needs! Whether you want a simple single color change-up, or an elaborate camouflage pattern, we can take care of it! Our applicator is well regarded in the industry and has been applying product for nearly a decade. All of our cerakote is done in-house, there is no sub-contracting or outsourcing. We strive to have a fast turn around, approximately 2 weeks or less! Cerkote service pricing is dependent on the size of the job. Feel free to contact us for pricing and timeline. Pistol training Whether you’re a first time shooter or a higher level competitor, ODM has something for you. Firearm safety and manipulation, mechanics, recognizing and clearing various malfunctions quickly and efficiently, or just making a few tweaks here and there, we can get you dialed. unarmed combatives training Our unique Combative Self Defense Program draws from the most effective combative fighting systems available, including systems such as Filipino Martial Arts, Krav Maga, Brazilian Jiu Jitsu, C.O.B.R.A, Marine Corps Martial Arts Program, and more. There is literally nothing else like this available anywhere. FFL TRANSFERS Having trouble finding a reasonable place to have your firearms transferred to? Look no further! ODM Defense is happy to conduct your FFL transfers! We charge $20.00 for the initial firearm, and $10.00 for any additional firearms on the same transfer. For current and former LE/Mil, 1st Responders, It’s $10.00 for per firearm. Contact us directly with any questions you may have pertaining to our transfer services! Rifle training Want to learn to build your very own custom AR-15? We can do that. Want to learn to run that gun? We can do that, too. We offer build classes and multiple levels of rifle training from static range to dynamic movement and working in pairs and teams. private instruction Often times, some individuals may not feel safe or comfortable receiving training in a large group of strangers. Not a problem? We are happy to offer one-on-one training and private group instruction at a reasonable hourly rate. If its a standard class we offer, you will not be charged extra for a private group class. NEVADA STATE PRIVATE INVESTIGATORS LICENSING BOARD ARMED GUARD CERTIFICATION ODM Defense is state certified and approved to teach both the initial two-day armed guard certification, and the 6-month renewal course. If you are employed by a third-party security contracting company and require either your initial or renewal, contact us for scheduling and we can get you certified! “ Awareness is good. But without skills and ability tied to that awareness,all you have is anxiety. ” Tony Blauer Let's Chat. Questions, comments, or concerns for us? Please feel free to correspond with us below. We will address any of your questions or concerns as soon as possible! Looking for a new firearm but not sure what works for you? Looking for a recommendation on defensive ammo? Can’t recall something that was covered in class and need a quick reminder? We’re happy to help! #jeffsays home | about | services | contact (775) 468-6874 | info@odmdefense.com 2559 Precision Dr, Ste 1 Minden, NV 89423 Echo 6 Industries, LLC is a retail, training and manufacturing business and intellectual property that provides safe, practical defensive training to civilians of all skill levels and disciplines, as well as quality thermoplastic retention systems, and retail service.
