Services ODM Defense Home Calendar Holsters Instructors Services Deposits Contact Media Home Calendar Holsters Instructors Services Deposits Contact Media Services Safe and practical self-defense, firearms, & emergency medical training for an unsafe world. Training Courses & Services State of Nevada cONCEALED CARRY CLASS ($120) - Renewals ($60) We offer one of the most in-depth and comprehensive concealed carry classes in Northern Nevada. The state mandates an 8hr minimum block of instruction, but we push a little beyond that to make sure you are getting the information and training you need to apply for your Nevada state carry permit. We cover basic safety, handling, nomenclature, basic shooting skills, force continuum, laws and regulations, all with a heavy emphasis on mindset. The course time covers the instruction portion, range qualification, and written exam. Completion certificates are handed out at the successful completion of the course. Lady’s only safety and pistol orientation ($100) The shooting world can be intimidating and overpowering to new shooters. There a lot of “Type-A” personalities out there, a lot of self-proclaimed “subject matter experts” that claim to be the end-all-be-all of range ninjas. This can make trying to get involved in shooting very daunting for some. We believe truly that comfort equals confidence. Our Lady’s Only classes provide a safe, low pressure environment where women can feel comfortable learning and asking questions. The class is geared more towards novice or first-time shooters that may want to learn more about firearms and safety in general. You do not need to own a gun to attend this class. The class consists of a 2 hr evening classroom session with no live firearms. It is strictly safety, proper handling and manipulation, and basic shooting fundamentals. We then meet up at the range for a 2 hr demonstration. All handguns and ammunition are provided, though you are welcome to bring your own firearm if you choose to! indoor shooting simulator Our shooting simulator provides users an opportunity to hone their shooting skills without the requirement of live ammunition. Through a combination of private instruction and the use of green-gas operated laser training pistols, the user gets positive feedback from the firearm cycling, while being coached on proper technique. This is a great way to greatly improve accuracy while solidifying basic fundamentals and techniques. It’s also a fun way to blow off some steam! The simulator can be booked as instructor led training, or for basic individual and groups by the hour. Tactical Advantage ($250) We are living in some extremely strange times! We are seeing more more acts of violence across the country with random targeting and zero provocation. Sadly, in these violent situations, when seconds count, help is MINUTES away! No one is coming. It is up to you. YOU are your own first responder. Our EDC Skills class is designed to give the shooter the skills, abilities, and confidence needed to carry a concealed firearm for personal defense, and the ability to deploy that defensive tool in a time of need. In our EDC Skills course, we discuss the mindset necessary in self defense situations. We will discuss equipment selection and options available to best suit the needs of the student. A heavy emphasis is placed on mechanics, fundamentals, and technique needed to get the gun into the fight quickly and accurately. The student can expect repetitions on draw technique, combat marksmanship, multiple target engagement, movement shooting, cover and concealment, reloading technique, malfunction and clearance manipulation, shooting from retention, stress inoculation, and some scenario based shooting focusing on rapid decision making. Requirements for this course: a valid CCW Permit demonstrating a basic knowledge of firearms handling and proficiency, carry pistol, holster, at least one (2) magazines minimum, magazine carrier, cover garment, and 250 rounds of ammunition (minimum). More ammo means more live fire drill repetitions. Pistol development (level I, II, III) ($125-$250) Let’s face it, we can’t all be John Wick. But what we can do, is train as hard and as disciplined as we can to become better, more proficient shooters than we were yesterday! And who knows, with enough time on the range, maybe someday you could find yourself in the lobby of the Continental. Until then, we train. Our pistol curriculum is designed to improve the abilities and confidence of all levels of shooters. From our introduction Level I class, up through our advanced Level III class, and everything in between. Safety, proficiency, gun handling skills, platform familiarity, mechanics, induced stress, and mindset are just a few of the things you will learn to overcome and master during our instruction. Requirements: Proof of successful completion of preceding course Quality belt, pistol, holster, 3 magazines (minimum), magazine carrier (2 singles or one double recommended), eye protection, hearing protection, 250 rds (minimum) Tactical Advantage ($250) This course is essentially a truncated version of our Handgunner II and our Rifleman II class rolled into one day. This course is intended for the intermediate shooter who already has a solid grasp on basic fundamentals and is ready to move to a higher level. The student must provide documentation showing training previously completed that covers introductory level skills. This is a fast paced course that covers a lot of information quickly. The first third of the day will encompass pistol work, the middle of the day will encompass rifle work, and the trail third of the day will involve use of both platforms in both drills and scenario based training. At the end of this class, students will have a solid working knowledge of pistol and rifle manipulation, reloading and malfunction resolution, proper implementation, and decision making skills that will make the student a better, more proficient defensive shooter. Requirements: Proof of successful completion of prior training Quality Belt, Pistol, Holster, 3 pistol magazines (minimum), magazine carrier (2 singles or one double recommended), Rifle, sling, 2 rifle magazines (minimum), rifle magazine carrier, eye protection, hearing protection, 200 rds pistol ammo, 200 rds rifle ammo TAC-Med (CPR/AED, First-Aid, Stop the bleed) Being able to make holes is important when it comes to defending yourself, but when seconds count, help is minutes away. This also holds true for medical response. You may be put in a position where medical aid is essential and there’s no one there to provide it. This class encompasses several aspects of emergency first aid: Stop the Bleed, First Aid, and CPR. Our TacMed class is AHA certified! once you complete this training you will receive your CPR Certification. This is a very thorough course, covering knife and gunshot wounds, wound packing, tourniquet use, chest seals, bandage application, and CPR implementation. This class is open to all age groups! rifle build class *Kit Dependent ($500-$1500+) Ever wanted to have that custom AR-15 to play with but didn’t know how to make it happen? In this class, builders will select their wants formalist of components. Once those components are ordered and delivered, builders than come in and build their very own rifle, to their specifications, with their own hands under the tutelage of our armorers. You leave the class with your very own, one of a kind, custom hand-built rifle! And normally for less cost then if you were to buy one off the shelf! RIFLE development (Level I, II, III) ($125-$250) Whether it be the first time shooter or the top level 3-gun competitor, we all want to become more proficient with our long guns. Our Carbine courses are designed for the shooter to become more comfortable and seamless in their rifle controls manipulation. Our carbine courses focus on clean manipulation and mechanics to establish proper “muscle memory”

All ages and skill levels are welcome. Parking and bathrooms are available at the Incline Village Recreation Center at 980 Incline Way, Incline Village. For updates and more information, visit the Incline Parks & Recreation Facebook page . Incline Village Bike Park overview video on Vimeo. RULES Helmets are required Please respect rain/snow/maintenance closures of the park (help keep our dirt rideable by staying off of it when it’s wet) Please obey all posted signs and rules E-bikes, including Surrons and Super 73, are NOT allowed in the park The bike park is open during daylight hours VISION Incline Bike Park Project seeks to share its passion for cycling amongst the active outdoor community in Incline Village, Nevada, by building a sustainable recreation asset, one that aligns with the healthy living of Incline Village. MISSION Incline Bike Park Project’s mission is to provide a free-to-use bike park facility that welcomes all ages and skill levels to a safe, outdoor, healthy, family-friendly community gathering venue. Incline Bike Park Project is dedicated to building a full spectrum riding experience that will unite the world-class recreational riding experiences around Lake Tahoe. WHO WE ARE A group of community-committed Tahoe cycling enthusiasts who have created a not-for-profit organization in partnership with Incline-Tahoe Parks and Recreation Vision Foundation & Incline Tahoe Foundation. DONATIONS ACCEPTED Holman Family Bike Park History In early 2014, Incline Bike Project (IBP) was formed by an enthusiastic and interested group of Incline Village/Crystal Bay residents, in partnership with the Incline Tahoe Foundation (ITF), a 501(c)3 entity, to facilitate fundraising to design and construct a community bike park. Bike parks, or pump tracks are becoming increasingly popular. It is a park with a continuous loop of dirt berms and “rollers” (smooth dirt mounds) that you ride without pedaling. The origins are rooted from the hardpack BMX trails of the 1970/1980s. In the early 2000s, a group of Australian downhill racers designed and developed the first pump track. A pump track builds confidence, strength, balance, and bike handling skills – not to mention it provides great social benefits. They are safe and fun to ride for all ages and skill levels. Incline Village General Improvement District (IVGID) and IBP collaborated and proposed a project plan to build a community Bike Park. Passes Golf Events & Programs Local Clubs Disc Golf The Incline Village Disc Golf course is a course consisting of 18 par 3s in a picturesque setting located adjacent to the Incline Village Recreation Center, skateboard park and Ridgeline Park ball fields. This is a multiuse area to be enjoyed by all ages. Parking is available at the Recreation Center located at 980 Incline Way. Parking is not permitted at the Incline Tennis & Pickleball Center. The 1st hole is located on the west side of the Recreation Center entrance road. Discs available for rent or sale Need a disc or a full set? The Recreation Center has discs available to rent ($5 per disc/day) or to purchase (price varies). Please adhere to the course rules: This is a multiuse area. Please respect our neighbors, the environment and other users. No glass, littering or loud music. Please adhere to the course M – Mandatory signs. If your disc lands in water: one stroke penalty and play out (10-15 feet) of stream zone. Please do not throw from out of bounds areas including any tennis courts, pickleball courts, ball fields or roadways. No Smoking or open fires of any kind! It’s the forest and fire danger is high. Enjoy the course. Course Rules, Map & Scorecard – Download 2-page PDF Map & Scorecard (PDF) Disc Golf Course Project History & Future Construction of a disc or frisbee golf course began late summer of 2011 after approval by the IVGID Board of Trustees. The Disc Golf Course construction was funded through private donations from community clubs, businesses and individuals. In July 2011, The North Lake Tahoe Lions Club donated $10,000 to partially fund the course. Remaining funding was raised through Incline-Tahoe Foundation , by individual business and family hole sponsorships. The Incline Tahoe Foundation is currently collecting funds to help with future improvements and upkeep of this facility. Visit the Disc Golf Course project page at InclineTahoe.org for more information or to make a donation. Recreation Center, Beach Picnic Areas, Parks and Fields The Recreation Center offers year-round facilities for birthday parties, group fitness room, indoor gymnasium, and indoor pool. Adjacent to the Recreation Center, the new Bocce Park is a great outdoor space that is available for parties and rentals. On the west end of town, Preston Park is another great location for a family gathering, work outing or your child’s birthday party. In addition, Village Green, Preston Field and Ridgeline Park offer wide open spaces for activities and have multi-use fields for your softball and baseball needs for tournaments, family reunions, or corporate events. For IVGID Picture Pass Holders (with beach access), Incline and Burnt Cedar beaches have picnic areas to reserve for your spring or summer event. No longer do you need to arrive hours before your event to secure a spot for your group. The designated beach sites include picnic tables offering you and your friends an area to picnic or grill and enjoy the beach. The volleyball courts and bocce area is also now available for group rentals. Each guest is still responsible for beach access fees. Reservations at all sites are taken on a first-come, first-served basis at the Parks & Recreation Counter. Please call (775) 832-1310 or stop by and see us for rates or more information. Payment is required with your application. Rent individual courts or rent the entire Pickleball Center (15 upper courts). The newly renovated deck can also be rented for events. Our 37,000 square foot, first-class complex boasts a wide variety of activities for all ages and interests. The Recreation Center offers a vast selection of memberships and equipment for you and your family to enjoy. With a myriad of activities and fitness classes available, we have a place for your workout! Recreation Center Daily & Membership Rates (PDF) Cancel a Membership To cancel a membership you must come into the Recreation Center and fill out a cancelation form by the 21st day of the month prior to the month you wish to cancel. Forms will not be mailed or faxed. Call the Front Desk at (775) 832-1310 for more information. New Member Orientation If you are a new member to the Incline Village Recreation Center, you may sign up for a complimentary “get acquainted” orientation. New members will receive a facility tour, an overview of the fitness/weight room, and some helpful program and class information. Call (775) 832-1310 to make an appointment. (IVGID Picture Card holders are exempt from pre-booking fees.) Cancellation policy: Fill out the Golf Contact Form and select “Tee Time Cancellation” to cancel tee time reservations. Cancel at least 72 hours prior to your tee time to avoid cancelation fees. 50% of green fees will be charged for cancellations made between 72 – 48 hours of tee time. Within 48 hours of tee time, full green fees will be charged for all golfers in your party. Pre-booking fees, if applicable, are non-refundable for all cancelations. Single Players: Single players may only join an existing group. Please call the Golf Shop and we will do our best to pair you with other golfers. Check-In Procedures: Golf cart keys will be in the Golf Shop for all carts. Public Check-In Procedure: Each golfer responsible for their tee time or their group’s tee time will be required to check in with the Golf Shop and pick up a receipt for the Starter. A golfer who is not responsible for payment, or someone in their group, will only be able to check themselves in for golf. IVGID Check-In Procedure: All IVGID Picture Pass Holders within a group must check themselves in individually and show their IVGID Pass. You may not check in other IVGID Pass Holders. Verification of a valid IVGID Picture Pass will be the only way to receive the IVGID Pass rates. Rider / Non-Player Fee: Non-player riders are welcome, but they must pay a rider fee of $35 per person at the Championship Course, or $20 per person (18 holes) / $15 per person (9 holes) at the Mountain Course. The rider must accompany a player. Cart Fee: Green fees include a shared golf cart. The single cart fee is $35 (Championship Course) or $25 (Mountain Course) for golfers who want to ride solo (subject to availability). Passes Golf Events & Programs Local Clubs Transfer of Service In order to transfer service to a new owner we will need to receive notification at least two business days prior to close of escrow. Water and sewer services are not interrupted upon change of ownership. Service is not transferred until a Grant Deed has been received from the title company. The details below also provide other helpful information to ensure accuracy upon close of escrow. Buyers can contact our office to provide their contact information, but water and sewer utilities follow the property. Once we receive a copy of the Grant Deed after close of escrow we can transfer service. Processing change of ownership upon sale For single, multi-family and commercial properties (excluding HOA accounts or vacant land) For all changes of ownership due to sale we will require a minimum of 2 working days notice, prior to the close of escrow, to schedule a final read on the water meter. Please call our office to notify us of the estimated close of escrow date and a request for final meter read. By the morning of the close of escrow date we will provide you with the current balance on the account and the consumption charges due from the final meter read. IVGID does not prorate balances on accounts so the final read breakdown will include the base rate charges for the account (which are billed in advance). If a final meter read is not requested the new owner will be liable for the past consumption charges on the account. Other helpful information to ensure accuracy upon close of escrow If the leak notification is set at the time of collecting a final meter read IVGID will advise escrow so all parties can be informed. This is a courtesy notification and IVGID will not require a leak be fixed. When a demand is submitted for completion, we will complete the information requested or indicate if the property is located within an HOA which pays the water/sewer charges or is vacant land. We will also send the demand to the IVGID Recreation department for them to indicate if there are passes which need to be returned upon sale. Our billing cycle is the 19th to the 18th of each month. Our base rates are billed on the 19th of the month in advance for this time period. Consumption charges are billed in arrears based on water and sewer use at the property. IVGID does not prorate charges and water and sewer services and charges are continuous through change of ownership. If the customer has Auto Payment set for their account, we will cancel auto payment once a final read is completed. If duplicate payment is made after the close of escrow date, we will deposit the title company check and issue a refund check to the seller. Upon close of escrow we need to receive a copy of the Deed (excluding properties in an HOA), even if there is not a check being submitted, as well as a contact phone number(s) for the customer. A separate demand for refuse charges must be sent to Waste Management by email: dpayoffs@wm.com. Refuse rates are billed quarterly in advance on October 1, January 1, April 1, and July 1. It's your training partner, your escape, your race machine, and often your favorite way to experience the mountains, roads, and trails that surround us. At Free Lap Collective, we approach every bike with that understanding. Whether you're preparing for a major event, chasing personal goals, or simply looking to keep your bike performing at its best, our service process is built around professionalism, communication, and attention to detail. From the moment your bike enters our workshop, our team performs a thorough assessment to understand its condition, identify potential issues, and recommend solutions tailored to your riding style and goals. We believe exceptional service starts with honest communication, which is why we take the time to explain our recommendations and help you make informed decisions about your equipment. We specialize in road, gravel, and mountain bikes and work with many of the industry's most respected brands and components. From routine maintenance to complete overhauls, every service is performed with precision, care, and an uncompromising commitment to quality. What truly sets Free Lap apart is the experience. Our workshop isn't hidden behind closed doors, it's an extension of our community. Customers are encouraged to ask questions, learn about their equipment, and become part of the process. We take pride in building long-term relationships that continue well beyond the completion of a tune-up or repair. Because great service isn't measured by the day you pick up your bike. It's measured by every ride that follows. Schedule your service appointment using the contact form below The Custom Experience at Free Lap A custom build should be as unique as the rider who owns it. At Free Lap Collective, every custom build begins with a conversation. We take the time to understand your riding goals, fit requirements, aesthetic preferences, and the type of experience you want from your bike. Whether you're dreaming of a lightweight climbing bike, a purpose built gravel machine, or just something fun and unique, we guide you through every detail of the process. Our carefully curated portfolio of brands and components allows us to create truly personalized bicycles that aren't limited by standard stock specifications. Frame, wheels, drivetrain, cockpit, tires, saddle, and finishing details are all selected with purpose to create a bike that reflects both your performance goals and personal style. Every build is assembled in-house with meticulous attention to detail. We obsess over the small things because we know those details can define the ride experience. The result is more than a custom bicycle. It's a collaborative process that transforms an idea into a one-of-a-kind machine built specifically for you. From the first consultation to the final handoff and beyond, our team is committed to delivering an experience that is every bit as exceptional as the bike itself. Caution needed with the presence of many users: pedestrians, baby strollers, joggers, pets on leashes, river rafters, and fisherman. Trailhead: Starting your ride at the parking area, next to the Transit Center, cross the bike/ped bridge to connect to the bike path and turn left. GPS: 39.164629, -120.147293 (Tahoe City Transit Center) GPS: 39.204733, -120.199446 (Squaw Valley entrance) The Bike Ride: Historic Truckee River Bike Path: This is a great ride for the entire family – its level, relaxing and beautiful. You cruise alongside the Truckee River to the entrance of Squaw Valley. Along the way are several places to turn out to absorb the natural beauty of the river’s eco-system. During the summer months, the river is most popular for rafting and you can literally see hundreds of people enjoying a fun-filled flow down to River Ranch Resort – where they exit and is a great local spot for food, refreshments, and entertainment Preview Ride: Historical: You are riding along the original Tahoe-Truckee Toll Road built in 1860 to enable horse-drawn freight and passenger wagons to travel between the Lake and Truckee. The river was used to float logs downstream to the mills in Truckee, and during the winter months the frozen river became a natural supplier of much needed ice for the mining operations in Virginia City. Later in the 1880’s, this route became the corridor for a narrow gauge railroad hauling logs to the Truckee mills, and then in the early 1900’s automobiles traveled on what was then called the Truckee Turnpike. This was an important transportation route for commerce, freight, and tourists traveling from Tahoe to Truckee and beyond to Sacramento, San Francisco, and Reno. Replacing our popular Enduro HC, the Freeride Carbon is set up with the best of everything and ready to take on nearly anything you can throw at it. From the wide range of gearing to the 2.80 MAXXIS tires, this bike is built for rough terrain. The M600 motor with torque and cadence sensing provides a natural riding feel, giving you power when you want it while providing the ability to navigate low-speed obstacles smoothly. Beyond the awesome specifications, these bikes are gorgeous, whether selected in Vivid Red, Forest Green or Cosmic Blue. Call for Pricing REGULAR PRICE: $5999 SALE PRICE: $3999 LIMITED SUPPLY Sale! Color Choose an option Blue Green Hi-Viz Clear - Concept Freeride Carbon quantity + Add to cart M600 MOTOR Would you like a little more? The M600 motor – 500 watts rated power, 120Nm max. torque, just 3.9kg – always delivers top performance and is the first choice for modern eMTBs. With its triple sensor system (1 torque, 2 speed sensors) it reacts with lightning speed to your pedal-power input and delivers impressive support at all times. INTEGRATED BATTERY The Freeride Carbon has a sleek high-quality lithium-ion battery integrated with the down tube. This modern design combines impressive mileage, performance, a long lifetime and low weight with an ergonomic design and simple handling. HIGH QUALITY PARTS Every Concept E-Bike is designed in Carson City, Nevada with our riders in mind. They are crafted with select, brand name components from the ground up. Our ideology is that our electric bikes are only as strong as the weakest part, so we don't cut corners and pay attention to the smallest of details. Small details make the biggest of differences and its the first thing you will notice when riding our bikes. AIR FORKS With bigger bikes, there come bigger demands. Thankfully, we picked the Rockshox 35 to offer great performance and value. Whether you are e-powered or 'au naturel', 35 Gold checks the box with our proven DebonAir™ air spring and Motion Control™ damping. 35 Gold versions are available with mounting points for optional short or full fenders. All told, you may wonder how we packed so much quality and performance into such a wallet-friendly package. Performance Parts Riders can go further: A robust drive that’s perfect for sports outings, training sessions, or long, hilly mountain rides. Wheel size: MAXXIS DHF/DHR Minion 27.5 x 2.80 Tires Seat Post: Promax seat post Crankset: 38T chainring with 150mm cranks for increased ground clearance. pages.text: Shaun's Guide Service | Donner Lake Fishing Guide Shaun's Guide Service Home About Gallery Book a Trip Shaun's Guide Service Over 40 years of fishing experience. Full-time since 2015. Licensed, bonded, and insured. Book Your Trip Call 530-802-4484 40+ Years Fishing 139+ Mackinaw Over 10 lbs 6 Guests Per Trip 365 Days a Year Donner Lake Collins Lake Sacramento River Feather River Stampede Reservoir Boca Reservoir Prosser Creek Reservoir Why Fish With Shaun Personal guided trips for up to six people, plus instruction on your own boat 🐟 Trophy Mackinaw Pro Big Mackinaw are Shaun's specialty. Since 2015, over 139 lake trout over 10 pounds have been caught and released. Spring is prime time for monster Mackinaw, plus a solid shot at big browns. 🛡️ Licensed & Insured US Coast Guard License #7611440. California Department of Fish and Wildlife guide license #1000439. Fully bonded and insured. 🗺️ Multiple Waterways Guided trips on Donner Lake, Stampede, Boca, and Prosser Creek reservoirs, plus spring Striped Bass and fall-run King Salmon on the Sacramento and Feather rivers. Year-round operation. Your Next Adventure Starts Here What You'll Catch Trophy Lake Trout (Mackinaw), eating-size Mackinaw, German Brown trout, Kokanee, King Salmon, Rainbow trout, and Striped Bass. Shaun will make sure your day is filled with catching experiences. Donner Lake — Lake Trout (Mackinaw) all year, Rainbows all year, and Kokanee June to November Sacramento & Feather Rivers — Chinook (King) Salmon August to December. Striped Bass (Stripers) March to mid-May Stampede & Boca Reservoirs — Kokanee (if they're not tiny), mid-May to September Prosser Creek Reservoir — Lahontan Cutthroat Trout and Rainbow Trout, June to August Collins Lake — Rainbow Trout November and April All fishing times change with weather. What Clients Say Real reviews from real trips ★★★★★ We fished with Shaun in early June on a Veteran's fishing day. We fished Stampede Reservoir. We were all back at the dock by 11:00 with limits for each of us. Shaun is a knowledgeable and hard working guide. Thank you Shaun for a fun and productive morning on the water. — Artie M. ★★★★★ I'd give Shaun 10 stars if they let me, what a great experience. He put us on the monsters all day and we had such an awesome time relaxing with him and his adorable pooch. Pulling in 2 lakers over 10 lbs and then fish after fish after fish didn't hurt either. I will be going with Shaun's guide service for many years to come. — Morgan P. ★★★★★ Awesome day on the water with Shaun's guide service. He knows the Donner Lake fishery very well and will put you on fish all day. We caught limits of fish early and had a great time. I recommend Shaun and would love to go out with him again! — Pear ★★★★★ Wanted to take my 5 year old son on our first fishing experience and Shaun was great. Son had a blast and Shaun was a great guide. — Arian C. ★★★★★ Shaun recently took our family (3 younger kids) on a fishing trip in the Tahoe area. He delivered on his promise of getting us 25 fish (our limit), and we then ate fish for days! Shaun was a great fishing educator for the kids. — Matt K. B ook a tour for you and your friends or family for a couple of hours or for an entire day. Or, come and enjoy an e vening sunset trip with us, relaxing and taking in the spectacular beauty of Lake Tahoe. All tours include fuel, Captain, complimentary beverages and a fresh fruit plate. It’s the perfect highlight to your Tahoe experience. Book Now Special Emerald Bay Cruise 2 hours, morning or sunset We also offer a 2 hour Emerald Bay tour for $600.00. Enjoy Eagle Falls and all the sights of the South Shore of Lake Tahoe. This special tour also includes fuel, Captain, complimentary beverages and a fresh fruit plate. I highly recommend. Phil M Customer This business just opened in 2017 and is preparing to become a major boat service company in South Lake Tahoe and is remodeling their large facility. Pat, formerly of South Shore Boat Co, is the service manager, and is very knowledgeable and does great work. The company has not done any advertising, nor has a website, so is hard to find on google. But they are very busy, just with word of mouth business and past relationships with Pat. They do a great job of winterizing and summerizing boats and I'm sure they do excellent repair work, although I haven't used them for that yet. Paul J Customer Can't say enough positive things about John and this company. We were in Tahoe last with a group of 12 for a week. We put our 2001 Super Air Nautique in the water late Thursday and drove it to our house in the keys. Friday morning when everyone was up and ready to go out, the boat wouldn't start. We spent several hours toying with it and calling numerous shops in the area, but none could offer any help for at least a week. I finally called LT Tahoe Boat Company, John answered, and I explained the situation. He said he'd give me a call later in the day. I wasn't holding my breath, but he actually did call back around 5pm. It was after work hours, but he threw some tools in his truck and drove by our house on a Friday evening. We were shocked to actually get some help. An hour later, John had fixed the issue and saved our week! The family and kids all had a great time boating for the rest of the week. Really awesome what he did for us. Saved our trip! Will definitely be the first place I call or go to for any boating needs any time I'm in Tahoe! Matt P. Customer I just moved to Tahoe from San Francisco. I'm used to have a one stop boat shop for storage, maintenance, and parts. This place is great! I just brought my Mastercraft X80 there for trailer/dry storage. It's a steal at their price for monthly storage. I was able to get a bunch of boat add ons and some spare parts at a very reasonable price. Very centrally locates as well. A must check out place for your Mastercraft or boat! Robert R. pages.text: Sailing Lessons, Racing, Private Group Charters and Bareboat Rentals on North Lake Tahoe | 1 Bristlecone st. Tahoe City CA 96145 top of page Lake Tahoe Sailing Home Charters Courses Laser Clinics Racing Book Online Regattas Privacy Policy Employment Contact Us Lake Conditions Blog More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. Log In Lake Tahoe Sailing Sailing is for everyone! We offer a variety of experiences from a mellow afternoon or evening charter to full on, adrenaline charged racing. We have experiences that are tailored to you. Anyone from age 5 and up can learn to sail in a safe controlled environment. WE MAKE SAILORS! Learn More Home: Welcome Home: Courses Sailing Charters on Lake Tahoe Hands on learn to sail or sit back and relax! If you want a fun sailing experience with your friends and family on Lake Tahoe you can charter our 33 foot monohull the "Aero" and create a memory you'll never forget. Take the helm and learn to sail or sit back and relax and take in the splendor of Lake Tahoe under sail. Our experienced skippers are in control. We offer 3 hour sailing experiences accommodating up to 6 with a minimum age of 5. Cost is $600 for a three hour experience. Sailing times are 2-5PM and 5:30 to 8:30PM daily. We provide the lifejackets you provide the smiles! Sailing is For Everyone We have a variety of Experiences from Mellow to Wet and Wild For new sailors and families sailing for the first time we recommend our most mellow experience which is a private group charter on our Hobie 33 pictured above top. If you want to solidify the basics and become proficient, sign up for our week long family or adult course on our Melges 24 Raceboat where we'll take you racing on Wednesday night! Once you have the basics you are ready to try Laser Sailing/Racing for Youth and Adults. The Laser is physical, very fast and tippy! This is where saling gets really exciting! Bring your wetsuit because you'll be swimming! ​ Call us at 530-412-1101 or email at william.n.pullen@gmail.com We Make Sailors! Lake Tahoe Sailing News Stay in the Loop Instructor Spotlight - Nick Pullen Introduced to sailing by his Grandfather at the age of 5, Nick went on to become a member of Canada's National Sailing Team in the Laser Class. For decades he's travelled world wide racing Lasers and Melges 24s. He's a former Canadian National Champion, competed in 12 world championships, and has logged over 4 thousand miles of blue water ocean sailing. Nick has coached with International Sailing Academy in Puerta Vallarta drawing from their methodologies. He's also a Licensed Coast Guard Captain and US Sailing Level 1 Instructor. Contact Instructor Spotlight - Tasha Hacker Tasha Hacker is a USCG certified Captain and US Sailing certified basic keelboat instructor. Before moving to Lake Tahoe, she spent 5 years sailing around the world on her own boat. She also competed on the winning boat, Henri Lloyd, in the 2013-14 Clipper Round the World Yacht Race. Prior to the pandemic, Tasha was teaching women to sail a 41-foot racing yacht in the Bahamas and the Caribbean on week-long journeys. Tasha now enjoys teaching day sailors of all levels on beautiful Lake Tahoe. Contact Join our Laser Race Team! We're looking for both boys and girls age 12-21 who LOVE sailing and sailboat racing. This is a high performance race team training 4 weeks in the summer with Nick Pullen and traveling to regattas and training events throughout the year on the west coast. ​ Joining the team is a big commitment and is for kids who really love the sport and want to become champions. The good news is that the boats are provided and there is funding for travel and coaching. ​ The investment required to participate is similar to downhill ski racing. Athletes are required to obtain sailing specific clothing for protection from the elements and pay for 4 weeks of coaching. ​ ​ Learn More Home: About Home: News & Updates Get in Touch 2500 Lake Forest Blvd, Tahoe City CA 96145 william.n.pullen@gmail.com (530) 412-1101 Home: Contact Mindset of a Champion Join our High Performance Race Team The Best Way to Introduce Sailing for Kids Home: Blog Feed Book Now Questions? Most soft tub customers use spa perfect once a month which helps the body oils break down that tend to collect on the liner. ahhNatural will not hurt the fabric and works great in the medium and large sizes. The smaller one will require support products. Smaller soft tubs are harder to maintain because the volume of water to body contaminates is super high. If you own the small size, please be aware that ahh will work but maintenace will be more than the medium and large size. PRO TIP: It's imperative that you keep your filters clean and use your jets often to aid in filtering out the body organics. Get in the habit of letting the jets run when you exit the tub and wiping the sides free of body oils regularly. Use Spa Perfect two times a month to help. The nature of the fabric collects oils and organics the slippery feel is part of owning a soft tub. Avoid lotions, potions and detergents from entering the tub. pages.text: CHAOS Estate Boutique | Place to Shop in Reno, NV - Chaos Reno: Expert Estate Sales & Organizing Services STORE ESTATE SALES CONTACT Shop our Store Wednesday - Sunday 11 am - 5 pm CHAOS Estate Boutique 1311 So. Virginia Street, Suite 105 Reno, NV 89502 Reno's Favorite Place to Shop. See the Hottest Estate Sale Finds! Meet Debbie Owner of CHAOS Estate Boutique Out of life's chaos come the stories, memories, and treasures that make a house feel like home. For more than thirteen years, I've had the privilege of helping families throughout Reno and Northern Nevada navigate life's transitions. Through my estate sale and organizing work, I've met incredible people and discovered thousands of fascinating items each with its own history and story. ​ Along the way, I kept thinking about how wonderful it would be to create a space where those treasures could live on and be appreciated by someone new. That idea eventually became CHAOS Estate Boutique. Today, our store offers nearly 5,000 square feet of carefully selected items a blend of vintage pieces, antiques, home d cor, collectibles, artwork, furniture, jewelry, books, rugs, and so much more. You'll also find hobby items, trains, sporting goods, electronics, kitchen pieces, costumes, and everyday items that still have plenty of life left in them. Some pieces arrive through estate sales we manage across Reno and Northern Nevada, while others come from trusted consignors who want their special items to find the right home. We also occasionally bring in new items and unique overstock finds to keep the store fresh and exciting. What makes CHAOS special is that nothing stays the same for long. Every week, new treasures arrive, displays change, and customers discover something unexpected. It's the kind of place where you can wander through the store and suddenly find the perfect gift, a beautiful piece of vintage d cor, or something you didn't even know you were looking for. My hope is that CHAOS Estate Boutique becomes a place people love to visit whether they're hunting for antiques, searching for collectibles, decorating their home, or simply enjoying the thrill of discovering something unique. If you enjoy the charm of vintage finds, estate treasures, and one-of-a-kind pieces, I invite you to come explore with us. You never know what treasure might be waiting for you. ​ Debbie "The store is set-up so nice, easy to shop, lots of great stuff!" Thanks for the Reviews! CHAOS Estate Boutique 1311 So. With its stunning natural beauty, numerous ski resorts, and world-class amenities, South Lake Tahoe has become a favorite destination for skiers and snowboarders from around the world. For those who love to ski but don't want to deal with the hassle and expense of owning a ski property, a ski lease in South Lake Tahoe may be the perfect solution. What is a Ski Lease? A ski lease is a rental agreement for a ski property that typically lasts for the duration of the ski season, which is usually from November through April. Unlike a traditional rental agreement, a ski lease is specifically designed for skiers and snowboarders who want to have a place to stay near the ski resorts during the winter months. Ski leases can range from a small studio apartment to a large, luxurious cabin, depending on your needs and budget. Benefits of a Ski Lease in South Lake Tahoe There are many benefits to leasing a ski property in South Lake Tahoe, including: Convenient access to the ski resorts: By leasing a property near the ski resorts, you'll be able to easily access the slopes without having to deal with the hassle of driving or parking. Many ski leases offer shuttle service to the resorts, so you can focus on enjoying your time on the mountain. Cost-effective: Skiing can be an expensive hobby, especially if you own a ski property. By leasing a property, you can save money on the upfront costs of buying a property, as well as the ongoing expenses of maintenance, property taxes, and utilities. Flexible: A ski lease allows you to enjoy the ski season without the commitment of owning a property year-round. You can choose the length of your lease, and if you decide you want to ski somewhere else next season, you're not tied to a specific property. Comfortable and convenient: Ski leases are often fully furnished and equipped with all the amenities you need to enjoy your time in South Lake Tahoe. Many leases include things like hot tubs, fireplaces, and fully equipped kitchens, so you can relax and enjoy your time off the slopes. Community: Ski leases often come with a built-in community of like-minded skiers and snowboarders. This can be a great way to meet new people and enjoy the social aspect of skiing. Choosing a Ski Lease in South Lake Tahoe When choosing a ski lease in South Lake Tahoe, there are a few things to keep in mind: Location: The location of your ski lease is important. You want to be close enough to the ski resorts to make it convenient, but not so close that you're dealing with crowds and noise. Look for a property that is in a quiet, peaceful location, but still within easy reach of the slopes. Amenities: Look for a ski lease that offers the amenities you need to enjoy your time off the slopes. This could include things like a hot tub, fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, and laundry facilities. Size: Consider the size of the property and the number of people in your group. You want to make sure that everyone has enough space to be comfortable. Price: Ski leases can vary widely in price, so it's important to find a property that fits your budget. Keep in mind that you'll also need to budget for things like lift tickets, equipment rentals, and food and drink. Availability: Ski leases can fill up quickly, so it's important to start your search early and be flexible with your dates. If you have specific dates in mind, be sure to book early to ensure availability. South Lake Tahoe is home to some of the best ski resorts in the world, including Heavenly Ski Resort, Kirkwood Mountain Resort, and Sierra-at-Tahoe Resort. Each resort offers a unique skiing experience, with a variety of terrain for all skill levels. Heavenly Ski Resort is the largest resort in South Lake Tahoe, with over 4,800 skiable acres and 97 runs. The resort boasts stunning views of Lake Tahoe and the surrounding mountains, and offers a variety of terrain for skiers and snowboarders of all levels. The resort also offers a variety of other activities, including zip lining, ice skating, and snowshoeing. Kirkwood Mountain Resort is known for its challenging terrain, with over 2,300 skiable acres and 86 runs. The resort is located at a higher elevation than the other resorts in South Lake Tahoe, which means it often has more snow and better conditions. Kirkwood also offers backcountry skiing and snowboarding, making it a popular destination for experienced skiers. Sierra-at-Tahoe Resort is a smaller resort with over 2,000 skiable acres and 46 runs. The resort is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and excellent beginner and intermediate terrain. Sierra-at-Tahoe also offers terrain parks and a halfpipe for freestyle skiers and snowboarders. No matter which resort you choose, a ski lease in South Lake Tahoe is the perfect way to enjoy all the skiing and snowboarding the area has to offer. With its stunning natural beauty, world-class amenities, and excellent skiing, South Lake Tahoe is a must-visit destination for any winter sports enthusiast. Conclusion A ski lease in South Lake Tahoe is a convenient, cost-effective, and comfortable way to enjoy all the skiing and snowboarding the area has to offer. With its stunning natural beauty, world-class amenities, and excellent skiing, South Lake Tahoe is the perfect destination for winter sports enthusiasts. Whether you're looking for a challenging ski experience or a family-friendly atmosphere, there's a ski resort in South Lake Tahoe that's perfect for you. So why wait? pages.text: Wanna Ride Tahoe – WannaRideTahoe.com Home Pricing Trails Info Partners Rent Bikes Kayaks Paddleboards Blog Contact us Select Page Wanna Ride Tahoe Shuttle (775) 790-6375 Lake Tahoe TRAIL SHUTTLE SERVICE for Mountain Bikers and Hikers The Trails are Calling!!! We have already kicked-off the 2024 season and are taking reservations for all Tahoe trails. Please provide the following information when making your shuttle reservation: Preferred date/time of shuttle Pick-up location Drop-off location Number of passengers – bikes/backpacks, etc… Primary contact Email address/phone number Contact us at 775-790-6375 for our summer specials. We thank you for your cooperation and we look forward to seeing you soon! About Us Founded in 2008, Wanna Ride is South Lake Tahoe’s first trail shuttle, providing point-to-point mountain bike and hiking shuttle service throughout the region. There are many great mountain bike rides and hikes in and around the Lake Tahoe basin that are best accessed by shuttle! We provide Shuttle Service to and between Luther Pass, Echo Summit, Kingsbury Grade and Spooner Summit. Some of the more popular trails that we shuttle are Mr. Toad’s Wild Ride, The Stinger Trail, Van Sickle Downhill, The Kingsbury Bench and all of the Tahoe Rim Trail trailheads (Big Meadows, Tahoe Meadows, Emerald Bay, Meeks Bay, Barker Pass Road, etc…) We operate daily from 8 AM until 7 PM. Shuttles can be scheduled outside of our normal hours of operation by making your reservation in advance. Reservation Information Reservation office hours: Daily 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM Reservations must be made at least one day in advance. (7+) US Coast Guard Regulation (US federal law ) : “GREAT DAY ON THE LAKE! Awesome day on the lake! Captain Scott was great. Everyone had a great time. We had a large group of 17 people and everyone felt that they go their turn (six participants at a time). I would highly recommend this – it’s like having a friend with a boat and toys. We didn’t need to worry about anything other than having fun .” – Vicki G US Coast Guard Lake Tahoe: The crystal blue waters can lure water-goers into a false sense of security. Unpredictable mountain weather patterns can change rapidly, turning a calm outing on the lake into a rough day on the sea. High winds and eight-foot waves are not uncommon on Lake Tahoe. “I don’t think people realize how dangerous this lake can get in a few minutes,” says Petty Officer 2nd Class Kauakea Colon. It’s dangerous. You just don’t know what lies beneath the surface. Depending on the weather, it can kill you.” Stretching 22 miles long and 12 miles wide, the crew has a lot of water to cover. The station responds to about 150 search and rescue cases each summer. “We’re non-stop when the busy season gets here. Memorial Day through Labor Day, you don’t sit down at all,” says Petty Officer 2nd Class Megan Archer. “We’re up from sunrise until midnight, then we go to bed to get our eight hours of rest and we’re up the next day doing the same exact thing again.” Don’t risk having your rental cut short and a US Coast Guard fine for overcrowding, swamping/sinking/drowning. Keep Tahoe Safe, choose a responsible boat company who obeys the law. Babes on a Boat keeps you safer . All boat rental companies on Lake Tahoe must operate in compliance with US Coast Guard regulations (US federal law) On Lake Tahoe and other Federal Waterways the US Coast Guard regulation requires commercial vessels less than 100 gross tons limit capacity to 6 passengers not including captain/crew: link Lake Tahoe boating conditions are similar to the ocean: deep, rough and windy; not like your typical low altitude lake back home and can get dangerous, very quickly. Pontoon boats are a less than optimal rental in these conditions, choose wisely. That’s why the US Coast Guard is stationed on Lake Tahoe! LEARN MORE: 8SEP19 OVERCROWDED RENTAL BOATER DEATH (NOT Babes on a Boat) Most of our Clients have more than 6 participants in their Group: “We booked Captain Scott for a full day and it was an absolute blast! We offer targets, target systems, and stands to the general public. Who We Are and What We Target For years, Take Aim Targets has designed and marketed target systems used by law enforcement agencies for advanced training in rifles, shotguns, and pistols. Now, we are offering systems for shooting enthusiast. Our modular systems feature quick setup, replaceable components, and additional accessories to make one target system meet every shooter’s needs. Whether your style of shooting is prone, standing, kneeling, or sitting, you can be assured the target systems we sell will meet your needs. Our law enforcement partners have sent thousands of rounds at our targets with the confidence the system will continue performing. Whether in-service training or specialized S.W.A.T. training, our target systems will meet the expectation of law enforcement or the shooting enthusiast. Take Aim Targets allows for a quick and easy setup in multiple configurations for convenient and repeatable target shooting. Which Target Is Right for You? Use the charts below to determine which product will best suit your needs. All Take Aim Targets are made with certified US AR500 grade steel. Each target is powder coated with a color indicating its thickness. The transformer was developed with the concept of one versatile stand to be used in many different applications. All transformer stands are able to utilize both 18” and 24” paper targets supported from 1x2 wooden lath found at any home improvement store. The 29” Deluxe adds the option of using a 2x4 to support more target options such as our 2-plate rack, swivel target systems as well as 14-gun racks. The 44” Deluxe will expand your options even further by adding the ability to use a 2x2 wooden lath with our crossbar to hang all our sniper targets from the two squares up to our precision sniper target and everything in between. A durable 3/16” formed steel base with removable legs is featured on all transformers. The legs conveniently store underneath the stand for easy storage. The durable powder-coated finish, fully welded assembly, and ease of use will provide years of dependability. Each pass comes with a number of incredible benefits. Visit our Season Pass Benefits page to learn which come with each pass option! Benefits Overview Do you offer an Adaptive Season Pass? Yes, Sierra-at-Tahoe offers an Adaptive Season Pass, typically available to purchase in the fall. Click the button, below, to learn more. Learn More Cancellation + Deferral Policy Deferral Form Cancellation requests received by 11/15/2026: Season Pass and other seasonal products are non-refundable and non-transferable. Any qualifying 2026-27 seasonal product can be deferred for a resort credit to use during the 2027-28 season. Deferrals requested by 11/15/2026 for any reason will receive a resort credit for value paid , less the onsite ticket or program rate per day, for any days used from date of purchase through 11/15/2026. Any pass usage recorded after 11/15/2026 invalidates a deferral request. Resort credit will not be applied to a 2027-28 product until May 1, 2027. Resort credit cannot be redeemed for cash value and refunds will not be given for 2026-27 products of lesser value. The Play It Forward Guarantee is available for seasonal products purchased for the 2026-27 season only and is not applicable for any extended products. If you choose to use your resort credit during the 2026-27 season, original purchase price will not be honored. Prices are based on the current rate at time of re-purchase, and you will be responsible for any price difference incurred. Refunds will not be given for a lesser value product. Deferral requests received AFTER 11/15/2026: Season Passes and other seasonal products are non-refundable and non-transferable. In the case of documented medical reasons (a physician’s statement is required) that prevent the product holder from skiing/riding for the remainder of the season, a resort credit may be issued. Medical conditions must occur prior to March 15, 2027, and Season Pass must not have been used after the initial symptoms to be eligible for any credit. Days used will be charged at the onsite ticket/program rate per day plus a processing fee of $50. Resort credit is valid for a 2027-28 season pass only and can be used starting May 1, 2027 . Cancellation requests do not extend to family members. Cancellation requests must be received prior to 04/01/2027. No refunds or credits will be given on seasonal products which are not picked up or used. All rates subject to change without notice. 2026-27 Season Pass product eligibility is determined by passholder’s age as of November 1, 2026. How Do I Pick Up My Season Pass? First Time Pass Purchasers : After purchasing your season pass online , NEW * passholders will be required to take a upload a photo of themselves for their season pass. This can be done in our online store or at the Season Pass Office at the resort. We highly encourage doing this online to save time and get you on the mountain faster. *A one-time ticketing fee will be added on to all first time pass purchases. When renewing your Season Pass onto the same card, you will not have to pay this fee. Renewing Pass Purchasers : Reloading your Season Pass card is simple. Visit the online store, login to your account associated with your Pass and purchase. Your new Season Pass will automatically be renewed and you may proceed directly to the lift. You can also bring your existing Season Pass card to the Season Pass Office for assistance. Misplaced your season pass or lift ticket card? No sweat, Sierra can replace it! Season Passes can be replaced at the Season Pass Office. There will be a small fee to replace a lost or forgotten Season Pass. Whether you’re conquering the winter’s embrace or preparing for a sun-drenched escape, we present an exclusive collection of premium winter wear, sophisticated swimwear, and more, all designed to elevate your adventure. Unearth the refined essentials you may have missed, along with one-of-a-kind souvenirs and collectible treasures—perfect for gifting or preserving as a luxurious keepsake. No matter where your journey leads, the Boutique ensures you explore the world with elegance, confidence, and timeless style. pages.text: Safer Terrain Park Jumps | Precision Approach AIR INTELLIGENCE™ Skip to content Our App Tubing App For Operators Safety Our Story Let’s talk Login Mobile Nav SEND IT, STICK IT , SHARE IT VIDEO OF YOUR JUMP TO YOUR PHONE IN SECONDS For Riders For Riders For Parents Get the App For Riders Less guess, start to progress Real time approach speed awareness for less guesswork. Enjoy instant replays of every jump to track progress, improve your skills, and share with your friends and family NOTE: Center light may be either green or white. DOWNLOAD APP, GET STARTED NOW! Just download the AIR INTELLIGENCE™ App for instant videos of each jump. Review them for fun with your friends, family or coaches. MORE Information. LESS GUESSWORK AIR INTELLIGENCE™ provides the feedback you need to approach jumps with more confidence. Introducing Air Intelligence TM LiDAR technology helps with the “spotting” (visual confirmation of an all clear landing zone) detecting obstacles and warning you when a rider is still in the landing zone. Note the red X during the last approach when a person is in the landing area Our App Get Instant Video Access Get instant access to videos with the Precision Approach app. Share your favorite content online with friends and family effortlessly. Enjoy seamless video engagement today! CAUTION: Risk of severe injury is inherent to using terrain park jumps. Our display unit should not be interpreted as instruction or encouragement to attempt any jump feature. Ride/jump at own risk and within your ability. Obey posted signage, follow resort safety policies including Park SMART and go to Skisafety.us for more information. FOR PARENTS TERRAIN PARK TECH FOR THEM, SO YOU CAN WORRY LESS No one wants to under/overshoot a terrain park jump. Air Intelligence TM uses advanced lidar and video tech to inform riders before they Even leave the ground. Speed awareness Air Intelligence’s technology helps riders better understand how to approach jumps at appropriate speeds More information promotes better decision making Air Intelligence’s technology helps riders better understand the relationship between speed and distance Real-time feedback can help improve skills and habits Collision avoidance LiDAR and A.I. technology is also used to electronically show the status of the landing area. Continually monitors landing area Alerts riders when landing area is not clear Patrol alert technology* * Does not replace the best practice of a personal safety spotter. PERSONAL JUMP VIDEO DELIVERED INSTANTLY Relive the highlights of your rider’s day in the park. Share in their enthusiasm as progression and confidence grows. Skip to content Products Monoski Custom Projects Parts and Options Bindings and Binding Blocking Sets Shock Absorber Seat System Other Options Support Quote and Order Demo and Tuning Services Resources Manual How-to Videos Funding FAQs Contact Products Monoski Custom Projects Parts and Options Bindings and Binding Blocking Sets Shock Absorber Seat System Other Options Support Quote and Order Demo and Tuning Services Resources Manual How-to Videos Funding FAQs Contact Contact Products Our Monoskis Hydra The Hydra is our most popular model — a high-performance monoski with unique suspension kinematics that performs exceptionally well for racers and intermediate to advanced recreational skiers. The Hydra automatically moves the body of the monoskier as able-bodied skiers do in a turn: it applies pressure near the ski tip during turn initiation to begin bending the ski, then moves the skier backward on the ski to center the pressure at the apex of the turn, and finally shifts slightly to the back to straighten the ski and accelerate out of the turn. This movement helps users – especially those with limited upper body mobility – shift weight and turn more easily. To our knowledge, the Hydra is the only monoski on the market with this kind of suspension system, and better pressure distribution also leads to better control. The Hydra retains the competitive advantages of all DynAccess monoskis: extremely responsive and strong, with an exceptionally stiff frame, made from high-grade materials yet relatively lightweight. This is achieved through a unique structural geometry, custom-developed high-quality bearings and hardware, and a Penske Racing shock absorber specifically designed for DynAccess. The Hydra sits stably on lift chairs — it sits further back on the seat and tilts the rider slightly backward. Standard finish: clear hard anodized; custom colors available upon request. Request A Quote Parts & Options Hydra Light The Hydra Light is a lighter version of the Hydra monoski, specially developed for lighter skiers. It is a completely redesigned monoski, and almost every part is lighter than on the regular Hydra. The complete frame with shock, etc. (without a seat or a footrest) weighs 15.4 lbs. (7.0 kg) and 18.2 lbs. (8.2 kg) with a footrest. This is 6.5 lbs. (3 kg) lighter than the regular Hydra. A new lightweight shock with a single spring was developed for the Hydra Light, based on a mountain bike shock but modified for DynAccess monoskis. It features a custom-made ice scraper, cold temperature oil, and modified damping by Penske Racing Shocks, with both high & low speed rebound and compression damping adjusters. If desired, a full-size Hydra shock can be installed in the Hydra Light frame. The Hydra Light works best for skiers under 135 lbs, and the frames are anodized in Red or Light Blue as standard. Request A Quote Parts & Options Tensor The Tensor is a high-performance and highly versatile monoski. It accepts different types of shocks — including air shocks, coil-over shocks, and light-duty shocks — allowing you to customize your ride and ride height. Standard setup includes the Penske Racing Shocks Pro-Air: dual-chamber air spring (Chambers 1 & 2), hydraulic damping, and easy adjustability of spring rate, ride height, rebound, and compression damping (no tools needed). Weight (w/o seat): 23.25 lbs. Benefits: high stiffness for excellent control, stable lift-chair positioning by sitting further back and tilting the rider slightly backward, and suitability for racing, recreation, and adaptive programs alike. Request A Quote Parts & Options Legacy Models Legacy Model Torque 2 Our strongest model to date. The Torque 2 uses thin-walled, closed-section chromoly members for its frame, suspension link, and “boot” tower — making it extremely stiff and durable. This stiffness translates to superior rider control and a crisper feel on the slopes. Parts & Options Legacy Model Torque 1 The Torque 1 is the original DynAccess monoski. It’s compact and lightweight, weighing: 23 lbs without a seat 20.5 lbs without a footrest The Torque 1 features a steep thigh angle (40°), which reduces the moment of inertia and helps the skier initiate quick, responsive turns. Multi-Day, All-Inclusive Trips on the Wild & Scenic Rogue River Nestled in the picturesque landscape of Southern Oregon, the Rogue River is one of the most popular destinations for drift boat fishing. Drift boats provide anglers with the perfect way to access remote and offers an unparalleled fly fishing experience for enthusiasts seeking the thrill of catching adult and Half Pounder Steelhead. These steelhead, known for their feisty nature and acrobatic displays, provide an exciting challenge for anglers of all levels. We offer 4 day, 3 night all-inclusive fishing and rafting trips down the wild and scenic section of the Rogue River. Learn More Take a Trip With Us It’s hard to cram 4 days and 3 nights of adventure into one video — but we managed to condense it to about 17 minutes of footage to give you an idea! Give it a listen if when you have the time. 4-Day, 3-Night Drift Boat Adventure Prepare for a one-of-a-kind fishing experience on the majestic Rogue River. Our trips are all-inclusive of lodging and meals and our expert guides will ensure a thrilling and memorable trip. Overnight Lodging at Historic Wilderness Lodges Evenings and nights are spent in historic Rogue River wilderness lodges. These lodges are all boat-in only and feature all the comforts of home with showers and a place to gather around in the main lodge. Riverside & Lodge Meals Each morning, and every night breakfast and dinner are hosted at the wilderness lodges. Riverside lunches on the Rogue are a memorable experience, featuring fresh steelhead and a deli spread. What’s Included in Your Trip Fly Fishing: A Nature Lover's Dream Adventure! Imagine casting your line into the pristine waters of the Rogue River, surrounded by breathtaking scenery that changes with every bend. Towering Douglas firs and rugged cliffs create a stunning backdrop as you wait for that telltale tug on your rod. The air is filled with the sounds of nature: the gentle rush of the river, the melody of birdsong, and perhaps the distant call of a deer hidden in the thickets. Go with the Flow “ One of the best trips we have been on! Scenic ride down the river with plenty of wildlife to see. We had excellent meals every day and the guides were helpful, fun & informative. We had a blast! ” Dan & Jill Ripple, Reno NV Read More reviews from our clients Location Rogue River, Oregon Hours Always Open - Book Now! Trips Run August - November Contact Tim@drift-adventures.com Katie@drift-adventures.com 541-206-2766 or 775-527-2600 Tim Conway - Licensed - Insured - Bonded in Oregon. Fishing | Experience Rogue River Fishing Drift 0 Skip to Content Home Fishing Rafting Lodges Dates & Cost About Contact News from the River Book a Trip Open Menu Close Menu Home Fishing Rafting Lodges Dates & Cost About Contact News from the River Book a Trip Open Menu Close Menu Home Fishing Rafting Lodges Dates & Cost About Contact News from the River Book a Trip The mighty Rogue River flows 215 miles from its headwaters in Crater Lake National Park to the Pacific Ocean in Gold Beach. In 1968, an 84-mile stretch of the Rogue River was designated as a National Wild & Scenic River by the US Congress, which means that it is protected from development and other forms of disturbance that could degrade its natural and scenic qualities. This designation recognizes the river's exceptional values, including its outstanding scenery, wildlife habitat, and recreational opportunities. Our trips take you through 43 miles of the Wild & Scenic section of the river, stopping at 3 comfortable riverside wilderness lodges along the way. All trips include 3 hearty meals and all of the gear and instruction you need to catch those pesky half pounders! Where We Drift BOOK NOW From Our Clients "What a blast on the Rogue!" My family had an incredibly memorable week with Captain Tim and his awesome team of guides through the Rogue for four days. Tim went above and beyond to ensure we were safe, ensure we had fun fishing, jumping off rocks, ate well, always had beverages within arms length, and ensured we made memories that will last forever. Couldn’t recommend Drift any more! —Jack B., Carmel Valley, CA "Put This One on Your Bucket List!" I applaud the owner, Tim Conway, and his very experienced fishing and white water guides. The fabulous scenery of the Rogue River combined with the home cooked meals, real beds, hot showers every night and let’s not forget the fabulous fishing is something everyone should experience at least once. Let’s check that box on your bucket list!! —Al B., Reno, NV "Fantastic Trip Down the Wild & Scenic Rogue River!" Our trip with Drift Adventures down the Rogue River was absolutely fantastic from start to finish. The whole experience captured everything you hope for in an Oregon fishing adventure — stunning scenery, great fishing, and a top-notch outfitter and guides who made each day unforgettable. Can’t wait to go again! —Chris C., Creswell OR "I've never been so close to bears and bald eagles." Nothing beats a back to nature trip! Also, throw in some fantastic fishing with a great crew. The lodges that we stayed in were historic and very comfortable. The food was excellent. I especially enjoyed the lunches with fresh caught steelhead. This trip will rejuvenate your body and soul. Tim is an excellent guide and leader. —Ron R., Reno NV Your Adventure Awaits Big Fish Stories Embark on a thrilling journey as you take in the scenery, the wildlife, and the adrenaline of the experience. Make sure to save your “Big Fish” pictures and stories for the dinner table each night. Unforgettable Memories Create lasting memories and stories to share. Immerse yourself in the thrill of the Oregon wilderness. Along the way, you might spot a black bear, bald eagle, river otter or salmon and steelhead trout who make their home along this incredible river. BOOK NOW Expert Guides Benefit from the knowledge and expertise of our professional guides. Our guides are all trained to navigate the waters of the Rogue to make your trip enjoyable and safe. “ I fished with the Drift crew on the Rogue in September ‘24 and it was the trip of a lifetime. I’ve fished all over the world and none of those trips rivaled my Rogue experience. Tim and his crew were fantastic, getting us into great fishing, amazing scenery, wonderful food and a lot of fun. I enjoyed it so much that I’ve booked another trip for three friends and myself next September. ” Rich Fisher, Lincoln CA Contact Outfitter Location Rogue River, Oregon Hours Always Open - Book Now! Trip Dates & Costs | Explore Rogue River Now Drift 0 Skip to Content Home Fishing Rafting Lodges Dates & Cost About Contact News from the River Book a Trip Open Menu Close Menu Home Fishing Rafting Lodges Dates & Cost About Contact News from the River Book a Trip Open Menu Close Menu Home Fishing Rafting Lodges Dates & Cost About Contact News from the River Book a Trip All-Inclusive Trips; 4 Days, 3 Nights Drift maintains a special use permit issued by the Bureau of Land Management. Trip start and end dates are the same every year. Trip Dates September 1-4, 6-9, 11-14, 16-19, 21-24, 26-29 October 1-4, 6-9, 11-14, 16-19, 21-24, 26-29 November Oct. 31- Nov. 3, 5-7, 10-12 Trip Costs $2650/person, 4 days $2375/person, 3 days late season Includes, all lodging, all meals, river fees, guides and equipment. Gratuities are not included but are appreciated for a job well done. Payments 50% of total trip cost is due at time of booking. Remaining 50% is due 60 days prior to trip start date. See below for cancellation policy. BOOK NOW FAQs Transportation If you’re flying in: The closest airport to our launch is Medford. You can also fly to Eugene (about 2.5 hour drive) or Portland (about a 4 hour drive). Driving to the river: If you have rented a car or have driven your own, we will give you directions to the launch and we will arrange for your car to be shuttled to the take out. Charges range from $135 for individual cars to $900 for a group of 12 to be driven in a shuttle van. If you have flown in as a group it is best to rent a van service to pick you up at the airport and be taken to your motel and then on to the river the following morning. They will then pick you up after the trip ends and transport you back to the airport. We can arrange this service for you. Where does the trip start and end? You will meet your guides at Graves Creek the morning of the first day of the trip. Directions to the launch will be given to you once the trip is booked. The launch is located about 20 miles off I-5. We generally reach our final destination on the fourth day about 11 am at the community of Agnes. If you are on a 3 day trip, we reach Foster Bar about 4pm. You are about 27 miles from Gold Beach, if you’re heading for the coast. If you’re traveling back to Interstate 5, you are about 2 hours to Grants Pass. Where should I stay the night before we launch? The trip wiIl begin at Graves Creek at 9 am, so it’s best to spend the night preceding your trip in Grants Pass. Here are some options for lodges near our launch: — Riverside Inn 1-800-334-4567 — Galice Resort 541-476-3818 — Morrison’s Rogue River Lodge 1-800-826-1963. What kind of gear do I need to bring? High quality rain gear including rain hat and warm coat A couple changes of clothes (casual or sport clothes are customary) Sneakers and waterproof boots in the event of rain (late fall) Small flashlight Sunscreen Sunglasses Camera & binoculars if you wish Shorts and Swimsuit (early fall) Hat for shade Long underwear, gloves and rubber pac boots (for late October-November) Day pack for items you want to keep close while on the river Beverage and mix if you wish Book to read at leisure Water Bottle Cell phones & internet Phones don’t work on this stretch of the river! We carry a satellite phone for emergencies. What is the cancellation policy? Due to the nature of our business with limited launch dates, trip size and commitments to lodges and guides - deposits are non-refundable. However, if we can refill your cancelled seats at full price, we will refund all fees received. If you must cancel, your deposit will be refunded only if the vacancies can be filled by you or us. If you cancel within 60 days of your start date, you will owe the entire balance. If we have to cancel, you will receive a full refund. Come rain, snow, or high water, we almost always run our trips. But if there are insufficient reservations, we reserve the right to alter the departure date or place, or to cancel a trip. There will be a full refund for any trip canceled by Drift Adventures, LLC. Our financial liability is limited to the amount paid to Drift and shall not cover any other costs incurred by trip members. We strongly urge that you buy trip insurance in the event you become ill or are hurt prior to your trip or in the event you must depart a trip in progress. Our guests in the past have used Travelex, Travel Guard and others. “Our October fly fishing trip down the Wild and Scenic Rogue was spectacular. The scenery was mind blowing; the wildlife did not disappoint; and the guides were professional and highly skilled in maneuvering the river (and they knew the best fishing spots!). If you are looking for an outfitter who offers a customized experience with attention to the details, Drift Adventures brings it all.” -Shannon Christopher, Brookings, Oregon Book A Trip Location Rogue River, Oregon Hours Always Open - Book Now! Taylor Norton, GUIDE Taylor grew up fishing Long Island Sound, He moved west and honed his skills on western trout running pack trips in the Rockies. His passion for teaching makes for a a memorable trip for his clients. Jason Shaw, GUIDE A true outdoorsman who spends a lot of time on the water and sure to create a memorable day for his guests on his home waters Chad Fuller, GUIDE Chad has carried a fly rod all over the western seaboard from baja to Alaska and hunts the flats for saltwater big game every chance he gets. Guests are sure to enjoy the knowledge and good times that come with a day on the water. Drew Johnston, GUIDE & GEAR GURU “Yo!” Drew is a good time on the water with strong knowledge of Tahoe’s surrounding steams and stillwaters. For float tube and walk & wade trips Drew has the map and ties the bugs to find big fish. Jasper Donley, GUIDE A 4-Season mountain native with great knowledge of stillwater and rivers around the Sierra. You’ll find him on the water or on the slopes 8 days a week. Drew Litzinger, GUIDE “Litz” has the fishing bug like few other when it comes to Sierra trout. He’s comfortable in a float tube in the high alpine, in a drift boat, or walking a river. A great teacher for all and feel safe with his fire fighting, EMT background. John Brassfield, OWNER & GUIDE DIRECTOR John has spent the last 15 years hunting for fabled fish. The big fish of the McCloud are where this passion started. Now more than ever he finds his heart’s desires on the flats chasing permit. Jacob Smith, GUIDE & SHOP TEAM Jacob might love trout fishing more than any of us. His pursuit and passion is on full display whether around the counter at the shop or riverside with his clients. Mike Patten, BASS GUIDE Our dedicated bass guide who knows the ins and outs of float and fly, striper fishing, and conventional bass fishing. He even comes with a boat! Bob Caron, GUIDE Bobby has a good time on the water and has a great way of becoming fast friends with whoever he fishes with. They are known for their beauty along with the gorgeous trout that come with them. Although appealing to the eye, many find these fisheries as being some of the most difficult to figure out. This is your opportunity to venture with a highly experienced guide that will make your trip to these rivers an all around success. Service Blake Hunter has the skills and techniques to trick finicky trout in all situations and gives clientele of every skill level the opportunity of catching the fish of a lifetime. Hunter will be there every step of the way; perfecting your cast, matching the hatch, and locating the fish for you. You will be using new age rigging techniques along with intricate home tied flies known to produce positive results. Don't find yourself flustered and alone on the river when you have a definite answer to your fly fishing needs with Blake Hunter's guide service. pages.text: Five Dot Fly Fishing Club | Round Valley Reservoir | Susanville, California top of page Five Dot Pheasant Club (530) 254-6987 HOME RATES GROUP RATES ACCOMMODATIONS MEMBERSHIP ABOUT CONTACT ACCESS LICENSE PHOTOS More Use tab to navigate through the menu items. 400-Acre Private Catch & Release Trout Fishery Located 17 Miles North of Susanville, CA Five Dot Fly Fishing Club | Premier Private Trout Fishery Five Dot Fly Fishing Club is situated on one of California's largest private stillwater fisheries; Round Valley Reservoir. This 400-acre reservoir is located in the upper elevations of Susanville California and is in an ultra secluded basin. Triploid Rainbow Trout are growing fast and strong in this fertile environment and can be commonly caught in the 2 to 5 pound range along with some larger fish. The reservoir is fed by natural springs, seasonal run-off and also from smaller lakes located in remote areas of the Five Dot Ranch. The Ranch is located only a few miles from Eagle Lake and is close enough to Susanville for anglers to have plenty of options for lodging and camping while fishing this remarkable fishery. A limited number of aluminum boats without motors are available. Fisherman are allowed to bring their own electric trolling motors and/or float tubes or personal pontoon boats. ​ The reservoir can accommodate groups of 2-15 people. Smaller groups may be combined with other groups of similar size.
