Reserve… A Campsite A Meeting Room A Park Pavilion Volunteer… As a Youth Sport Coach At the Senior Center About About the Community Services Department Administrative Offices Advisory Boards Community Services Foundation Event Calendar MENU Community Services Parks Reservation Information A+ A- Sub Menu Skip Sidebar Navigation Reservation Information Parks Reservation Information Fee and Deposit Schedule TITLE 13 Rules and Regulations Last item for navigation Reservation Information General Information Douglas County Parks are available for free for the enjoyment of all, however if you wish to have exclusive use of an area of a park, there are areas / facilities that can be reserved for that purpose, for a fee. There are also some basic guidelines that need to be followed to exclude the rest of the public for your event or activity: All applications require a $5 administrative processing fee. Once an application is approved, the deposit must be paid within 10 working days to hold your date, and all fees must be paid 10 working days prior to your reservation. Comprehensive General Liability insurance naming Douglas County as additional insured will be required for any event when: The event is open to the public A fee is charged for the event The very nature of the event and/or the number of applicants require its application, and/or As determined by the Director of Community Services or his/her authorized designee. The minimum limits for the insurance shall be as follows: $1,000,000 for each occurrence $1,000,000 annual aggregate Insurance coverage must include premises and operations, and products and completed operations as a minimum. Further, if alcohol is to be sold, the insurance policy shall include Liquor Liability naming Douglas County as additional insured, with the same aforementioned requirements and minimum limits Depend

Home » Recreation & Parks » Facilities » Outdoor Rental Spaces » Tahoe Vista Scenic Overlook Tahoe Vista Scenic Overlook Alpen Lily 2026-06-15T10:22:54-07:00 Offering two-hour rental blocks with some of the best views anywhere on Lake Tahoe. ADA accessible, access limited to 40 people. TVRA Scenic Overlook Information Rental Fees User Type 2-Hour Rental Resident $600 Non-Resident/Non-Profit $1,200 Commercial $2,400 Resident : Property owner or tenant within North Tahoe PUD boundaries Non-Resident/Non-Profit : Person or non-profit business that resides outside of North Tahoe PUD Boundaries Commercial : Any business that cannot prove residency and has a business, be it a LLC, Sole Proprietorship, Cooperation, Small Business or Partnership. Facility Information Scenic Overlook is ADA accessible Rental is limited to 40 people Rental includes 40 chairs Time reserved is inclusive of setup and cleanup Scenic Overlook will be sectioned off for private use Rentals available Monday-Friday only in July and August Rentals available 7-days a week in May, June, September and October Rental Instructions Step 1: Login to MyRecAccount Step 2: Log in (upper left corner) or Create Account for first time users Step 3: Click on Facility Rental Tab Step 4: Click on Tahoe Vista Recreation Area and select Scenic Overlook Step 5: Select date under Make a Reservation If area is blocked out, rental is not available Step 6: Complete prompts Sign waiver Continue to payment FAQs Can I bring in additional rental items? Chairs are provided for you to setup with a Scenic Overlook rental. The only additional item that is allowed at a Scenic Overlook rental is an arch. No tables are allowed. Where can I have my reception? A nice idea is to also reserve the TVRA Plaza, which is suitable for a large event and additional rental items. Ceremony can occur at the Overlook, with the reception on the Plaza. Can I throw biodegradable items, such as rose petals or confetti, at the event? No. In protection of the wildlife and environment, there is no throwing or releasing of anything at events or weddings. What time can I arrive? The 2-hour Scenic Overlook rental is inclusive of your setup and cleanup time. That means that you should not plan to arrive several hours early to setup. You can arrive 30-45 minutes early to ensure chairs, arch and flowers are in proper location. Will I have exclusive access to the Overlook? The Scenic Overlook will be marked and sectioned off for private use during your 2-hour rental period. The remainder of Tahoe Vista Recreation Area will remain open and accessible to the public. NTPUD cannot guarantee exclusive use of space during rental. What months are rentals available? May-October Why can’t I book on Saturday or Sunday in July and August? We want all of our users to have an enjoyable experience. Due the popularity of TVRA during summer months and high volume of public use, we need to take each weekend request on a case-by-case basis. Please reach out to parks@ntpud.org for assistance. Can I reserve parking spaces? The Tahoe Vista Recreation Area has a dedicated parking lot and street parking is also available in specific areas. NTPUD will not reserve spaces for events, the lot is available on a first come, first serve basis. Wildlife? Lake Tahoe is black bear and raccoon habitat, please use caution. Make sure to clean up after yourself and your guests and deposit all trash into a bear-proof trash receptacle. Do not leave food unattended at any time. Do not approach wildlife. Can I grill or use charcoal? Charcoal grilling and grills are restricted within North Lake Tahoe and NTPUD parks (with the exception of the built-in grill at the Ramada), per North Tahoe Fire Protection District seasonal burn ban. The use of propane outdoor barbecues are also restricted on certain days, according to the fire restrictions at the time. Visit www.ntfire.net for up-to-date information and regulations related to regional and local burn bans. What about trash? NTPUD staff will collect trash, but renter is responsible for bagging trash and putting inside or next to trash receptacles. Do not overfill trash receptacles. Renter is responsible for bagging their own trash and replacing with bags if full. Renter may choose to bring additional trash cans for placement around rental space. How close to rental can I reserve? A 5 day minimum is required for rentals. What are insurance requirements? NTPUD requires general liability insurance with additional liquor liability coverage any time that alcohol is served. For outdoor events, general liability insurance is required for events over 100 people, any athletic event, and events deemed “high risk” per NTPUD. Features concrete pavers, a sit wall, ADA access and direct access to bathrooms. TVRA Plaza Information Facility Information Rentals available May-October TVRA Plaza is a large, lakefront space that can accommodate up to 150 people Plaza ADA Accessible Additional rental items from third parties, such as tents, tables and chairs allowed. Plaza is rented by the day Plaza is separated by a large seat wall, with walkway to water Food trucks welcome Adjacent to bathrooms Additional space available through booking Picnic Areas 1, 3 or 5 Rental Fees 1-50 people User Type Daily Cost Resident $800 Non-Resident/Non-Profit $1,600 Commercial $2,400 51-100 people User Type Daily Cost Resident $900 Non-Resident/Non-Profit $1,800 Commercial $2,400 101-150 people User Type Daily Cost Resident $1,000 Non-Resident/Non-Profit $2,000 Commercial $3,000 Resident : Property owner or tenant within North Tahoe PUD boundaries Non-Resident/Non-Profit : Person or non-profit business that resides outside of North Tahoe PUD Boundaries Commercial : Any business that cannot prove residency and has a business, be it a LLC, Sole Proprietorship, Cooperation, Small Business or Partnership. Rental Instructions Step 1: Use the NTPUD’s registration software Step 2: Log in (upper left corner) or Create Account for first time users Step 3: Click on Facility Rental Tab Step 4: Click on Tahoe Vista Recreation Area and select TVRA Plaza Step 5: Select date under Make a Reservation If area is blocked out, rental is not available Step 6: Complete prompts Sign waiver Continue to payment FAQs Can I bring in additional rental items? Yes. Third party rental items, such as a tent, tables and chairs are allowed at the Plaza. Where can I have my ceremony? A nice idea for a full day at the beach is to also reserve the TVRA Scenic Overlook, which allows for a 2-hour rental overlooking the water. Can I throw biodegradable items, such as rose petals or confetti, at the event? No. In protection of the wildlife and environment, there is no throwing or releasing of anything at events or weddings. What time can I arrive? Rental begins when park opens, at 7am. Drop off of supplies is not permitted until day of. Will I have exclusive access to the Plaza? The Plaza will be marked and sectioned off for private use. The remainder of Tahoe Vista Recreation Area will be open and accessible to the public and it is likely that people will pass through the Plaza on the way to the bathrooms. NTPUD cannot guarantee exclusive use of space during rental. What months are rentals available? May-October Can I reserve parking spaces? The Tahoe Vista Recreation Area has a dedicated parking lot and street parking is also available in specific areas. NTPUD will not reserve spaces for events, the lot is available on a first come, first serve basis. Wildlife? Lake Tahoe is black bear and raccoon habitat, please use caution. Make sure to clean up after yourself and your guests and deposit all trash into a bear-proof trash receptacle. Do not leave food unattended at any time. Do not approach wildlife. Can I grill or use charcoal? Charcoal grilling and grills are restricted within North Lake Tahoe and NTPUD parks (with the exception of the built-in grill at the Ramada), per North Tahoe Fire Protection District seasonal burn ban. The use of propane outdoor barbecues are also restricted on certain days, according to the fire restrictions at the time. Visit www.ntfire.net for up-to-date information and regulations related to regional and local burn bans. What about trash? NTPUD staff will collect trash, but renter is responsible for bagging trash and putting inside or next to trash receptacles. Do not overfill trash receptacles. Renter is responsible for bagging their own trash and replacing with bags if full. There are several trash cans at the Ramada however renter may choose to bring in additional cans if they desire. How close to rental can I reserve? A 5 day minimum is required for rentals. What are insurance requirements? NTPUD requires general liability insurance with additional liquor liability coverage any time that alcohol is served. For outdoor events, general liability insurance is required for events over 100 people, any athletic event, and events deemed “high risk” per NTPUD. Unless a District-approved exemption applies, applicants shall provide and maintain general liability insurance with limits of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence, two million dollars ($2,000,000) general aggregate
